name: OMXS30 Screener Import

# Triggas manuellt från GitHub Actions-gränssnittet.
# Klistra in screener-texten (hela Telegram-meddelandet) i inmatningsfältet.
#
# Kräver två GitHub Secrets:
#   DASHBOARD_URL           — t.ex. https://asset-screen-fetch.replit.app
#   DASHBOARD_IMPORT_SECRET — samma värde som TELEGRAM_IMPORT_SECRET i Replit
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      screener_text:
        description: "Klistra in hela screener-texten från Telegram här"
        required: true
        type: string

jobs:
  import:
    name: Importera screener-session
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5

    steps:
      - name: Skicka till dashboard-API
        id: import
        run: |
          RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" \
            -X POST "${{ secrets.DASHBOARD_URL }}/api/telegram-import" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.DASHBOARD_IMPORT_SECRET }}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            --data-raw "$(jq -n --arg text "${{ inputs.screener_text }}" '{"text":$text}')")

          HTTP_CODE=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | tail -n1)
          BODY=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | head -n-1)

          echo "HTTP status: $HTTP_CODE"
          echo "Response: $BODY"

          if [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "200" ]; then
            echo "✅ Session uppdaterad (befintligt datum)"
          elif [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "201" ]; then
            echo "✅ Ny session skapad"
          else
            echo "❌ Import misslyckades (HTTP $HTTP_CODE)"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Sammanfattning
        if: success()
        run: |
          echo "### ✅ Screener importerad" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "Dashboard: ${{ secrets.DASHBOARD_URL }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

FILE: artifacts/api-server/src/app.ts

import express, { type Express } from "express";
import cookieParser from "cookie-parser";
import pinoHttp from "pino-http";
import rateLimit from "express-rate-limit";
import path from "path";
import { existsSync } from "fs";
import router from "./routes";
import { logger } from "./lib/logger";
import { authMiddleware } from "./middlewares/authMiddleware";

const app: Express = express();

// Replit (and most PaaS) run behind a reverse proxy that sets X-Forwarded-For.
// Without this, express-rate-limit throws a ValidationError on every request.
app.set("trust proxy", 1);

app.use(
  pinoHttp({
    logger,
    serializers: {
      req(req) {
        return {
          id: req.id,
          method: req.method,
          url: req.url?.split("?")[0],
        };
      },
      res(res) {
        return {
          statusCode: res.statusCode,
        };
      },
    },
  }),
);
// The dashboard and API share one origin through the Replit proxy. No
// credentialed cross-origin browser access is required.
app.use(cookieParser());
app.use(express.json());

// General rate limiter — 200 req/min per IP
app.use(
  "/api",
  rateLimit({
    windowMs: 60_000,
    max: 200,
    standardHeaders: true,
    legacyHeaders: false,
    message: { error: "Too many requests — try again in a minute." },
  }),
);

// Stricter limit on EdgeAI import (hits external service)
app.use(
  "/api/screener/sessions/import-from-edgeai",
  rateLimit({
    windowMs: 60_000,
    max: 5,
    standardHeaders: true,
    legacyHeaders: false,
    message: { error: "EdgeAI import rate limit — max 5 per minute." },
  }),
);
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true }));
app.use(authMiddleware);

app.use("/api", router);

// In production, serve the built Vite frontend from the same Express process.
// The frontend is built to artifacts/screener/dist/public relative to the repo root.
if (process.env.NODE_ENV === "production") {
  const staticDir = path.resolve(process.cwd(), "artifacts/screener/dist/public");
  if (existsSync(staticDir)) {
    app.use(express.static(staticDir));
    // Catch-all: serve index.html for client-side routing (wouter)
    app.get("*splat", (_req, res) => {
      res.sendFile(path.join(staticDir, "index.html"));
    });
    logger.info({ staticDir }, "Serving frontend static files");
  } else {
    logger.warn({ staticDir }, "Production static dir not found — frontend not served");
  }
}

export default app;

FILE: artifacts/api-server/src/index.ts

import app from "./app";
import { logger } from "./lib/logger";
import { startScheduler } from "./lib/scheduler";
import { runMigrations } from "./lib/migrate";

const rawPort = process.env["PORT"];

if (!rawPort) {
  throw new Error(
    "PORT environment variable is required but was not provided.",
  );
}

const port = Number(rawPort);

if (Number.isNaN(port) || port <= 0) {
  throw new Error(`Invalid PORT value: "${rawPort}"`);
}

async function main() {
  // Apply pending versioned schema migrations before accepting traffic.
  // runMigrations uses a PostgreSQL advisory lock, so concurrent instances
  // serialize safely during deployment.
  await runMigrations();

  app.listen(port, (err) => {
    if (err) {
      logger.error({ err }, "Error listening on port");
      process.exit(1);
    }

    logger.info({ port }, "Server listening");
    // Start only after listen succeeds: migrations and the HTTP startup path
    // are complete, and the scheduler can safely use the live DB connection.
    startScheduler();
  });
}

main().catch((err) => {
  logger.error({ err }, "Fatal startup error — process cannot continue");
  process.exit(1);
});

FILE: artifacts/api-server/src/lib/auth.ts

import crypto from 'crypto';
import type { AuthUser } from '@workspace/api-zod';
import { db, sessionsTable } from '@workspace/db';
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { type Request, type Response } from 'express';
import * as client from 'openid-client';

export const ISSUER_URL = process.env.ISSUER_URL ?? 'https://replit.com/oidc';
export const SESSION_COOKIE = 'sid';
export const SESSION_TTL = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

export interface SessionData {
  user: AuthUser;
  access_token: string;
  refresh_token?: string;
  expires_at?: number;
}

let oidcConfig: client.Configuration | null = null;

export async function getOidcConfig(): Promise<client.Configuration> {
  if (!oidcConfig) {
    oidcConfig = await client.discovery(
      new URL(ISSUER_URL),
      process.env.REPL_ID!,
    );
  }
  return oidcConfig;
}

export async function createSession(data: SessionData): Promise<string> {
  const sid = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
  await db.insert(sessionsTable).values({
    sid,
    sess: data as unknown as Record<string, unknown>,
    expire: new Date(Date.now() + SESSION_TTL),
  });
  return sid;
}

export async function getSession(sid: string): Promise<SessionData | null> {
  const [row] = await db
    .select()
    .from(sessionsTable)
    .where(eq(sessionsTable.sid, sid));

  if (!row || row.expire < new Date()) {
    if (row) await deleteSession(sid);
    return null;
  }

  return row.sess as unknown as SessionData;
}

export async function updateSession(
  sid: string,
  data: SessionData,
): Promise<void> {
  await db
    .update(sessionsTable)
    .set({
      sess: data as unknown as Record<string, unknown>,
      expire: new Date(Date.now() + SESSION_TTL),
    })
    .where(eq(sessionsTable.sid, sid));
}

export async function deleteSession(sid: string): Promise<void> {
  await db.delete(sessionsTable).where(eq(sessionsTable.sid, sid));
}

export async function clearSession(res: Response, sid?: string): Promise<void> {
  if (sid) await deleteSession(sid);
  res.clearCookie(SESSION_COOKIE, { path: '/' });
}

export function getSessionId(req: Request): string | undefined {
  const authHeader = req.headers['authorization'];
  if (authHeader?.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
    return authHeader.slice(7);
  }
  return req.cookies?.[SESSION_COOKIE];
}

FILE: artifacts/api-server/src/lib/candidateRanking.test.ts

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import { candidateSelectionScore, selectSourceBalancedCandidates } from "./candidateRanking.ts";

const candidate = (ticker: string, signalSource: string, overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => ({
  ticker,
  signalSource,
  direction: "LONG",
  category: "MOMENTUM",
  rank: 1,
  perf1m: signalSource === "edgeai" ? 0.55 : 12,
  rs3m: signalSource === "edgeai" ? 1 : 10,
  rsi: signalSource === "edgeai" ? 30 : 70,
  pctB: signalSource === "edgeai" ? 100 : 0,
  distFrom20dH: 0,
  ...overrides,
});

test("mixed sources are interleaved instead of compared in incompatible units", () => {
  const selected = selectSourceBalancedCandidates([
    candidate("EDGE-1", "edgeai"),
    candidate("EDGE-2", "edgeai", { rank: 2 }),
    candidate("TELEGRAM-1", "telegram"),
  ], 3);
  assert.deepEqual(selected.map((row) => row.ticker), ["EDGE-1", "TELEGRAM-1", "EDGE-2"]);
});

test("same-ticker candidates from different sources remain independently ranked", () => {
  const selected = selectSourceBalancedCandidates([
    candidate("SAME", "edgeai"),
    candidate("SAME", "telegram", { perf1m: 12, rs3m: 10 }),
  ], 2);
  assert.deepEqual(selected.map((row) => row.signalSource), ["edgeai", "telegram"]);
});

test("manual short weakness ranks in the correct direction", () => {
  const weak = candidate("WEAK", "telegram", { direction: "SHORT", perf1m: -12, rs3m: -8 });
  const strong = candidate("STRONG", "telegram", { direction: "SHORT", perf1m: 5, rs3m: 4 });
  assert.ok(candidateSelectionScore(weak) > candidateSelectionScore(strong));
});

test("EdgeAI score shrinks small samples and decays old signals", () => {
  const reliable = candidate("RELIABLE", "edgeai", { pctB: 200, distFrom20dH: 0 });
  const tinyOld = candidate("TINY-OLD", "edgeai", { pctB: 3, distFrom20dH: 9 });
  assert.ok(candidateSelectionScore(reliable) > candidateSelectionScore(tinyOld));
});

FILE: artifacts/api-server/src/lib/candidateRanking.ts
==============================================================================
type RankableCandidate = {
  signalSource?: string | null;
  direction: string;
  category: string;
  rank: number;
  ticker: string;
  perf1m: number;
  rs3m: number;
  rsi: number;
  pctB: number;
  distFrom20dH: number;
  edgeExpectancyR?: number | null;
  edgeSampleN?: number | null;
  signalAgeBars?: number | null;
  maxHoldDays?: number | null;
};

const SOURCE_ORDER = ["edgeai", "telegram", "manual", "screener", "unknown"];
const MAX_HOLD_DAYS: Record<string, number> = {
  MOMENTUM: 10,
  SQUEEZE: 15,
  STUDS: 5,
  WEAKEST: 10,
};

export function candidateSelectionScore(candidate: RankableCandidate): number {
  if (candidate.signalSource === "edgeai") {
    const expectancyR = candidate.edgeExpectancyR ?? candidate.rsi / 100;
    const sampleN = Math.max(0, candidate.edgeSampleN ?? candidate.pctB);
    const reliability = sampleN / (sampleN + 20);
    const maxHoldDays = candidate.maxHoldDays ?? MAX_HOLD_DAYS[candidate.category] ?? 10;
    const signalAgeBars = candidate.signalAgeBars ?? candidate.distFrom20dH;
    const ageDecay = Math.max(0, 1 - Math.max(0, signalAgeBars) / maxHoldDays);
    return expectancyR * reliability * ageDecay;
  }

  const directionSign = candidate.direction === "SHORT" ? -1 : 1;
  return directionSign * (candidate.perf1m + candidate.rs3m) / 100;
}

function compareWithinSource<T extends RankableCandidate>(a: T, b: T): number {
  return candidateSelectionScore(b) - candidateSelectionScore(a) ||
    a.rank - b.rank ||
    a.ticker.localeCompare(b.ticker);
}

/**
 * Never compare EdgeAI expectancy fields directly with Telegram/manual RSI and
 * momentum fields. Rank within each provenance first, then interleave sources.
 */
export function selectSourceBalancedCandidates<T extends RankableCandidate>(
  candidates: T[],
  limit: number,
): T[] {
  const groups = new Map<string, T[]>();
  for (const candidate of candidates) {
    const source = candidate.signalSource ?? "unknown";
    const group = groups.get(source) ?? [];
    group.push(candidate);
    groups.set(source, group);
  }
  for (const group of groups.values()) group.sort(compareWithinSource);

  const orderedSources = [...groups.keys()].sort((a, b) => {
    const ai = SOURCE_ORDER.indexOf(a);
    const bi = SOURCE_ORDER.indexOf(b);
    return (ai === -1 ? SOURCE_ORDER.length : ai) - (bi === -1 ? SOURCE_ORDER.length : bi) ||
      a.localeCompare(b);
  });

  const selected: T[] = [];
  let index = 0;
  while (selected.length < limit) {
    let added = false;
    for (const source of orderedSources) {
      const candidate = groups.get(source)?.[index];
      if (!candidate) continue;
      selected.push(candidate);
      added = true;
      if (selected.length >= limit) break;
    }
    if (!added) break;
    index++;
  }
  return selected;
}

FILE: artifacts/api-server/src/lib/candidateSynchronization.test.ts
==============================================================================
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";
import { top3SelectionSnapshotsTable } from "@workspace/db";

import {
  candidateIdentity,
  effectiveCandidateInputs,
  pendingRemovalIdentities,
  synchronizedSignalSource,
  aggregateSessionSource,
  legacySignalSourceForSession,
} from "./candidateSynchronizationPolicy.ts";
import {
  pendingCandidatesToRemove,
  synchronizeCandidates,
} from "./candidateSynchronization.ts";
import { reviewCandidate } from "./screeningReview.ts";

type Row = {
  market: "SE" | "US";
  signalSource: "edgeai" | "telegram" | "manual" | null;
  category: "MOMENTUM";
  ticker: string;
  direction: "LONG";
  outcome: "PENDING" | "WIN" | "LOSS";
};

const row = (
  ticker: string,
  market: Row["market"] = "SE",
  outcome: Row["outcome"] = "PENDING",
  signalSource: Row["signalSource"] = "edgeai",
): Row => ({ market, signalSource, category: "MOMENTUM", ticker, direction: "LONG", outcome });

function synchronizationTx(
  candidates: any[],
  snapshots: Array<{ candidateId: number; selected: boolean }>,
  incoming: any[],
) {
  const tx: any = {
    select: () => {
      let selectedTable: unknown;
      const query: any = {
        from(table: unknown) {
          selectedTable = table;
          return query;
        },
        where() {
          return query;
        },
        orderBy() {
          return query;
        },
        then(resolve: (value: any[]) => unknown, reject: (reason: unknown) => unknown) {
          return Promise.resolve(
            selectedTable === top3SelectionSnapshotsTable
              ? snapshots.filter((snapshot) => snapshot.selected)
              : candidates,
          ).then(resolve, reject);
        },
      };
      return query;
    },
    update: () => ({
      set(values: Record<string, unknown>) {
        return {
          where() {
            const current = candidates.find((candidate) => candidate.ticker === values.ticker);
            if (current) {
              const { id: _incomingId, ...persistedValues } = values;
              Object.assign(current, persistedValues);
            }
            return Promise.resolve();
          },
        };
      },
    }),
    delete: () => ({
      where() {
        const incomingIdentities = new Set(incoming.map(candidateIdentity));
        for (let index = candidates.length - 1; index >= 0; index--) {
          const candidate = candidates[index];
          if (
            candidate.outcome === "PENDING" &&
            !snapshots.some((snapshot) => snapshot.selected && snapshot.candidateId === candidate.id) &&
            !incomingIdentities.has(candidateIdentity(candidate))
          ) {
            candidates.splice(index, 1);
          }
        }
        return Promise.resolve();
      },
    }),
    insert: () => ({
      values(values: any) {
        candidates.push(values);
        return Promise.resolve();
      },
    }),
  };
  return tx;
}

function syncCandidate(id: number, ticker: string, overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {
  return {
    id,
    sessionId: 77,
    market: "SE",
    signalSource: "manual",
    category: "MOMENTUM",
    ticker,
    direction: "LONG",
    rank: 1,
    entryPrice: 100,
    stopPrice: 95,
    targetPrice: 110,
    outcome: "PENDING",
    ...overrides,
  };
}

test("selected snapshot candidates keep their row and signal plan through reimport", async () => {
  const selectedPresent = syncCandidate(101, "LOCKED", { rank: 1, entryPrice: 100, targetPrice: 110 });
  const selectedAbsent = syncCandidate(102, "SELECTED-ABSENT", { rank: 2, entryPrice: 80 });
  const staleLegacy = syncCandidate(103, "STALE-LEGACY", { rank: 3 });
  const existing = [selectedPresent, selectedAbsent, staleLegacy];
  const incoming = [
    syncCandidate(900, "LOCKED", { rank: 9, entryPrice: 125, targetPrice: 140 }),
  ];
  const preview = pendingCandidatesToRemove(
    existing,
    incoming,
    new Set([101, 102]),
  );

  const { candidates, diff } = await synchronizeCandidates(
    synchronizationTx(existing, [
      { candidateId: 101, selected: true },
      { candidateId: 102, selected: true },
    ], incoming),
    77,
    incoming,
  );

  assert.deepEqual(preview.map((entry) => entry.ticker), ["STALE-LEGACY"]);
  assert.deepEqual(diff.removed.map((entry) => entry.ticker), ["STALE-LEGACY"]);
  assert.deepEqual(diff.updated, []);
  assert.deepEqual(
    candidates.filter((candidate) => candidate.ticker === "LOCKED").map((candidate) => [
      candidate.id,
      candidate.rank,
      candidate.entryPrice,
      candidate.targetPrice,
    ]),
    [[101, 1, 100, 110]],
  );
  assert.ok(candidates.some((candidate) => candidate.id === 102));
});

test("selected snapshot and Today retain the same candidate identity", async () => {
  const original = syncCandidate(201, "TODAY-PICK");
  const snapshot = { candidateId: original.id, selected: true };
  const incoming = [syncCandidate(999, "TODAY-PICK", { entryPrice: 150 })];

  const { candidates } = await synchronizeCandidates(
    synchronizationTx([original], [snapshot], incoming),
    77,
    incoming,
  );

  const todayCandidate = candidates.find((candidate) => candidate.id === snapshot.candidateId);
  assert.ok(todayCandidate);
  assert.equal(todayCandidate.ticker, "TODAY-PICK");
  assert.equal(todayCandidate.entryPrice, 100);
});

test("unsnapshotted legacy candidates retain ordinary update and removal behavior", async () => {
  const existing = [
    syncCandidate(301, "LEGACY-UPDATE", { entryPrice: 100 }),
    syncCandidate(302, "LEGACY-REMOVE"),
  ];
  const incoming = [syncCandidate(999, "LEGACY-UPDATE", { entryPrice: 125 })];

  const { candidates, diff } = await synchronizeCandidates(
    synchronizationTx(existing, [], incoming),
    77,
    incoming,
  );

  assert.equal(candidates.find((candidate) => candidate.id === 301)?.entryPrice, 125);
  assert.deepEqual(diff.updated.map((entry) => entry.ticker), ["LEGACY-UPDATE"]);
  assert.deepEqual(diff.removed.map((entry) => entry.ticker), ["LEGACY-REMOVE"]);
});

test("explicit reimport policy preserves US pending and removes absent SE pending", () => {
  const existing = [row("KEEP"), row("REMOVE"), row("RESOLVED", "SE", "WIN"), row("US-KEEP", "US")];
  const incoming = [row("KEEP")];

  const preview = pendingRemovalIdentities(existing, incoming);
  const effective = effectiveCandidateInputs(incoming, existing);
  const effectiveIdentities = new Set(effective.map(candidateIdentity));
  const actual = existing.filter(
    (candidate) => candidate.outcome === "PENDING" && !effectiveIdentities.has(candidateIdentity(candidate)),
  );

  assert.deepEqual(preview, ["SE|MOMENTUM|REMOVE|LONG|edgeai"]);
  assert.deepEqual(
    actual.map((candidate) => candidateIdentity(candidate)),
    preview,
  );
});

test("resolved WIN and LOSS rows remain preserved when absent from incoming", () => {
  const existing = [row("WIN", "SE", "WIN"), row("LOSS", "SE", "LOSS")];
  const incoming = [row("NEW")];
  const effective = effectiveCandidateInputs(incoming, existing);

  // synchronizeCandidates only deletes stale PENDING rows; resolved rows are
  // retained even when they are not part of the effective import input.
  const remaining = existing.filter(
    (candidate) =>
      candidate.outcome !== "PENDING" ||
      effective.some((incomingCandidate) => candidateIdentity(incomingCandidate) === candidateIdentity(candidate)),
  );
  assert.deepEqual(remaining.map((candidate) => candidate.ticker), ["WIN", "LOSS"]);
  assert.deepEqual(pendingRemovalIdentities(existing, incoming), []);
});

test("only a genuinely separate market is carried into effective input", () => {
  const existing = [row("OLD-SE"), row("OLD-US", "US")];
  const incoming = [row("NEW-SE")];
  const effective = effectiveCandidateInputs(incoming, existing);

  assert.deepEqual(effective.map((candidate) => candidate.ticker), ["NEW-SE", "OLD-US"]);
  assert.deepEqual(
    pendingRemovalIdentities(existing, incoming),
    ["SE|MOMENTUM|OLD-SE|LONG|edgeai"],
  );
});

test("EdgeAI reimport preserves pending Telegram candidates in the same market", () => {

test("same setup from different sources coexists and keeps its resolved outcome", () => {
  const resolvedEdgeAi = row("SAME", "SE", "WIN", "edgeai");
  const incomingTelegram = row("SAME", "SE", "PENDING", "telegram");
  const effective = effectiveCandidateInputs([incomingTelegram], [resolvedEdgeAi]);

  assert.notEqual(candidateIdentity(resolvedEdgeAi), candidateIdentity(incomingTelegram));
  assert.deepEqual(
    effective.map((candidate) => [candidate.signalSource, candidate.outcome]),

  );
  assert.deepEqual(pendingRemovalIdentities([resolvedEdgeAi], [incomingTelegram]), []);
});

test("preview keeps legacy null-source provenance distinct from an imported source", () => {
  const legacyPending = row("SAME", "SE", "PENDING", null);
  const staleEdgeAi = row("STALE", "SE", "PENDING", "edgeai");
  const incomingEdgeAi = row("SAME", "SE", "PENDING", "edgeai");

  assert.notEqual(candidateIdentity(legacyPending), candidateIdentity(incomingEdgeAi));
  assert.equal(candidateIdentity(legacyPending), "SE|MOMENTUM|SAME|LONG|<unknown>");
  assert.deepEqual(
    effectiveCandidateInputs([incomingEdgeAi], [legacyPending, staleEdgeAi])
      .map((candidate) => [candidate.ticker, candidate.signalSource]),
    [["SAME", "edgeai"], ["SAME", null]],
  );
  assert.deepEqual(
    pendingRemovalIdentities([legacyPending, staleEdgeAi], [incomingEdgeAi]),
    ["SE|MOMENTUM|STALE|LONG|edgeai"],
  );
});

  assert.match(manualReview.reasons.join(" "), /Momentum/);
});

import { and, eq, inArray, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

import { candidatesTable, top3SelectionSnapshotsTable } from "@workspace/db";
import { logger } from "./logger";
import {
  candidateIdentity as policyCandidateIdentity,
  effectiveCandidateInputs,
  pendingRemovalIdentities,
  synchronizedSignalSource,
} from "./candidateSynchronizationPolicy";

type CandidateInput = Record<string, unknown> & {
  market?: string | null;
  category: string;
  ticker: string;
  direction: string;
};

/**
 * A stable identity for an individual setup. Ticker alone is not enough: a
 * session can contain the same ticker in multiple categories, markets,
 * directions, or signal sources. A null source remains distinct as unknown
 * provenance; it is not inferred from a session or a later import.
 */
export function candidateIdentity(candidate: CandidateInput): string {
  return policyCandidateIdentity(candidate);
}

/** @deprecated Use deduplicateCandidates instead — no longer throws on duplicates. */
export function assertUniqueCandidateIdentities(_candidates: CandidateInput[]) {
  // kept for import compatibility; deduplication is now handled silently
}

/**
 * Remove duplicate candidates from an incoming batch, keeping the first
 * occurrence of each (market|category|ticker|direction|signalSource) identity.
 * Returns the deduplicated list and the identities that were skipped.
 */
export function deduplicateCandidates<T extends CandidateInput>(
  candidates: T[],
): { candidates: T[]; skipped: string[] } {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const result: T[] = [];
  const skipped: string[] = [];
  for (const candidate of candidates) {
    const identity = candidateIdentity(candidate);
    if (seen.has(identity)) {
      skipped.push(identity);
    } else {
      seen.add(identity);
      result.push(candidate);
    }
  }
  return { candidates: result, skipped };
}

/**
 * Merge a new import into an existing session without dropping candidates
 * from the other source. Incoming candidates come first, so an exact
 * source-aware identity match uses the latest import's values while
 * synchronization still preserves any already-recorded outcome.
 */
export function mergeCandidateInputs<T extends CandidateInput>(
  incoming: T[],
  existing: CandidateInput[],
): T[] {
  return effectiveCandidateInputs(incoming, existing);
}

/**
 * Return the pending rows that synchronizeCandidates will delete for an
 * incoming batch. Keeping this calculation beside the writer is important:
 * conflict previews must not grow a subtly different notion of "effective"
 * input from the actual force-import.
 */
export function pendingCandidatesToRemove(
  existing: CandidateInput[],
  incoming: CandidateInput[],
  selectedCandidateIds: ReadonlySet<number> = new Set(),
): CandidateDiffEntry[] {
  const removedIdentities = new Set(
    pendingRemovalIdentities(existing, incoming),
  );
  return existing
    .filter((candidate: any) =>
      !selectedCandidateIds.has(candidate.id) &&
      removedIdentities.has(candidateIdentity(candidate)),
    )
    .map(toDiffEntry);
}

/** Business fields whose changes are worth surfacing in an import diff. Fields the
 * synchronization step always preserves outcome resolution fields and
 * isTop3Pick, so they are deliberately excluded — those never change on
 * re-import. */
const DIFF_TRACKED_FIELDS = [
  "entryPrice",
  "stopPrice",
  "targetPrice",
  "rr",
  "rsi",
  "volMultiplier",
  "volumeAsOf",
  "oneR",
  "rank",
  "distFrom20dH",
  "pctB",
  "atr",
  "perf1m",
  "rs3m",
  "gapWarning",
  "earningsInDays",
  "earningsKnowledge",
  "market",
  "signalSource",
  "edgeWinRate",
  "edgeExpectancyR",
  "edgeSampleN",
  "signalAgeBars",
  "maxHoldDays",
  "signalDate",
] as const;

export type CandidateDiffEntry = {
  identity: string;
  ticker: string;
  category: string;
  direction: string;
  market: string | null;
};

export type CandidateFieldChange = CandidateDiffEntry & {
  changes: { field: string; from: unknown; to: unknown }[];
};

export type CandidateSyncDiff = {
  added: CandidateDiffEntry[];
  updated: CandidateFieldChange[];
  removed: CandidateDiffEntry[];
};

function toDiffEntry(candidate: any): CandidateDiffEntry {
  return {
    identity: candidateIdentity(candidate),
    ticker: candidate.ticker,
    category: candidate.category,
    direction: candidate.direction,
    market: candidate.market ?? null,
  };
}

function diffFields(current: any, incoming: any): { field: string; from: unknown; to: unknown }[] {
  const changes: { field: string; from: unknown; to: unknown }[] = [];
  for (const field of DIFF_TRACKED_FIELDS) {
    const from = current[field] ?? null;
    const to = incoming[field] ?? null;
    // Compare numerically-rounded values for floats so float-noise from re-fetches
    // (e.g. 102.850000001) doesn't manufacture spurious "changed" entries.
    const same =
      typeof from === "number" && typeof to === "number"
        ? Math.abs(from - to) < 0.005
        : from === to;
    if (!same) changes.push({ field, from, to });
  }
  return changes;
}

/**
 * Synchronize an imported candidate set without deleting recorded history.
 * PENDING candidates that disappear from an import are removed; resolved
 * candidates remain, so a partial upstream response cannot erase outcomes.
 *
 * Returns the final candidate list plus a diff describing exactly what this
 * import added, changed, or removed compared to what was there before.
 */
export async function synchronizeCandidates(
  tx: any,
  sessionId: number,
  incoming: CandidateInput[],
): Promise<{ candidates: any[]; diff: CandidateSyncDiff }> {
  const { candidates: deduped, skipped } = deduplicateCandidates(incoming);
  if (skipped.length > 0) logger.warn({ skipped }, "Candidate synchronization skipped duplicate identities");
  incoming = deduped;

  const selectedSnapshotRows: Array<{ candidateId: number }> = await tx
    .select({ candidateId: top3SelectionSnapshotsTable.candidateId })
    .from(top3SelectionSnapshotsTable)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(top3SelectionSnapshotsTable.sessionId, sessionId),
        eq(top3SelectionSnapshotsTable.selected, true),
      ),
    );
  const selectedCandidateIds = new Set(selectedSnapshotRows.map((row) => row.candidateId));

  const existing: any[] = await tx
    .select()
    .from(candidatesTable)
    .where(eq(candidatesTable.sessionId, sessionId));
  const existingByIdentity = new Map<string, any>(
    existing.map((candidate) => [candidateIdentity(candidate), candidate]),
  );
  const incomingIdentities = new Set(incoming.map(candidateIdentity));

  const diff: CandidateSyncDiff = { added: [], updated: [], removed: [] };

  for (const candidate of incoming) {
    const identity = candidateIdentity(candidate);
    const current = existingByIdentity.get(identity);
    const values: Record<string, unknown> = { ...candidate, sessionId };

    if (current) {
      // The signal-time selection is immutable evidence. Do not let later
      // imports rewrite either its signal/plan fields or its identity fields.
      // Outcome updates remain handled by the dedicated outcome PATCH path.
      if (selectedCandidateIds.has(current.id)) continue;

      // A known source date is immutable. Legacy NULL means unknown and must
      // remain unknown rather than being retrospectively backfilled.
      if (current.signalDate == null) {
        values.signalDate = null;
      } else if (values.signalDate !== current.signalDate) {
        throw new Error(
          `Signal date mismatch for ${current.ticker}: stored ${current.signalDate}, incoming ${String(values.signalDate ?? "unknown")}`,
        );
      }
      // A later historical re-import has no way to recreate a signal-day
      // calendar. Do not replace an already recorded signal-time observation
      // with its deliberately UNKNOWN incoming counterpart.
      if (
        values.earningsKnowledge === "UNKNOWN" &&
        current.earningsKnowledge === "SIGNAL_TIME"
      ) {
        values.earningsInDays = current.earningsInDays;
        values.earningsKnowledge = current.earningsKnowledge;
        values.earningsObservedAt = current.earningsObservedAt;
      }
      const changes = diffFields(current, values);
      if (changes.length > 0) diff.updated.push({ ...toDiffEntry(candidate), changes });

      await tx
        .update(candidatesTable)
        .set({
          ...values,
          outcome: current.outcome,
          exitPrice: current.exitPrice,
          outcomeNotes: current.outcomeNotes,
          resolutionMethod: current.resolutionMethod,
          resolutionQuality: current.resolutionQuality,
          realizedR: current.realizedR,
          resolutionEntryPrice: current.resolutionEntryPrice,
          resolutionStopPrice: current.resolutionStopPrice,
          resolutionDirection: current.resolutionDirection,
           signalSource: synchronizedSignalSource(
             values.signalSource as string | null | undefined,
             current.signalSource,
           ),
          isTop3Pick: current.isTop3Pick,
        } as any)
        .where(eq(candidatesTable.id, current.id));
    } else {
      diff.added.push(toDiffEntry(candidate));
      await tx.insert(candidatesTable).values(values as any);
    }
  }

  const stalePending = existing.filter(
    (candidate: any) =>
      candidate.outcome === "PENDING" &&
      !selectedCandidateIds.has(candidate.id) &&
      !incomingIdentities.has(candidateIdentity(candidate)),
  );
  const stalePendingIds = stalePending.map((candidate: any) => candidate.id);

  if (stalePendingIds.length > 0) {
    diff.removed = stalePending.map(toDiffEntry);
    await tx
      .delete(candidatesTable)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(candidatesTable.sessionId, sessionId),
          inArray(candidatesTable.id, stalePendingIds),
        ),
      );
  }

  const candidates = await tx
    .select()
    .from(candidatesTable)
    .where(eq(candidatesTable.sessionId, sessionId))
    .orderBy(candidatesTable.category, candidatesTable.rank);

  return { candidates, diff };
}

/** Serializes all writers for one calendar-day session across app processes. */
export async function lockScreenerSession(tx: any, date: string) {
  await tx.execute(sql`select pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(${date}))`);
}

export type CandidatePolicyInput = {
  market?: string | null;
  signalSource?: string | null;
  category: string;
  ticker: string;
  direction: string;
};

export function candidateIdentity(candidate: CandidatePolicyInput): string {
  return [
    candidate.market ?? "SE",
    candidate.category,
    candidate.ticker.trim().toUpperCase(),
    candidate.direction,
    candidate.signalSource ?? "<unknown>",
  ].join("|");
}

/** Preserve rows from markets or sources not represented by this import. */
export function effectiveCandidateInputs<T extends CandidatePolicyInput>(
  incoming: T[],
  existing: CandidatePolicyInput[],
): T[] {
  const incomingIdentities = new Set(incoming.map(candidateIdentity));
  const incomingMarkets = new Set(incoming.map((candidate) => candidate.market ?? "SE"));
  const incomingSources = new Set(incoming.map((candidate) => candidate.signalSource ?? null));
  return [
    ...incoming,
    ...existing.filter(
      (candidate) =>
        !incomingIdentities.has(candidateIdentity(candidate)) &&
        (
          !incomingMarkets.has(candidate.market ?? "SE") ||
          !incomingSources.has(candidate.signalSource ?? null)
        ),
    ),
  ] as T[];
}

export function pendingRemovalIdentities(
  existing: Array<CandidatePolicyInput & { outcome?: string }>,
  incoming: CandidatePolicyInput[],
): string[] {
  const effectiveIdentities = new Set(
    effectiveCandidateInputs(incoming, existing).map(candidateIdentity),
  );
  return existing
    .filter(
      (candidate) =>
        candidate.outcome === "PENDING" &&
        !effectiveIdentities.has(candidateIdentity(candidate)),
    )
    .map(candidateIdentity);
}

export function synchronizedSignalSource(
  incoming: string | null | undefined,
  current: string | null | undefined,
): string | null {
  return incoming ?? current ?? null;
}

export function aggregateSessionSource(
  current: string | null | undefined,
  candidateSources: Array<string | null | undefined>,
): string | null {
  if (current === "mixed") return "mixed";
  const provenances = new Set(candidateSources.filter((source): source is string => Boolean(source)));
  if (provenances.size > 1) return "mixed";
  return provenances.values().next().value ?? current ?? null;
}

export function legacySignalSourceForSession(
  sessionSource: string | null | undefined,
): string | null {
  if (sessionSource === "edgeai" || sessionSource === "telegram") return sessionSource;
  if (sessionSource == null || sessionSource === "manual" || sessionSource === "screener") {
    return "manual";
  }
  return null;
}

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import { fetchCompletedVolumeMultiplier } from "./completedVolume.ts";

type Bar = {
  date: Date;
  open: number;
  high: number;
  low: number;
  close: number;
  volume: number;
};

function day(date: string, volume: number): Bar {
  return {
    date: new Date(`${date}T00:00:00.000Z`),
    open: 10,
    high: 12,
    low: 9,
    close: 11,
    volume,
  };
}

function priorTradingDays(asOfDate: string, volumes = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, index) => (index + 1) * 100)): Bar[] {
  const bars: Bar[] = [];
  const date = new Date(`${asOfDate}T00:00:00.000Z`);
  let daysBack = 1;
  while (bars.length < volumes.length) {
    const candidate = new Date(date.getTime() - daysBack * 86_400_000);
    daysBack++;
    if (candidate.getUTCDay() === 0 || candidate.getUTCDay() === 6) continue;
    bars.unshift(day(candidate.toISOString().slice(0, 10), volumes[bars.length]));
  }
  return bars;
}

function fakeYahoo(history: unknown) {
  const calls: { ticker: string; options: { period1: Date; period2: Date; interval: "1d" } }[] = [];
  return {
    calls,
    yf: {
      historical: async (
        ticker: string,
        options: { period1: Date; period2: Date; interval: "1d" },
      ) => {
        calls.push({ ticker, options });
        return history;
      },
    },
  };
}

test("matches the exact daily bar and compares its volume with the prior ten positive bars", async () => {
  const asOfDate = "2024-03-20";
  const bars = priorTradingDays(asOfDate);
  bars.push(day(asOfDate, 550));
  bars.push(day("2024-03-21", 99_999));
  const { yf, calls } = fakeYahoo(bars);

  const result = await fetchCompletedVolumeMultiplier(yf, "ABC.ST", asOfDate, "SE");

  assert.deepEqual(result, { multiplier: 1, asOf: asOfDate });
  assert.equal(calls.length, 1);
  assert.equal(calls[0].ticker, "ABC.ST");
  assert.equal(calls[0].options.interval, "1d");
});

test("returns null if the exact as-of date is missing", async () => {
  const { yf } = fakeYahoo(priorTradingDays("2024-03-20"));
  assert.equal(await fetchCompletedVolumeMultiplier(yf, "ABC", "2024-03-20", "US"), null);
});

test("returns null when target OHLCV fields are missing, non-finite, or non-positive", async () => {
  for (const [field, value] of [
    ["open", undefined],
    ["high", Number.NaN],
    ["low", 0],
    ["close", -1],
    ["volume", Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY],
  ] as const) {
    const asOfDate = "2024-03-20";
    const target = { ...day(asOfDate, 500), [field]: value };
    const { yf } = fakeYahoo([...priorTradingDays(asOfDate), target]);
    assert.equal(await fetchCompletedVolumeMultiplier(yf, "ABC", asOfDate, "US"), null, `${field} should be rejected`);
  }
});

test("requires ten prior positive-volume bars and excludes the as-of bar from the average", async () => {
  const asOfDate = "2024-03-20";
  const insufficient = [...priorTradingDays(asOfDate, Array(9).fill(100)), day(asOfDate, 1_000)];
  const insufficientClient = fakeYahoo(insufficient);
  assert.equal(await fetchCompletedVolumeMultiplier(insufficientClient.yf, "ABC", asOfDate, "US"), null);

  const bars = [...priorTradingDays(asOfDate, Array(12).fill(100)), day(asOfDate, 300)];
  bars[1].volume = 0;
  bars[2].volume = -5;
  const { yf } = fakeYahoo(bars);
  assert.deepEqual(await fetchCompletedVolumeMultiplier(yf, "ABC", asOfDate, "US"), {
    multiplier: 3,
    asOf: asOfDate,
  });
});

test("does not count an incomplete prior daily bar in the ten-day baseline", async () => {
  const asOfDate = "2024-03-20";
  const bars = [...priorTradingDays(asOfDate), day(asOfDate, 300)];
  delete (bars[0] as Partial<Bar>).close;
  const { yf } = fakeYahoo(bars);
  assert.equal(await fetchCompletedVolumeMultiplier(yf, "ABC", asOfDate, "US"), null);
});

test("retains a positive ratio that would otherwise round to zero", async () => {
  const asOfDate = "2024-03-20";
  const bars = [...priorTradingDays(asOfDate, Array(10).fill(1_000_000)), day(asOfDate, 1)];
  const { yf } = fakeYahoo(bars);
  assert.deepEqual(await fetchCompletedVolumeMultiplier(yf, "ABC", asOfDate, "US"), {
    multiplier: 0.000001,
    asOf: asOfDate,
  });
});

test("rejects malformed dates and only applies the close buffer to the exchange's current date", async () => {
  const { yf, calls } = fakeYahoo([...priorTradingDays("2024-03-20"), day("2024-03-20", 500)]);
  assert.equal(await fetchCompletedVolumeMultiplier(yf, "ABC", "2024-02-30", "US"), null);
  assert.equal(calls.length, 0);

  const result = await fetchCompletedVolumeMultiplier(yf, "ABC", "2024-03-20", "US");
  assert.deepEqual(result, { multiplier: 0.91, asOf: "2024-03-20" });
  assert.equal(calls.length, 1);
});

test("does not request today's bar until 90 minutes after the relevant exchange close", async () => {
  for (const { market, timeZone, cutoff } of [
    { market: "SE" as const, timeZone: "Europe/Stockholm", cutoff: 19 * 60 },
    { market: "US" as const, timeZone: "America/New_York", cutoff: 17 * 60 + 30 },
  ]) {
    const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", {
      timeZone,
      year: "numeric",
      month: "2-digit",
      day: "2-digit",
      hour: "2-digit",
      minute: "2-digit",
      hourCycle: "h23",
    }).formatToParts(new Date());
    const getPart = (type: Intl.DateTimeFormatPartTypes) => parts.find((part) => part.type === type)?.value ?? "";
    const asOfDate = `${getPart("year")}-${getPart("month")}-${getPart("day")}`;
    const minuteOfDay = Number(getPart("hour")) * 60 + Number(getPart("minute"));
    const { yf, calls } = fakeYahoo([...priorTradingDays(asOfDate), day(asOfDate, 550)]);

    const result = await fetchCompletedVolumeMultiplier(yf, "ABC", asOfDate, market);

    if (minuteOfDay < cutoff) {
      assert.equal(result, null);
      assert.equal(calls.length, 0);
    } else {
      assert.deepEqual(result, { multiplier: 1, asOf: asOfDate });
      assert.equal(calls.length, 1);
    }
  }
});

FILE: artifacts/api-server/src/lib/completedVolume.ts

import { withRetry } from "./retry.ts";

type Market = "SE" | "US";

type HistoricalBar = {
  date: Date | string | number;
  open?: unknown;
  high?: unknown;
  low?: unknown;
  close?: unknown;
  volume?: unknown;
};

type YahooHistoryClient = {
  historical: (
    ticker: string,
    options: { period1: Date; period2: Date; interval: "1d" },
  ) => Promise<unknown>;
};

function formatDate(date: Date): string | null {
  if (!Number.isFinite(date.getTime())) return null;
  return [
    date.getUTCFullYear(),
    String(date.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0"),
    String(date.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, "0"),
  ].join("-");
}

function barDate(value: HistoricalBar["date"]): string | null {
  const date = value instanceof Date ? value : new Date(value);
  return formatDate(date);
}

function isCurrentSessionIncomplete(asOfDate: string, market: Market): boolean {
  const timeZone = market === "SE" ? "Europe/Stockholm" : "America/New_York";
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", {
    timeZone,
    year: "numeric",
    month: "2-digit",
    day: "2-digit",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
    hourCycle: "h23",
  }).formatToParts(new Date());
  const part = (type: Intl.DateTimeFormatPartTypes) => parts.find((item) => item.type === type)?.value ?? "";
  const today = `${part("year")}-${part("month")}-${part("day")}`;
  if (asOfDate !== today) return false;

  const localMinutes = Number(part("hour")) * 60 + Number(part("minute"));
  const cutoffMinutes = market === "SE" ? 19 * 60 : 17 * 60 + 30;
  return localMinutes < cutoffMinutes;
}

/**
 * Fetches a completed daily volume bar and compares it with the prior ten
 * positive-volume daily bars. The current session is deliberately not used.
 */
export async function fetchCompletedVolumeMultiplier(
  yf: YahooHistoryClient,
  ticker: string,
  asOfDate: string,
  market: Market,
): Promise<{ multiplier: number; asOf: string } | null> {
  if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(asOfDate)) return null;
  const asOf = new Date(`${asOfDate}T00:00:00.000Z`);
  if (formatDate(asOf) !== asOfDate || isCurrentSessionIncomplete(asOfDate, market)) return null;

  const period1 = new Date(asOf.getTime() - 30 * 86_400_000);
  const period2 = new Date(asOf.getTime() + 86_400_000);
  let history: unknown;
  try {
    history = await withRetry(() => yf.historical(ticker, { period1, period2, interval: "1d" }));
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(history)) return null;

  const bars = (history as HistoricalBar[])
    .map((bar) => ({ bar, date: bar?.date == null ? null : barDate(bar.date) }))
    .filter((entry): entry is { bar: HistoricalBar; date: string } => entry.date !== null)
    .sort((left, right) => left.date.localeCompare(right.date));
  const targetIndex = bars.findIndex((entry) => entry.date === asOfDate);
  if (targetIndex < 0) return null;

  const target = bars[targetIndex].bar;
  const targetValues = [target.open, target.high, target.low, target.close, target.volume].map(Number);
  if (targetValues.some((value) => !Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0)) return null;
  const targetVolume = targetValues[4];

  const priorVolumes = bars
    .slice(0, targetIndex)
    .map(({ bar }) => {
      const values = [bar.open, bar.high, bar.low, bar.close, bar.volume].map(Number);
      return values.every((value) => Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0) ? values[4] : null;
    })
    .filter((volume): volume is number => volume !== null)
    .slice(-10);
  if (priorVolumes.length !== 10) return null;

  const averageVolume = priorVolumes.reduce((sum, volume) => sum + volume / 10, 0);
  if (!Number.isFinite(averageVolume) || averageVolume <= 0) return null;
  const ratio = targetVolume / averageVolume;
  if (!Number.isFinite(ratio) || ratio <= 0) return null;

  const roundedRatio = Math.round(ratio * 100) / 100;
  return {
    multiplier: roundedRatio === 0 ? ratio : roundedRatio,
    asOf: asOfDate,
  };
}

FILE: artifacts/api-server/src/lib/completedVolumeBatch.ts
==============================================================================
import { fetchCompletedVolumeMultiplier } from "./completedVolume";
import { resolveYahooTicker } from "./omxs30TickerMap";
import { logger } from "./logger";

export type CompletedVolumeRequest = {
  ticker: string;
  market: "SE" | "US";
  asOfDate: string;
};

export const completedVolumeKey = ({ ticker, market, asOfDate }: CompletedVolumeRequest): string =>
  `${market}:${ticker}:${asOfDate}`;

/** Limit Yahoo history calls and never substitute a current quote for a missing daily bar. */
export async function fetchCompletedVolumeBatch(
  yf: Parameters<typeof fetchCompletedVolumeMultiplier>[0],
  requests: CompletedVolumeRequest[],
): Promise<Map<string, { multiplier: number; asOf: string }>> {
  const unique = [...new Map(requests.map((request) => [completedVolumeKey(request), request])).values()];
  const results = new Map<string, { multiplier: number; asOf: string }>();
  for (let offset = 0; offset < unique.length; offset += 8) {
    await Promise.all(unique.slice(offset, offset + 8).map(async (request) => {
      if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(request.asOfDate)) {
        logger.warn({ ticker: request.ticker, market: request.market }, "Volume source date missing");
        return;
      }
      try {
        const result = await fetchCompletedVolumeMultiplier(
          yf,
          resolveYahooTicker(request.ticker),
          request.asOfDate,
          request.market,
        );
        if (result) results.set(completedVolumeKey(request), result);
        else logger.warn({ ...request }, "Completed Yahoo daily volume unavailable");
      } catch (err: any) {
        logger.warn({ ...request, err: err.message }, "Completed Yahoo daily volume fetch failed");
      }
    }));
  }
  return results;
}

FILE: artifacts/api-server/src/lib/edgeAiMapping.ts

/**
 * Single source of truth for mapping a raw EdgeAI setup object to a candidate
 * row's fields. Used by BOTH the scheduled auto-import (scheduler.ts) and the
 * manual "Importera från EdgeAI" endpoint (routes/edgeai.ts).
 *
 * IMPORTANT: never re-implement this mapping in either caller. A rounding/type
 * mismatch between two separate copies of this logic has already caused a real
 * incident: one copy rounded `rsi` before insert (the column is an integer)
 * while the other didn't, so the daily auto-import silently rolled back its
 * transaction whenever a fractional value appeared — invisible until someone
 * checked whether a session existed for that date. Keep this the only copy.
 */
import { calculateOpeningGapPct, calculateWilderRsi } from "./marketIndicators.ts";
import { edgeAiDirection } from "./edgeAiSource.ts";

export type EdgeAiCategory = "MOMENTUM" | "SQUEEZE" | "STUDS" | "WEAKEST";
export type EdgeAiMarket = "SE" | "US";

export function mapEdgeAiCategory(
  direction: "LONG" | "SHORT",
  setupName: string,
): EdgeAiCategory {
  if (direction === "SHORT") return "WEAKEST";
  const n = setupName.toLowerCase();
  if (n.includes("squeeze") || n.includes("bollinger") || n.includes("reversion") || n.includes("mean"))
    return "SQUEEZE";
  if (n.includes("pullback") || n.includes("stud") || n.includes("reversal"))
    return "STUDS";
  return "MOMENTUM"; // breakout, momentum, flag, trend, default
}

/**
 * Maps one raw EdgeAI setup to a candidate row. `rankCounter` is a caller-owned
 * dict used to assign a 1-based rank within each `${market}:${category}` bucket
 * — pass a fresh dict per session, and the same dict across markets is safe
 * since the key already includes the market.
 */
export function mapEdgeAiSetup(
  s: any,
  market: EdgeAiMarket,
  rankCounter: Record<string, number>,
) {
  const direction = edgeAiDirection(s.dir);
  const category = mapEdgeAiCategory(direction, s.setup ?? "");
  const rankKey = `${market}:${category}`;
  rankCounter[rankKey] = (rankCounter[rankKey] ?? 0) + 1;

  const entry = Number(s.entry ?? 0);
  const stop = Number(s.stop ?? 0);
  const oneR = Math.abs(entry - stop);
  // Use EdgeAI's own calibrated target — it reflects the system's actual back-tested level.
  // Forcing a fixed R:R would reduce win rate below the system's calibration.
  const targetPrice = Number(s.target ?? 0);
  const reward = direction === "SHORT" ? entry - targetPrice : targetPrice - entry;
  const rr = oneR > 0 && reward > 0 ? reward / oneR : 0;
  // Strip .ST so resolveYahooTicker can re-add it correctly for SE stocks;
  // US tickers have no .ST so this is a no-op for them.
  const ticker = String(s.ticker ?? "").replace(/\.ST$/i, "").toUpperCase();
  // barsAgo: how many bars (trading days) ago the signal was first triggered
  const barsAgo = Number(s.barsAgo ?? 0);
  const chart = Array.isArray(s.chart) ? s.chart : [];
  const signalChart = barsAgo > 0
    ? chart.slice(0, Math.max(0, chart.length - Math.floor(barsAgo)))
    : chart;
  const signalRsi = calculateWilderRsi(signalChart.map((bar: any) => Number(bar?.c)));
  const signalGapPct = calculateOpeningGapPct(signalChart);
  const edgeWinRateRaw = Number(s.edge?.winRate ?? 0);
  const edgeWinRate = edgeWinRateRaw > 1 ? edgeWinRateRaw / 100 : edgeWinRateRaw;
  const edgeExpectancyR = Number(s.edge?.expectancyR ?? 0);
  const edgeSampleN = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(s.edge?.sample ?? 0)));
  const maxHoldDays = category === "SQUEEZE" ? 15 : category === "STUDS" ? 5 : 10;

  return {
    market,
    category,
    rank: rankCounter[rankKey],
    ticker,
    price: entry,
    rs3m: Number(s.rs ?? 0),
    // These conventional screener columns do not describe EdgeAI statistics.
    // Keep schema-required fields neutral; use the dedicated fields below.
    perf1m: 0,
    rsi: 0,
    pctB: 0,
    atr: 0,
    volMultiplier: 0, // filled only from a verified completed Yahoo daily bar
    volumeAsOf: null as string | null,
    earningsInDays: null as number | null,
    earningsKnowledge: "UNKNOWN" as "SIGNAL_TIME" | "UNKNOWN",
    earningsObservedAt: null as Date | null,
    distFrom20dH: 0,
    signalRsi,
    signalGapPct,
    edgeWinRate,
    edgeExpectancyR,
    edgeSampleN,
    signalAgeBars: Math.max(0, Math.floor(barsAgo)),
    maxHoldDays,
    gapWarning: signalGapPct != null && Math.abs(signalGapPct) >= 2.5 ? signalGapPct : null,
    direction,
    entryPrice: entry,
    stopPrice: stop,
    targetPrice,
    rr,
    oneR,
    outcome: "PENDING" as const,
  };
}

FILE: artifacts/api-server/src/lib/edgeAiSource.ts
==============================================================================
const EDGEAI_CONTENTS_API_URL =
  "https://api.github.com/repos/alexgianni777-tech/edgeai/contents/public/data.json?ref=main";
const EDGEAI_RAW_URL =
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alexgianni777-tech/edgeai/main/public/data.json";

const WARN_EDGEAI_DATA_AGE_MS = 30 * 60 * 60 * 1_000;
const MAX_EDGEAI_IMPORT_AGE_MS = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1_000;

export class EdgeAiDataFreshnessError extends Error {
  public readonly generatedAt: string | null;

  constructor(
    message: string,
    generatedAt: string | null,
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "EdgeAiDataFreshnessError";
    this.generatedAt = generatedAt;
  }
}

/**
 * raw.githubusercontent.com can keep serving yesterday's file after EdgeAI has
 * committed fresh data. Fetch the canonical repository content through GitHub's
 * API instead. The manual button may import the latest valid signal file when
 * it is older than today (for example after a weekend), while the scheduler
 * keeps the strict default and waits for today's file.
 */
export async function fetchFreshEdgeAiData(
  timeoutMs: number,
  options: { allowStale?: boolean } = {},
): Promise<any> {
  let response = await fetch(EDGEAI_CONTENTS_API_URL, {
    headers: {
      Accept: "application/vnd.github.raw+json",
      "Cache-Control": "no-cache",
      "User-Agent": "omxs30-screener",
      "X-GitHub-Api-Version": "2022-11-28",
    },
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(timeoutMs),
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    const contentsStatus = response.status;
    response = await fetch(`${EDGEAI_RAW_URL}?fallback=${Date.now()}`, {
      headers: {
        Accept: "application/json",
        "Cache-Control": "no-cache",
        "User-Agent": "omxs30-screener",
      },
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(timeoutMs),
    });
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(
        `EdgeAI fetch failed (GitHub API HTTP ${contentsStatus}, raw fallback HTTP ${response.status})`,
      );
    }
  }

  const data: any = await response.json();
  const generatedAt = typeof data?.generatedAt === "string" ? data.generatedAt : null;
  const generatedAtMs = generatedAt ? Date.parse(generatedAt) : Number.NaN;

  if (!Number.isFinite(generatedAtMs)) {
    throw new EdgeAiDataFreshnessError(
      "EdgeAI response has no valid generatedAt timestamp",
      generatedAt,
    );
  }

  const freshness = edgeAiDataFreshness(data);
  const tooFarInFuture = freshness.ageMs < -5 * 60 * 1_000;
  const tooOld = freshness.ageMs > MAX_EDGEAI_IMPORT_AGE_MS;
  const staleForStrictImport = freshness.ageMs > WARN_EDGEAI_DATA_AGE_MS || freshness.isDifferentUtcDate;
  if (tooFarInFuture || tooOld || (staleForStrictImport && !options.allowStale)) {
    const ageDescription = freshness.ageDescription;
    throw new EdgeAiDataFreshnessError(
      tooFarInFuture
        ? `EdgeAI-data har en framtida tidsstämpel (${generatedDateLabel(generatedAtMs)})`
        : tooOld
          ? `EdgeAI-data är ${ageDescription} (${generatedDateLabel(generatedAtMs)}) och för gammal för import`
          : `EdgeAI-data är ${ageDescription} (${generatedDateLabel(generatedAtMs)}) och importeras inte som dagens session`,
      generatedAt,
    );
  }

  return data;
}

function generatedDateLabel(timestamp: number): string {
  return new Date(timestamp).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

export function edgeAiDataFreshness(data: { generatedAt?: unknown }): {
  ageMs: number;
  isDifferentUtcDate: boolean;
  calendarDaysOld: number;
  ageDescription: string;
} {
  const generatedAt = typeof data.generatedAt === "string" ? data.generatedAt : "";
  const generatedAtMs = Date.parse(generatedAt);
  if (!Number.isFinite(generatedAtMs)) {
    throw new EdgeAiDataFreshnessError(
      "EdgeAI response has no valid generatedAt timestamp",
      generatedAt || null,
    );
  }

  const ageMs = Date.now() - generatedAtMs;
  const generatedDate = generatedDateLabel(generatedAtMs);
  const currentDate = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const generatedDayMs = Date.parse(`${generatedDate}T00:00:00.000Z`);
  const currentDayMs = Date.parse(`${currentDate}T00:00:00.000Z`);
  const calendarDaysOld = Math.round((currentDayMs - generatedDayMs) / 86_400_000);
  const ageDescription =
    calendarDaysOld === 0
      ? "från i dag"
      : calendarDaysOld === 1
        ? "från igår"
        : calendarDaysOld > 1
          ? `${calendarDaysOld} kalenderdagar gammal`
          : `från ${generatedDate}`;

  return {
    ageMs,
    isDifferentUtcDate: generatedDate !== currentDate,
    calendarDaysOld,
    ageDescription,
  };
}

export function edgeAiSessionDate(data: { generatedAt?: unknown }): string {
  const generatedAt = typeof data.generatedAt === "string" ? data.generatedAt : "";
  const timestamp = Date.parse(generatedAt);
  if (!Number.isFinite(timestamp)) {
    throw new EdgeAiDataFreshnessError("EdgeAI response has no valid generatedAt timestamp", generatedAt || null);
  }
  return new Date(timestamp).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

export function edgeAiDirection(value: unknown): "LONG" | "SHORT" {
  return String(value ?? "").trim().toLowerCase() === "short" ? "SHORT" : "LONG";
}

FILE: artifacts/api-server/src/lib/marketCalendar.ts

const DAY_MS = 86_400_000;

/**
 * Yahoo's earnings timestamps include a time of day. For a report calendar we
 * must compare the exchange-provided calendar dates, not round elapsed hours:
 * an after-close report at 20:00 UTC is still today's report, not tomorrow's.
 */
function utcCalendarStart(date: Date): number {
  return Date.UTC(date.getUTCFullYear(), date.getUTCMonth(), date.getUTCDate());
}

export function calendarDaysBetween(eventDate: Date, referenceDate = new Date()): number | null {
  const eventMs = eventDate.getTime();
  const referenceMs = referenceDate.getTime();
  if (!Number.isFinite(eventMs) || !Number.isFinite(referenceMs)) return null;
  return (utcCalendarStart(eventDate) - utcCalendarStart(referenceDate)) / DAY_MS;
}

export function calendarDaysUntil(
  value: Date | number | null | undefined,
  referenceDate = new Date(),
): number | null {
  if (value == null) return null;
  const eventDate = value instanceof Date ? value : new Date(value * 1_000);
  return calendarDaysBetween(eventDate, referenceDate);
}

export function utcCalendarDate(value: Date | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (!value || !Number.isFinite(value.getTime())) return null;
  return [
    value.getUTCFullYear(),
    String(value.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0"),
    String(value.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, "0"),
  ].join("-");
}

test("usable daily relative volume retains its actual ratio", () => {

    averageDailyVolume10Day: 1_000,
    averageDailyVolume3Month: 800,
  }), 0.5);
});

export type PriceBar = {
  o?: number;
  c?: number;
};

/**
 * Wilder RSI(14) with an extended warm-up. The extra bars avoid the
 * window-roll artifact where RSI moves in the opposite direction to price.
 */
export function calculateWilderRsi(closes: number[], period = 14): number | null {
  const valid = closes.filter((close) => Number.isFinite(close) && close > 0);
  if (valid.length < period * 2 + 1) return null;

  let gains = 0;
  let losses = 0;
  for (let index = 1; index <= period; index++) {
    const delta = valid[index] - valid[index - 1];
    if (delta >= 0) gains += delta;
    else losses -= delta;
  }

  let averageGain = gains / period;
  let averageLoss = losses / period;
  for (let index = period + 1; index < valid.length; index++) {
    const delta = valid[index] - valid[index - 1];
    const gain = Math.max(delta, 0);
    const loss = Math.max(-delta, 0);
    averageGain = (averageGain * (period - 1) + gain) / period;
    averageLoss = (averageLoss * (period - 1) + loss) / period;
  }

  if (averageLoss === 0) return 100;
  const relativeStrength = averageGain / averageLoss;
  return Math.round((100 - 100 / (1 + relativeStrength)) * 10) / 10;
}

/** Opening gap from the previous close to the latest bar's open. */
export function calculateOpeningGapPct(chart: PriceBar[] | undefined): number | null {
  if (!chart || chart.length < 2) return null;
  const previousClose = Number(chart.at(-2)?.c);
  const latestOpen = Number(chart.at(-1)?.o);
  if (!Number.isFinite(previousClose) || previousClose <= 0 || !Number.isFinite(latestOpen)) {
    return null;
  }
  return Math.round(((latestOpen - previousClose) / previousClose) * 100 * 1000) / 1000;
}

export function volumeMultiplierFromQuote(quote: {
  regularMarketVolume?: number | null;
  averageDailyVolume10Day?: number | null;
  averageDailyVolume3Month?: number | null;
}): number | null {
  const volume = Number(quote.regularMarketVolume ?? 0);
  const average10d = Number(quote.averageDailyVolume10Day ?? 0);
  if (average10d > 0 && volume / average10d >= 0.2) {
    return Math.round((volume / average10d) * 10) / 10;
  }
  return null;
}

FILE: artifacts/api-server/src/lib/migrate.ts
==============================================================================
import path from "node:path";
import pg from "pg";
import { drizzle } from "drizzle-orm/node-postgres";
import { migrate } from "drizzle-orm/node-postgres/migrator";
import { logger } from "./logger";

// __dirname is injected by the esbuild banner in the built output.
// Built file: <repo_root>/artifacts/api-server/dist/index.mjs
// __dirname : <repo_root>/artifacts/api-server/dist
// migrations: <repo_root>/lib/db/migrations
declare const __dirname: string;

// Arbitrary stable integer used as the PostgreSQL advisory lock key.
// This ensures that when multiple API-server instances start concurrently
// (autoscale deployments), only one runs DDL at a time; the others wait.
const MIGRATION_ADVISORY_LOCK_ID = 7_241_283_649n; // bigint fits pg_advisory_lock

/**
 * Apply all pending Drizzle migrations to the database, then return.
 *
 * Safety properties:
 *  - Uses versioned SQL files (lib/db/migrations/), not `push --force`.
 *    Every schema change is an explicit, reviewable, committed SQL file.
 *  - Serialised via a PostgreSQL session-level advisory lock: concurrent
 *    startup instances queue here and skip if already applied.
 *  - Uses a dedicated one-shot pg.Client so the lock is released the moment
 *    this function returns (client.end() releases the session lock).
 *  - Throws on failure — the caller (main()) owns process termination.
 */
export async function runMigrations(): Promise<void> {
  if (!process.env["DATABASE_URL"]) {
    logger.warn("DATABASE_URL not set — skipping migrations");
    return;
  }

  // Migrations are copied into dist/ alongside the bundle during the build
  // step (see build.mjs), so the deployable artifact is self-contained.
  // __dirname === <artifact>/dist at runtime (injected by esbuild banner).
  const migrationsFolder = path.resolve(__dirname, "./migrations");

  // Dedicated client — not the shared pool — so we control lifecycle and the
  // advisory lock is released automatically when we call client.end().
  const client = new pg.Client({
    connectionString: process.env["DATABASE_URL"],
  });

  await client.connect();

  try {
    // pg_advisory_lock(bigint) blocks until the lock is available.
    // When multiple instances start at once, they serialise here rather than
    // issuing concurrent DDL. After the first instance migrates and disconnects,
    // the second acquires the lock, finds nothing pending, and continues.
    logger.info("Acquiring migration advisory lock");
    await client.query("SELECT pg_advisory_lock($1::bigint)", [
      MIGRATION_ADVISORY_LOCK_ID.toString(),
    ]);

    logger.info({ migrationsFolder }, "Applying pending migrations");
    const db = drizzle(client);
    await migrate(db, { migrationsFolder });
    logger.info("Migrations complete — schema is up to date");
  } finally {
    // client.end() closes the connection and automatically releases all
    // session-level advisory locks held by this client.
    await client.end().catch((e: unknown) => {
      logger.warn({ err: e }, "Error closing migration client (non-fatal)");
    });
  }
}

/**
 * Maps the screener's display names to Yahoo Finance ticker symbols (.ST suffix).
 * The screener uses short company names; Yahoo Finance uses exchange tickers.
 */
export const OMXS30_TICKER_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
  // ── A ──
  ABB: "ABB.ST",
  "Alfa Laval": "ALFA.ST",
  "Atlas Copco": "ATCO-A.ST",
  Autoliv: "ALIV-SDB.ST",
  AstraZeneca: "AZN.ST",

  // ── B ──
  Boliden: "BOL.ST",

  // ── E ──
  Electrolux: "ELUX-B.ST",
  Epiroc: "EPIR-A.ST",
  Ericsson: "ERIC-B.ST",
  Essity: "ESSITY-B.ST",
  Evolution: "EVO.ST",

  // ── G ──
  Getinge: "GETI-B.ST",

  // ── H ──
  Handelsbanken: "SHB-A.ST",
  Hexagon: "HEXA-B.ST",
  "H&M": "HM-B.ST",
  Husqvarna: "HUSQ-B.ST",

  // ── I ──
  Investor: "INVE-B.ST",

  // ── K ──
  Kinnevik: "KINV-B.ST",

  // ── N ──
  Nibe: "NIBE-B.ST",
  Nordea: "NDA-SE.ST",

  // ── S ──
  Saab: "SAAB-B.ST",
  Sandvik: "SAND.ST",
  SEB: "SEB-A.ST",
  Sinch: "SINCH.ST",
  SKF: "SKF-B.ST",
  SSAB: "SSAB-B.ST",
  Swedbank: "SWED-A.ST",
  "Swedish Match": "SWMA.ST",

  // ── T ──
  Telia: "TELIA.ST",

  // ── V ──
  "Volvo": "VOLV-B.ST",
};

/**
 * Swedish base tickers that arrive stripped of .ST (e.g. from EdgeAI imports).
 * These need .ST re-added for Yahoo Finance. Tickers containing a hyphen
 * (ERIC-B, SSAB-B, etc.) are handled by the hyphen rule below.
 */
const SE_BASE_TICKERS = new Set([
  "ABB", "ALFA", "AZN", "BOL", "EVO",
  "SAND", "SINCH", "SWMA", "TELIA",
]);

/**
 * Resolve a ticker to a Yahoo Finance symbol.
 *
 * Priority order:
 *  1. Display-name map (manually pasted SE stock names like "Alfa Laval")
 *  2. Already a full Yahoo ticker ending in .ST → return as-is
 *  3. Known SE base ticker (stripped from .ST by EdgeAI import) → add .ST
 *  4. Contains a Nordic hyphen class suffix (ERIC-B, SSAB-B, NDA-SE) → add .ST
 *  5. Everything else (US stocks: AMD, ABBV, SBUX…) → return as-is
 */
export function resolveYahooTicker(screenerTicker: string): string {
  if (OMXS30_TICKER_MAP[screenerTicker]) return OMXS30_TICKER_MAP[screenerTicker];
  if (screenerTicker.endsWith(".ST")) return screenerTicker;
  if (SE_BASE_TICKERS.has(screenerTicker)) return `${screenerTicker}.ST`;
  if (screenerTicker.includes("-")) return `${screenerTicker}.ST`;
  return screenerTicker; // US or other market — use as-is
}

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";
import { calculateProductPnl, countUnderlyingDirections } from "./portfolioSemantics";

test("a rising owned Turbo S product has positive P&L without leverage multiplication", () => {
  const pnl = calculateProductPnl(10, 12, 5, "LONG", "SHORT");
  assert.deepEqual(pnl, { unrealisedKr: 10, unrealisedPct: 20 });
});

test("legacy rows with no product side retain the old direction-based P&L", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(calculateProductPnl(10, 12, 5, null, "SHORT"), {
    unrealisedKr: -10,
    unrealisedPct: -20,
  });
  assert.deepEqual(calculateProductPnl(10, 12, 5, undefined, "LONG"), {
    unrealisedKr: 10,
    unrealisedPct: 20,
  });
});

test("legacy Turbo S labels infer owned product LONG but explicit product SHORT overrides", () => {
  const legacyTurbo = calculateProductPnl(10, 12, 5, null, "SHORT", "TURBO S HEXAGON AVA 32");
  assert.deepEqual(legacyTurbo, { unrealisedKr: 10, unrealisedPct: 20 });

  const explicitShortProduct = calculateProductPnl(10, 12, 5, "SHORT", "SHORT", "TURBO S HEXAGON AVA 32");
  assert.deepEqual(explicitShortProduct, { unrealisedKr: -10, unrealisedPct: -20 });

  const ambiguousMetadata = calculateProductPnl(10, 12, 5, null, "SHORT", "Some custom instrument");
  assert.deepEqual(ambiguousMetadata, { unrealisedKr: -10, unrealisedPct: -20 });
});

test("underlying direction counts preserve unknown legacy instrument semantics", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(countUnderlyingDirections(["SHORT", "LONG", null, undefined]), {
    underlyingLongCount: 1,
    underlyingShortCount: 1,
    underlyingDirectionUnknownCount: 2,
  });
});

FILE: artifacts/api-server/src/lib/portfolioSemantics.ts

export type PositionSide = "LONG" | "SHORT";

/**
 * Legacy broker instrument labels identify leveraged products and their
 * underlying direction, while open-position rows represent held products.
 * Only infer ownership for a recognizable product label with an explicit L/S
 * marker; leave arbitrary/ambiguous instrument text unknown.
 */
export function inferOwnedLeveragedProductSide(instrument: string | null | undefined): "LONG" | null {
  return instrument && /^(?:MINI|TURBO|BULL|BEAR)\s+[LS]\s+\S+/i.test(instrument.trim())
    ? "LONG"
    : null;
}

/**
 * Product P&L follows the position held in the quoted product. Leverage is
 * metadata only; the product quote already reflects its leveraged movement.
 * Rows predating explicit productSide retain their historical direction rule.
 */
export function calculateProductPnl(
  entryPrice: number,
  livePrice: number,
  shares: number,
  productSide: PositionSide | null | undefined,
  legacyDirection: PositionSide,
  instrument?: string | null,
): { unrealisedKr: number; unrealisedPct: number } {
  const effectiveSide = productSide ?? inferOwnedLeveragedProductSide(instrument) ?? legacyDirection;
  const isShortProduct = effectiveSide === "SHORT";
  const priceDelta = isShortProduct ? entryPrice - livePrice : livePrice - entryPrice;
  return {
    unrealisedKr: priceDelta * shares,
    unrealisedPct: (priceDelta / entryPrice) * 100,
  };
}

export function countUnderlyingDirections(
  directions: Array<PositionSide | null | undefined>,
): { underlyingLongCount: number; underlyingShortCount: number; underlyingDirectionUnknownCount: number } {
  return directions.reduce(
    (counts, direction) => {
      if (direction === "LONG") counts.underlyingLongCount++;
      else if (direction === "SHORT") counts.underlyingShortCount++;
      else counts.underlyingDirectionUnknownCount++;
      return counts;
    },
    { underlyingLongCount: 0, underlyingShortCount: 0, underlyingDirectionUnknownCount: 0 },
  );
}

FILE: artifacts/api-server/src/lib/retry.ts

/**
 * Small retry helper for flaky upstream calls (Yahoo Finance quotes/history).
 * A single transient hiccup should not downgrade a whole session's market-RSI
 * to 0 or a candidate's volume to "missing" — retry a couple of times with a
 * short backoff before giving up and letting the caller fall back.
 */
export async function withRetry<T>(
  fn: () => Promise<T>,
  { attempts = 3, delayMs = 400 }: { attempts?: number; delayMs?: number } = {},
): Promise<T> {
  let lastErr: unknown;
  for (let i = 0; i < attempts; i++) {
    try {
      return await fn();
    } catch (err) {
      lastErr = err;
      if (i < attempts - 1) {
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delayMs * (i + 1)));
      }
    }
  }
  throw lastErr;
}
