/**
 * Daily EdgeAI auto-import scheduler.
 *
 * Logic:
 *  - Every 5 minutes, check if today is a weekday AND EdgeAI is not yet in today's session.
 *  - If conditions met AND Nasdaq Stockholm is open, trigger EdgeAI import.
 *  - This gracefully handles server restarts: if the server came up after
 *    09:00 Stockholm time and no session exists, it imports immediately.
 */
import { db, screenerSessionsTable, candidatesTable } from "@workspace/db";
import { and, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { logger } from "./logger";
import YahooFinance from "yahoo-finance2";
import { resolveYahooTicker } from "./omxs30TickerMap";
import {
  calculateWilderRsi,
} from "./marketIndicators";
import { completedVolumeKey, fetchCompletedVolumeBatch } from "./completedVolumeBatch";
import { edgeAiSessionDate, fetchFreshEdgeAiData } from "./edgeAiSource";
import {
  lockScreenerSession,
  mergeCandidateInputs,
  synchronizeCandidates,
} from "./candidateSynchronization";
import { aggregateSessionSource } from "./candidateSynchronizationPolicy";
import { snapshotNewSessionTop3 } from "./top3SelectionPolicy";
import { calendarDaysUntil } from "./marketCalendar";
import { mapEdgeAiSetup } from "./edgeAiMapping";
import { withRetry } from "./retry";

const yf = new YahooFinance({ suppressNotices: ["yahooSurvey", "ripHistorical"] });
const CHECK_INTERVAL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000; // 5 minutes

// Start at Nasdaq Stockholm's 09:00 local open. An IANA timezone avoids
// summer/winter time shifting the scheduler by an hour.
const STOCKHOLM_TIME = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", {
  timeZone: "Europe/Stockholm",
  weekday: "short",
  year: "numeric",
  month: "2-digit",
  day: "2-digit",
  hour: "2-digit",
  minute: "2-digit",
  hourCycle: "h23",
});

function stockholmClock(d: Date) {
  const parts = Object.fromEntries(
    STOCKHOLM_TIME.formatToParts(d).map((part) => [part.type, part.value]),
  );
  return {
    date: `${parts.year}-${parts.month}-${parts.day}`,
    weekday: parts.weekday,
    hour: Number(parts.hour),
    minute: Number(parts.minute),
  };
}

function daysUntil(date: Date | number | null | undefined): number | null {
  return calendarDaysUntil(date);
}

// In-memory status — reset on server restart
export let schedulerStatus: {
  lastChecked: string | null;
  lastImported: string | null;
  lastError: string | null;
  nextCheckAt: string | null;
} = {
  lastChecked: null,
  lastImported: null,
  lastError: null,
  nextCheckAt: null,
};

async function sessionHasEdgeAiForDate(date: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const [session] = await db
    .select({ id: screenerSessionsTable.id })
    .from(screenerSessionsTable)
    .where(eq(screenerSessionsTable.date, date));
  if (!session) return false;
  const [edgeAiCandidate] = await db
    .select({ id: candidatesTable.id })
    .from(candidatesTable)
    .where(and(
      eq(candidatesTable.sessionId, session.id),
      eq(candidatesTable.signalSource, "edgeai"),
    ))
    .limit(1);
  return Boolean(edgeAiCandidate);
}

async function fetchOmxsMarketWeather(): Promise<{
  omxsValue: number; perf5d: number; perf1m: number; perf3m: number; marketRsi: number;
}> {
  const now = new Date();
  const ninetyFiveDaysAgo = new Date(now.getTime() - 95 * 86_400_000);
  const history = await withRetry(() => yf.historical("^OMX", {
    period1: ninetyFiveDaysAgo,
    period2: now,
    interval: "1d",
  })) as Array<{ close: number }>;

  if (history.length === 0) return { omxsValue: 0, perf5d: 0, perf1m: 0, perf3m: 0, marketRsi: 0 };

  const omxsValue = history[history.length - 1].close;
  const perf5d  = history.length >= 6  ? ((omxsValue - history[history.length - 6].close)  / history[history.length - 6].close)  * 100 : 0;
  const perf1m  = history.length >= 22 ? ((omxsValue - history[history.length - 22].close) / history[history.length - 22].close) * 100 : 0;
  const perf3m  = history.length >= 64 ? ((omxsValue - history[history.length - 64].close) / history[history.length - 64].close) * 100 : 0;
  const marketRsi = calculateWilderRsi(history.map((bar) => Number(bar.close))) ?? 0;
  return { omxsValue, perf5d, perf1m, perf3m, marketRsi };
}

async function runImport(date: string): Promise<void> {
  logger.info({ date }, "[scheduler] Fetching EdgeAI data.json");

  const edgeData = await fetchFreshEdgeAiData(15_000);
  const signalDate = edgeAiSessionDate(edgeData);

  const se = edgeData?.markets?.SE;
  const seSetups: any[] = se?.setups ?? [];
  const usSetups: any[] = edgeData?.markets?.US?.setups ?? [];
  const allSetups = [...seSetups, ...usSetups];

  if (allSetups.length === 0) {
    logger.info({ date, generatedAt: edgeData.generatedAt }, "[scheduler] No setups today — skipping");
    return;
  }

  // Fetch real OMXS30 market data
  let mw = { omxsValue: 0, perf5d: 0, perf1m: 0, perf3m: 0, marketRsi: 0 };
  try {
    mw = await fetchOmxsMarketWeather();
  } catch (err: any) {
    logger.warn({ err: err.message }, "[scheduler] OMXS30 market weather fetch failed — using zeros");
  }

  const rankCounterSE: Record<string, number> = {};
  const rankCounterUS: Record<string, number> = {};
  const seMapped = seSetups.map((s) => mapEdgeAiSetup(s, "SE", rankCounterSE));
  const usMapped = usSetups.map((s) => mapEdgeAiSetup(s, "US", rankCounterUS));
  const mapped = [...seMapped, ...usMapped];
  mapped.forEach((candidate) => {
    Object.assign(candidate, { signalSource: "edgeai" as const, signalDate });
  });

  const volumeRequests = mapped.map((c) => ({
    ticker: c.ticker,
    market: c.market,
    asOfDate: String((c.market === "SE" ? se : edgeData.markets.US)?.dataAsOf ?? ""),
  }));
  const volumeMap = await fetchCompletedVolumeBatch(yf, volumeRequests);
  mapped.forEach((c, index) => {
    const request = volumeRequests[index];
    const value = request.asOfDate <= signalDate ? volumeMap.get(completedVolumeKey(request)) : null;
    if (value) {
      c.volMultiplier = value.multiplier;
      c.volumeAsOf = value.asOf;
    }
  });

  // Yahoo's current earnings calendar is usable only for today's signal.
  await Promise.allSettled(
    mapped.map(async (c) => {
      try {
        const isSignalDay = date === stockholmClock(new Date()).date && signalDate === date;
        if (isSignalDay) {
          const q = (await withRetry(() => yf.quote(resolveYahooTicker(c.ticker), {}, { validateResult: false }))) as any;
          const earningsInDays = daysUntil(q.earningsTimestamp);
          if (earningsInDays != null) {
            c.earningsInDays = earningsInDays;
            c.earningsKnowledge = "SIGNAL_TIME";
            c.earningsObservedAt = new Date();
          }
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        logger.warn({ ticker: c.ticker, err: err.message }, "[scheduler] Volume enrichment failed");
      }
    }),
  );

  try {
    await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await lockScreenerSession(tx, date);
      const [alreadyStored] = await tx
        .select({ id: screenerSessionsTable.id, source: screenerSessionsTable.source })
        .from(screenerSessionsTable)
        .where(eq(screenerSessionsTable.date, date));
      if (alreadyStored) {
        const existingCandidates = await tx
          .select()
          .from(candidatesTable)
          .where(eq(candidatesTable.sessionId, alreadyStored.id));
        const { candidates: synchronizedCandidates, diff } = await synchronizeCandidates(
          tx,
          alreadyStored.id,
          mergeCandidateInputs(
            mapped,
            existingCandidates.map(({ id, createdAt, ...candidate }) => candidate),
          ),
        );
        const source = aggregateSessionSource(
          alreadyStored.source,
          synchronizedCandidates.map((candidate) => candidate.signalSource),
        );
        await tx
          .update(screenerSessionsTable)
          .set({
            omxsValue: mw.omxsValue,
            perf5d: mw.perf5d,
            perf1m: mw.perf1m,
            perf3m: mw.perf3m,
            marketRsi: mw.marketRsi,
            trendLabel: se?.regime?.label ?? "n/a",
            edgeRegime: JSON.stringify(se?.regime ?? {}),
            edgeExpectancy: se?.edge?.expectancyR ?? null,
            edgeWinRate: se?.edge?.winRate != null
              ? (se.edge.winRate > 1 ? se.edge.winRate / 100 : se.edge.winRate)
              : null,
            edgePF: se?.edge?.profitFactor ?? null,
            edgeN: se?.edge?.n ?? null,
            source,
            lastImportDiff: diff,
            lastImportAt: new Date(),
          })
          .where(eq(screenerSessionsTable.id, alreadyStored.id));
        await snapshotNewSessionTop3(
          tx,
          { id: alreadyStored.id, date, source },
          synchronizedCandidates,
        );
        logger.info(
          { date, sessionId: alreadyStored.id, seSetups: seSetups.length, usSetups: usSetups.length },
          "[scheduler] EdgeAI merged into existing session",
        );
        return;
      }
      const [inserted] = await tx
        .insert(screenerSessionsTable)
        .values({
        date,
        omxsValue: mw.omxsValue,
        perf5d: mw.perf5d,
        perf1m: mw.perf1m,
        perf3m: mw.perf3m,
        marketRsi: mw.marketRsi,
        trendLabel: se?.regime?.label ?? "n/a",
        rawText: `EdgeAI auto-import — generatedAt ${edgeData.generatedAt}`,
        source: "edgeai",
        edgeRegime: JSON.stringify(se?.regime ?? {}),
        edgeExpectancy: se?.edge?.expectancyR ?? null,
        edgeWinRate: se?.edge?.winRate != null
          ? (se.edge.winRate > 1 ? se.edge.winRate / 100 : se.edge.winRate)
          : null,
        edgePF: se?.edge?.profitFactor ?? null,
        edgeN: se?.edge?.n ?? null,
        })
        .returning();

      const { candidates: insertedCandidates } = await synchronizeCandidates(tx, inserted.id, mapped);
      await snapshotNewSessionTop3(
        tx,
        { id: inserted.id, date, source: "edgeai" },
        insertedCandidates,
      );
      // Fresh insert: nothing existed before, so a diff would be all-"added" noise — skip it.
      logger.info(
        { date, sessionId: inserted.id, seSetups: seSetups.length, usSetups: usSetups.length, omxsValue: mw.omxsValue },
        "[scheduler] Auto-import complete",
      );
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    throw new Error(`DB insert failed: ${err.message}`);
  }
}



let tickInFlight = false;

async function tick() {
  if (tickInFlight) {
    logger.warn("[scheduler] Skipping overlapping tick");
    return;
  }
  tickInFlight = true;
  try {
  const now = new Date();
  schedulerStatus.lastChecked = now.toISOString();

  const stockholm = stockholmClock(now);
  if (stockholm.weekday === "Sat" || stockholm.weekday === "Sun") return;

  // ── Daily import (Mon–Fri from 09:00 Europe/Stockholm) ──────────────────────
  const marketIsOpen =
    stockholm.hour > 9 || (stockholm.hour === 9 && stockholm.minute >= 0);
  if (marketIsOpen) {
    const today = stockholm.date;
    if (!(await sessionHasEdgeAiForDate(today))) {
      logger.info({ today }, "[scheduler] EdgeAI missing from today's session — importing");
      try {
        await runImport(today);
        schedulerStatus.lastImported = today;
        schedulerStatus.lastError = null;
      } catch (err: any) {
        schedulerStatus.lastError = err.message ?? String(err);
        logger.warn({ err: err.message }, "[scheduler] Auto-import failed");
      }
    }
  }
  } finally {
    tickInFlight = false;
  }
}

export function startScheduler() {
  // This module is process-local, but startScheduler can be called by more
  // than one bootstrap path in tests or hot reloads. Never create two pollers.
  if (schedulerInterval) {
    logger.debug("[scheduler] Already started; ignoring duplicate start");
    return schedulerInterval;
  }
  // Run once on startup (with a short delay to let DB connect)
  setTimeout(() => tick(), 10_000);
  // Then every 5 minutes
  const interval = setInterval(tick, CHECK_INTERVAL_MS);
  schedulerInterval = interval;

  const nextCheck = new Date(Date.now() + CHECK_INTERVAL_MS);
  schedulerStatus.nextCheckAt = nextCheck.toISOString();

  logger.info("[scheduler] Started — checking EdgeAI every 5 min on weekdays from 09:00 Europe/Stockholm; imports as soon as today's data is available");
  return interval;
}

let schedulerInterval: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;

/**
 * Parses the raw screener text output into structured data.
 */

export interface ParsedMarketWeather {
  omxsValue: number;
  perf5d: number;
  perf1m: number;
  perf3m: number;
  rsi: number;
  trendLabel: string;
}

export interface ParsedCandidate {
  category: "MOMENTUM" | "SQUEEZE" | "STUDS" | "WEAKEST";
  rank: number;
  ticker: string;
  price: number;
  rs3m: number;
  perf1m: number;
  rsi: number;
  pctB: number;
  atr: number;
  volMultiplier: number;
  distFrom20dH: number;
  gapWarning: number | null;
  direction: "LONG" | "SHORT";
  entryPrice: number;
  stopPrice: number;
  targetPrice: number;
  rr: number;
  oneR: number;
}

export interface ParsedSession {
  date: string; // YYYY-MM-DD
  marketWeather: ParsedMarketWeather;
  candidates: ParsedCandidate[];
}

export class ScreenerParseError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "ScreenerParseError";
  }
}

/**
 * Telegram and chat clients sometimes replace ASCII separators with box-drawing
 * characters and collapse adjacent lines when copying a code block. Normalize
 * those presentation differences before parsing, while keeping the original
 * raw text untouched in the stored session.
 */
function normalizeScreenerText(rawText: string): string {
  return rawText
    .replace(/\r\n?/g, "\n")
    .replace(/═{2,}/g, "===")
    .replace(/(?<!\n)(?=={3,}\s*\d+\s*[·•])/g, "\n")
    .replace(/(?<!\n)(?=(?:={3,}\s*)?\d+\.\s+[A-ZÅÄÖ])/g, "\n")
    .replace(/(?<!\n)\s*(?=plan\((?:LONG|SHORT)\):)/g, "\n")
    .replace(/\n{2,}/g, "\n");
}

/**
 * Extracts the date from the screener text.
 * Looks for "SCREENER · YYYY-MM-DD" or "SCREENER · YYYY-MM-DD" or similar patterns.
 */
function parseDate(text: string): string {
  const dateMatch = text.match(/SCREENER\s*[·•]\s*(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})/);
  if (!dateMatch) {
    throw new ScreenerParseError("Could not find date in screener text (expected format: SCREENER · YYYY-MM-DD)");
  }
  return dateMatch[1];
}

/**
 * Parses the market weather line.
 * Example: "MARKNADSVÄDER  OMXS30 3305.0 | 5d    2.7% | 1m    1.8% | 3m    8.9% | RSI  79"
 */
function parseMarketWeather(text: string): ParsedMarketWeather {
  // Match the OMXS30 line
  const mwMatch = text.match(
    /OMXS30\s+([\d.]+)\s*\|\s*5d\s+([-\d.]+)%\s*\|\s*1m\s+([-\d.]+)%\s*\|\s*3m\s+([-\d.]+)%\s*\|\s*RSI\s+([\d.]+)/
  );
  if (!mwMatch) {
    throw new ScreenerParseError("Could not parse market weather line");
  }

  // Extract trend label from the arrow line (→ MEDVIND or → MOTVIND etc.)
  const trendMatch = text.match(/→\s*([A-ZÅÄÖ]+(?:\s+[A-ZÅÄÖ]+)*)/);
  const trendLabel = trendMatch ? trendMatch[1].trim() : "OKÄNT";

  return {
    omxsValue: parseFloat(mwMatch[1]),
    perf5d: parseFloat(mwMatch[2]),
    perf1m: parseFloat(mwMatch[3]),
    perf3m: parseFloat(mwMatch[4]),
    rsi: parseFloat(mwMatch[5]),
    trendLabel,
  };
}

type Category = "MOMENTUM" | "SQUEEZE" | "STUDS" | "WEAKEST";

/**
 * Parses a single candidate line and its plan line.
 * Example candidate line:
 *   "1. SSAB             102.85 | RS3m   18.5 | 1m    9.4% | RSI   57 | %B  0.90 | ATR    3.3% | vol  0.2x | ↔20dH   -0.3%"
 * Optional gap warning at end: "  ⚠ gap +3.4%"
 * Example plan line:
 *   "      plan(LONG): entry ~102.85 · stop 98.83 (1.2×ATR) · mål +1% 103.88 (R/R 0.26) · 1R 106.87"
 */
function parseCandidate(
  candidateLine: string,
  planLine: string,
  category: Category,
  rank: number
): ParsedCandidate {
  // Parse candidate data line
  // Pattern: "N. TICKER   PRICE | RS3m   X | 1m    X% | RSI   X | %B  X | ATR    X% | vol  Xx | ↔20dH   X%  [⚠ gap X%]"
  const dataMatch = candidateLine.match(
    /\d+\.\s+(.+?)\s+([\d.]+)\s*\|\s*RS3m\s+([-\d.]+)\s*\|\s*1m\s+([-\d.]+)%\s*\|\s*RSI\s+([\d.]+)\s*\|\s*%B\s+([-\d.]+)\s*\|\s*ATR\s+([\d.]+)%\s*\|\s*vol\s+([\d.]+)x\s*\|\s*\S*20dH\s+([-\d.]+)%/
  );

  if (!dataMatch) {
    throw new ScreenerParseError(`Could not parse candidate data line: "${candidateLine.trim()}"`);
  }

  const ticker = dataMatch[1].trim();
  const price = parseFloat(dataMatch[2]);
  const rs3m = parseFloat(dataMatch[3]);
  const perf1m = parseFloat(dataMatch[4]);
  const rsi = parseFloat(dataMatch[5]);
  const pctB = parseFloat(dataMatch[6]);
  const atr = parseFloat(dataMatch[7]);
  const volMultiplier = parseFloat(dataMatch[8]);
  const distFrom20dH = parseFloat(dataMatch[9]);

  // Check for gap warning
  const gapMatch = candidateLine.match(/⚠\s*gap\s*([-+][\d.]+)%/);
  const gapWarning = gapMatch ? parseFloat(gapMatch[1]) : null;

  // Parse plan line.
  // Old format: "plan(LONG): entry ~X · stop X (1.2×ATR) · mål +1% X (R/R X) · 1R X"
  // New format: "plan(LONG): entry ~X · stop X (1.2×ATR) · mål X (2×ATR, R/R X) · max N dagar"
  const planMatch = planLine.match(
    /plan\((LONG|SHORT)\):\s*entry\s*~?([\d.]+)\s*·\s*stop\s+([\d.]+)[^·]*·\s*mål\s*~?(?:[+\-\d.]+%\s*)?([\d.]+).*?R\/R\s+([\d.]+)/
  );

  if (!planMatch) {
    throw new ScreenerParseError(`Could not parse plan line: "${planLine.trim()}"`);
  }

  const direction = planMatch[1] as "LONG" | "SHORT";
  const entryPrice = parseFloat(planMatch[2]);
  const stopPrice = parseFloat(planMatch[3]);
  const targetPrice = parseFloat(planMatch[4]);
  const oneR = Math.abs(entryPrice - stopPrice);
  const reward = direction === "SHORT" ? entryPrice - targetPrice : targetPrice - entryPrice;
  const rr = oneR > 0 && reward > 0 ? reward / oneR : 0;

  return {
    category,
    rank,
    ticker,
    price,
    rs3m,
    perf1m,
    rsi,
    pctB,
    atr,
    volMultiplier,
    distFrom20dH,
    gapWarning,
    direction,
    entryPrice,
    stopPrice,
    targetPrice,
    rr,
    oneR,
  };
}

/**
 * Main parser function. Parses the full raw screener text.
 */
export function parseScreenerText(rawText: string): ParsedSession {
  const normalizedText = normalizeScreenerText(rawText);
  const date = parseDate(normalizedText);
  const marketWeather = parseMarketWeather(normalizedText);

  const candidates: ParsedCandidate[] = [];

  // Map section headers to category enums
  const sectionMap: Record<string, Category> = {
    "MOMENTUM": "MOMENTUM",
    "SQUEEZE": "SQUEEZE",
    "STUDS": "STUDS",
    "SVAGAST": "WEAKEST",
  };

  const lines = normalizedText.split("\n");
  let currentCategory: Category | null = null;

  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const line = lines[i];

    // Detect category section headers
    // Pattern: "=== N · CATEGORY — description ==="
    const sectionMatch = line.match(/===\s*\d+\s*[·•]\s*([A-ZÅÄÖ]+)/);
    if (sectionMatch) {
      const sectionKey = sectionMatch[1].toUpperCase();
      currentCategory = sectionMap[sectionKey] ?? null;
      continue;
    }

    if (!currentCategory) continue;

    // Only treat ranked, ticker-shaped entries as candidates. This avoids
    // interpreting numbered prose or headings as candidates, while catching
    // malformed data lines when they still look like a ticker row.
    const candidateLineMatch = line.match(/^\s*(\d+)\.\s+([A-ZÅÄÖ][A-ZÅÄÖ0-9.-]*)(?=\s|$)(.*)$/);
    if (candidateLineMatch) {
      const rank = parseInt(candidateLineMatch[1], 10);
      const ticker = candidateLineMatch[2];
      // Next line should be the plan line
      const planLine = lines[i + 1] ?? "";
      const looksLikeCandidate = planLine.includes("plan(")
        || candidateLineMatch[3].includes("|")
        || /\s[\d.]/.test(candidateLineMatch[3]);
      if (!looksLikeCandidate) continue; // e.g. a numbered heading or prose
      if (!planLine.includes("plan(")) {
        throw new ScreenerParseError(
          `Line ${i + 1} (${ticker}): candidate is missing its plan line`,
        );
      }

      try {
        const candidate = parseCandidate(line, planLine, currentCategory, rank);
        candidates.push(candidate);
      } catch (error) {
        const detail = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "invalid candidate";
        throw new ScreenerParseError(`Line ${i + 1} (${ticker}): ${detail}`);
      }
      i++; // skip plan line
    }
  }

  if (candidates.length === 0) {
    throw new ScreenerParseError("No candidates found in screener text. Please check the format.");
  }

  return { date, marketWeather, candidates };
}

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import { decideCandidate, reviewCandidate } from "./screeningReview.ts";

const edgeCandidate = {
  signalDate: new Intl.DateTimeFormat("sv-SE", {
    timeZone: "Europe/Stockholm", year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit",
  }).format(new Date()),
  category: "MOMENTUM",
  direction: "LONG",
  rs3m: 1,
  perf1m: 0.55,
  rsi: 50,
  edgeExpectancyR: -0.2,
  edgeSampleN: 100,
  signalAgeBars: 0,
  signalRsi: 50,
  signalGapPct: 0,
  volMultiplier: 1,
  volumeAsOf: "2026-07-10",
  earningsInDays: 10,
  earningsKnowledge: "SIGNAL_TIME" as const,
  entryPrice: 100,
  stopPrice: 95,
  targetPrice: 110,
  rr: 2,
  signalSource: "edgeai",
  price: 100,
};

test("negative EdgeAI expectancy blocks independently of conventional RSI", () => {
  const review = reviewCandidate(edgeCandidate, "edgeai");
  assert.equal(review.status, "BLOCKED");
  assert.match(review.reasons.join(" "), /Negativ historisk förväntan/);

  const decision = decideCandidate(edgeCandidate, review, edgeCandidate.signalDate);
  assert.equal(decision.status, "BLOCKED");
  assert.doesNotMatch(decision.reasons.join(" "), /RSI-data saknas/);
});

test("EdgeAI review prefers dedicated expectancy over legacy RSI compatibility", () => {
  const candidate = { ...edgeCandidate, edgeExpectancyR: 0.1, rsi: -50 };
  const review = reviewCandidate(candidate, "edgeai");
  assert.equal(review.status, "APPROVED");
  const decision = decideCandidate(
    candidate,
    review,
    candidate.signalDate,
  );
  assert.equal(decision.status, "TRADEABLE");
  assert.doesNotMatch(decision.reasons.join(" "), /RSI-data saknas/);
});

test("legacy EdgeAI expectancy in RSI remains supported when explicit field is absent", () => {
  const { edgeExpectancyR: _expectancy, ...legacyCandidate } = edgeCandidate;
  const legacy = { ...legacyCandidate, rsi: -20 };
  const review = reviewCandidate(legacy, "edgeai");
  assert.equal(review.status, "BLOCKED");
  assert.match(review.reasons.join(" "), /Negativ historisk förväntan \(-0.20R\)/);
});

test("undated legacy volume cannot qualify a trade", () => {
  const undated = { ...edgeCandidate, volumeAsOf: null };
  const review = reviewCandidate(undated, "edgeai");
  assert.equal(review.status, "BLOCKED");
  assert.match(review.reasons.join(" "), /kursdatum är inte verifierat/);
  const decision = decideCandidate(undated, review, "2026-07-11", new Date("2026-07-11T10:00:00Z"));

  assert.match(decision.reasons.join(" "), /kursdatum saknas/);
});

    { status: "WARN", reasons: ["Kontroll krävs."] },

test("stale comparison uses the Stockholm calendar date", () => {

  const justAfterMidnightStockholm = new Date("2026-07-10T22:30:00.000Z");

test("a later trading target date is stale relative to the immutable source date", () => {
  const approved = { status: "APPROVED" as const, reasons: [] };
  const nextDay = new Date(`${edgeCandidate.signalDate}T00:00:00.000Z`);
  nextDay.setUTCDate(nextDay.getUTCDate() + 1);

export type ReviewStatus = "APPROVED" | "WARN" | "BLOCKED";

export type CandidateReviewInput = {
  category: string;
  direction: string;
  rs3m: number;
  perf1m: number;
  rsi: number;
  edgeExpectancyR?: number | null;
  edgeSampleN?: number | null;
  signalAgeBars?: number | null;
  signalRsi: number | null;
  signalGapPct: number | null;
  volMultiplier: number;
  volumeAsOf?: string | null;
  earningsInDays: number | null;
  earningsKnowledge: "SIGNAL_TIME" | "UNKNOWN" | null;
  entryPrice: number;
  stopPrice: number;
  targetPrice: number;
  rr: number;
  signalSource?: string | null;
  signalDate?: string | null;
};

export type SignalReview = {
  status: ReviewStatus;
  reasons: string[];
};

export type CandidateDecisionStatus = "TRADEABLE" | "WAIT" | "BLOCKED" | "INVALID" | "STALE";

export type CandidateDecision = {
  status: CandidateDecisionStatus;
  reasons: string[];
};

const STOCKHOLM_DATE = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("sv-SE", {
  timeZone: "Europe/Stockholm",
  year: "numeric",
  month: "2-digit",
  day: "2-digit",
});

function statusFor(reasons: string[], blockers: string[]): ReviewStatus {
  if (blockers.length > 0) return "BLOCKED";
  return reasons.length > 0 ? "WARN" : "APPROVED";
}

export function reviewCandidate(
  candidate: CandidateReviewInput,
  source: string | null,
): SignalReview {
  const warnings: string[] = [];
  const blockers: string[] = [];
  const isShort = candidate.direction === "SHORT";
  const isEdgeAi = (candidate.signalSource ?? source) === "edgeai";
  // Legacy EdgeAI imports stored expectancyR * 100 in `rsi`. Keep that
  // compatibility only for EdgeAI rows; new imports use edgeExpectancyR.
  const edgeExpectancyR = candidate.edgeExpectancyR != null
    ? candidate.edgeExpectancyR
    : candidate.rsi / 100;

  if (!Number.isFinite(candidate.volMultiplier) || candidate.volMultiplier <= 0) {
    blockers.push("Volymdata saknas — ingen kvalificerad trade.");
  } else if (!candidate.volumeAsOf || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(candidate.volumeAsOf)) {
    blockers.push("Volymens avslutade kursdatum är inte verifierat — ingen kvalificerad trade.");
  } else if (candidate.volMultiplier < 0.2) {
    warnings.push(`Låg relativ volym (${candidate.volMultiplier.toFixed(1)}x).`);
  }

  if (
    !Number.isFinite(candidate.entryPrice) ||
    !Number.isFinite(candidate.stopPrice) ||
    !Number.isFinite(candidate.targetPrice) ||
    candidate.entryPrice <= 0 ||
    candidate.stopPrice <= 0 ||
    candidate.targetPrice <= 0
  ) {
    blockers.push("Ofullständig entry-, stop- eller targetdata.");
  } else if (
    (!isShort && (candidate.stopPrice >= candidate.entryPrice || candidate.targetPrice <= candidate.entryPrice)) ||
    (isShort && (candidate.stopPrice <= candidate.entryPrice || candidate.targetPrice >= candidate.entryPrice))
  ) {
    blockers.push("Tradeplanens riktning stämmer inte med entry, stop och target.");
  }

  if (candidate.rr < 1.2) blockers.push(`R:R ${candidate.rr.toFixed(2)} är under miniminivån 1,2.`);
  if (isEdgeAi && edgeExpectancyR < 0) {
    blockers.push(`Negativ historisk förväntan (${edgeExpectancyR.toFixed(2)}R).`);
  }
  if (candidate.earningsKnowledge !== "SIGNAL_TIME") {
    warnings.push("Regel 7 ej bedömbar: rapportkalender saknar verifierad signal-tidsobservation.");
  } else if (candidate.earningsInDays != null && candidate.earningsInDays >= 0 && candidate.earningsInDays <= 5) {
    blockers.push(`Rapport inom ${candidate.earningsInDays} dagar — exkluderas enligt Regel 7.`);
  }

  const targetDistance = candidate.entryPrice > 0 && candidate.targetPrice > 0
    ? Math.abs((candidate.targetPrice - candidate.entryPrice) / candidate.entryPrice) * 100
    : 0;
  if (targetDistance > 10) warnings.push(`Target ligger ${targetDistance.toFixed(1)}% från entry.`);

  if (!isEdgeAi && candidate.category === "MOMENTUM" && !isShort) {
    if (candidate.perf1m <= 0) blockers.push("Momentum saknar positiv 1-månadsutveckling.");
    if (candidate.rs3m <= 0) blockers.push("Momentum saknar positiv relativ styrka.");
  }

  if (isShort) {
    const shortRsi = isEdgeAi ? candidate.signalRsi : candidate.rsi;
    if (shortRsi != null && shortRsi > 0 && shortRsi < 35) {
      blockers.push(`Short är översåld (RSI ${shortRsi.toFixed(1)}) och stoppas.`);
    }
    if (candidate.signalGapPct != null && candidate.signalGapPct >= 2.5) {
      blockers.push(`Short har uppgap på ${candidate.signalGapPct.toFixed(1)}% och stoppas.`);
    }
    if (!isEdgeAi && candidate.rs3m > 0) {
      blockers.push("Short saknar negativ relativ styrka.");
    }
  }

  const reasons = [...blockers, ...warnings];
  return { status: statusFor(warnings, blockers), reasons };
}

/**
 * A trader-facing decision derived from the already persisted signal and its
 * review.  This deliberately does not infer whether a Yahoo request succeeded:
 * that provenance is not stored with legacy candidates.  It only reports
 * missing/invalid values that are actually present in the candidate record.
 */
export function decideCandidate(
  candidate: CandidateReviewInput & { price: number },
  review: SignalReview,
  sessionDate: string,
  now = new Date(),
): CandidateDecision {
  if (!candidate.signalDate) {
    return {
      status: "STALE",
      reasons: ["Signalen saknar verifierat källdatum — kontrollera en ny snapshot före trade.", ...review.reasons],
    };
  }
  if (sessionDate > candidate.signalDate) {
    return {
      status: "STALE",
      reasons: [`Sessionen ${sessionDate} ligger efter källsignalen ${candidate.signalDate}; ny signal krävs före trade.`, ...review.reasons],
    };
  }

  const invalid: string[] = [];
  if (!Number.isFinite(candidate.price) || candidate.price <= 0) {
    invalid.push("Screenad kurs saknas eller är ogiltig.");
  }
  if (!Number.isFinite(candidate.volMultiplier) || candidate.volMultiplier <= 0) {
    invalid.push("Volymdata saknas eller är ogiltig.");
  } else if (!candidate.volumeAsOf || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(candidate.volumeAsOf) || candidate.volumeAsOf > candidate.signalDate) {
    invalid.push("Volymens avslutade kursdatum saknas eller är ogiltigt.");
  }
  const isEdgeAi = (candidate.signalSource ?? null) === "edgeai";
  if (isEdgeAi) {
    const edgeExpectancyR = candidate.edgeExpectancyR != null
      ? candidate.edgeExpectancyR
      : candidate.rsi / 100;
    if (!Number.isFinite(edgeExpectancyR)) {
      invalid.push("Historisk EdgeAI-förväntan saknas eller är ogiltig.");
    }
  } else if (!Number.isFinite(candidate.rsi) || candidate.rsi < 0) {
    invalid.push("RSI-data saknas eller är ogiltig.");
  }
  if (!Number.isFinite(candidate.rr) || candidate.rr <= 0) {
    invalid.push("R:R saknas eller är ogiltig.");
  }
  if (
    !Number.isFinite(candidate.entryPrice) || candidate.entryPrice <= 0 ||
    !Number.isFinite(candidate.stopPrice) || candidate.stopPrice <= 0 ||
    !Number.isFinite(candidate.targetPrice) || candidate.targetPrice <= 0
  ) {
    invalid.push("Entry-, stop- eller targetdata saknas eller är ogiltig.");
  }
  if (invalid.length > 0) return { status: "INVALID", reasons: [...invalid, ...review.reasons] };

  const today = STOCKHOLM_DATE.format(now);
  if (candidate.signalDate < today || sessionDate < today) {
    return {
      status: "STALE",
      reasons: [`Signalen är från ${candidate.signalDate}; kontrollera en ny snapshot och live-pris före trade.`, ...review.reasons],
    };
  }
  if (review.status === "BLOCKED") return { status: "BLOCKED", reasons: review.reasons };
  if (review.status === "WARN") return { status: "WAIT", reasons: review.reasons };
  return {
    status: "TRADEABLE",
    reasons: ["Screeningsreglerna är godkända för dagens signal."],
  };
}

export function reviewSession(
  candidateReviews: SignalReview[],
  marketRsi: number,
): SignalReview & { tradableCount: number } {
  const tradableCount = candidateReviews.filter((review) => review.status === "APPROVED").length;
  const reasons: string[] = [];
  if (!Number.isFinite(marketRsi) || marketRsi <= 0) {
    reasons.push("Marknads-RSI saknas — marknadsregimen är inte fullt verifierad.");
  }
  if (tradableCount === 0) reasons.unshift("Ingen kvalificerad trade idag.");

  return {
    status: tradableCount === 0 ? "BLOCKED" : reasons.length > 0 ? "WARN" : "APPROVED",
    reasons,
    tradableCount,
  };
}

FILE: artifacts/api-server/src/lib/sessionWriteSerialization.test.ts

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import { afterSessionWriteLock } from "./sessionWriteSerialization.ts";

test("concurrent session writers cannot read or write before their advisory lock", async () => {
  const events: string[] = [];
  const state = {
    outcome: "PENDING",
    realizedR: null as number | null,
    resolutionEntryPrice: null as number | null,
    resolutionStopPrice: null as number | null,
    linkedPnlKr: null as number | null,
  };
  let releaseFirst!: () => void;
  let signalFirstRead!: () => void;
  let firstHoldsLock = false;
  const firstReleased = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { releaseFirst = resolve; });
  const firstRead = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { signalFirstRead = resolve; });

  const first = afterSessionWriteLock(
    async () => {
      events.push("first:lock");
      firstHoldsLock = true;
    },
    async () => {
      events.push("first:read");
      signalFirstRead();
      await firstReleased;
      events.push("first:write");
      Object.assign(state, {
        outcome: "WIN",
        realizedR: 2,
        resolutionEntryPrice: 100,
        resolutionStopPrice: 95,
        linkedPnlKr: 1_000,
      });
      firstHoldsLock = false;
    },
  );

  await firstRead;
  const second = afterSessionWriteLock(
    async () => {
      events.push("second:lock-request");
      while (firstHoldsLock) await new Promise((resolve) => setImmediate(resolve));
      events.push("second:lock");
    },
    async () => {
      events.push("second:read");
      const lockedCurrent = { ...state };
      // Mirrors synchronization: imports may update plan fields, but preserve
      // the freshly re-read resolution and linked financial result.
      Object.assign(state, lockedCurrent);
      events.push("second:write");
    },
  );

  await new Promise((resolve) => setImmediate(resolve));
  const beforeRelease = [...events];
  releaseFirst();
  await Promise.all([first, second]);
  assert.deepEqual(beforeRelease, ["first:lock", "first:read", "second:lock-request"]);
  assert.deepEqual(events, [
    "first:lock",
    "first:read",
    "second:lock-request",
    "first:write",
    "second:lock",
    "second:read",
    "second:write",
  ]);
  assert.deepEqual(state, {
    outcome: "WIN",
    realizedR: 2,
    resolutionEntryPrice: 100,
    resolutionStopPrice: 95,
    linkedPnlKr: 1_000,
  });
});

/**
 * Keep the lock acquisition structurally ahead of every authoritative read or
 * write in a session-scoped candidate mutation. The injected acquire function
 * makes the ordering deterministic to regression-test without a live database.
 */
export async function afterSessionWriteLock<T>(
  acquire: () => Promise<void>,
  writer: () => Promise<T>,
): Promise<T> {
  await acquire();
  return writer();
}

function candidate(

    stopPrice: isShort ? 105 : 95,

function currentStockholmDate() {
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", {
    timeZone: "Europe/Stockholm",
    year: "numeric",
    month: "2-digit",
    day: "2-digit",
  }).formatToParts(new Date());
  const values = Object.fromEntries(parts.map((part) => [part.type, part.value]));
  return `${values.year}-${values.month}-${values.day}`;
}

    candidate(7, "SHORT3", "SHORT"),

    sessionDate,
    null,
    now,
  );

  assert.equal(selected.filter((row) => row.market === "SE" && row.direction === "SHORT").length, 3);

  assert.equal(rows.find((row) => row.candidateId === 10)?.selected, false);

FILE: artifacts/api-server/src/lib/top3SelectionPolicy.ts

import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { screenerSessionsTable, top3SelectionSnapshotsTable } from "@workspace/db";
import {
  buildTop3SelectionSnapshot,
  TOP3_POLICY_VERSION,
  type PolicyCandidate,
} from "./top3SelectionPolicyCore";

export { buildTop3SelectionSnapshot, TOP3_POLICY_VERSION, TOP3_SELECTION_TYPE } from "./top3SelectionPolicyCore";

/**
 * Called only inside the creating import's existing per-session transaction
 * and advisory lock. The session timestamp is the manifest, so an empty
 * candidate set is still a completed snapshot and can never be filled in by a
 * later import.
 */
export async function snapshotNewSessionTop3(
  tx: any,
  session: { id: number; date: string; source: string | null },
  candidates: PolicyCandidate[],
): Promise<void> {
  const stockholmDate = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("sv-SE", {
    timeZone: "Europe/Stockholm",
    year: "numeric",
    month: "2-digit",
    day: "2-digit",
  }).format(new Date());
  // A retrospective import is not point-in-time evidence. Leave the session
  // unsealed so a later real same-day source import can establish a snapshot.
  if (session.date !== stockholmDate) return;
  const knownSignalCandidates = candidates.filter(
    (candidate) => candidate.signalDate === session.date && Boolean(candidate.signalSource),
  );
  if (knownSignalCandidates.length === 0) return;

  const [storedSession] = await tx
    .select({ top3SnapshotAt: screenerSessionsTable.top3SnapshotAt })
    .from(screenerSessionsTable)
    .where(eq(screenerSessionsTable.id, session.id));
  if (!storedSession || storedSession.top3SnapshotAt) return;

  const selectedAt = new Date();
  const rows = buildTop3SelectionSnapshot(
    knownSignalCandidates,
    session.id,
    session.date,
    session.source,
    selectedAt,
  );
  if (rows.length > 0) await tx.insert(top3SelectionSnapshotsTable).values(rows);
  await tx
    .update(screenerSessionsTable)
    .set({ top3SnapshotAt: selectedAt, top3PolicyVersion: TOP3_POLICY_VERSION })
    .where(eq(screenerSessionsTable.id, session.id));
}

FILE: artifacts/api-server/src/lib/top3SelectionPolicyCore.ts

import { candidateSelectionScore, selectSourceBalancedCandidates } from "./candidateRanking.ts";
import { decideCandidate, reviewCandidate } from "./screeningReview.ts";

export const TOP3_POLICY_VERSION = "official-top3-v1";
export const TOP3_SELECTION_TYPE = "AUTO";

export type PolicyCandidate = {
  id: number;
  ticker: string;
  category: string;
  rank: number;
  market: "SE" | "US" | null;
  direction: "LONG" | "SHORT";
  signalSource: "edgeai" | "telegram" | "manual" | "screener" | null;
  signalDate: string | null;
  price: number;
  perf1m: number;
  rs3m: number;
  rsi: number;
  pctB: number;
  distFrom20dH: number;
  edgeExpectancyR: number | null;
  edgeSampleN: number | null;
  signalAgeBars: number | null;
  maxHoldDays: number | null;
  signalRsi: number | null;
  signalGapPct: number | null;
  volMultiplier: number;
  volumeAsOf: string | null;
  earningsInDays: number | null;
  earningsKnowledge: "SIGNAL_TIME" | "UNKNOWN" | null;
  entryPrice: number;
  stopPrice: number;
  targetPrice: number;
  rr: number;
};

export type SnapshotInput = {
  sessionId: number;
  candidateId: number;
  ticker: string;
  category: string;
  selected: boolean;
  rank: number | null;
  score: number;
  review: { status: string; reasons: string[] };
  decision: { status: string; reasons: string[] };
  earningsWarning: boolean;
  policyVersion: string;
  selectedAt: Date;
  type: string;
  market: "SE" | "US" | null;
  direction: "LONG" | "SHORT";
  source: "edgeai" | "telegram" | "manual" | "screener" | null;
};

function tickerConflictKey(ticker: string): string {
  return ticker.trim().toUpperCase().replace(/\.ST$/, "");
}

/** Build a frozen signal-time selection; user stars are annotations only. */
export function buildTop3SelectionSnapshot(
  candidates: PolicyCandidate[],
  sessionId: number,
  sessionDate: string,
  sessionSource: string | null,
  selectedAt = new Date(),
): SnapshotInput[] {
  const evaluated = candidates.map((candidate) => {
    const review = reviewCandidate(candidate, sessionSource);
    const decision = decideCandidate(candidate, review, sessionDate, selectedAt);
    const rawScore = candidateSelectionScore(candidate);
    return {
      candidate,
      review,
      decision,
      score: Number.isFinite(rawScore) ? Number(rawScore.toFixed(6)) : 0,
    };
  });

  const eligible = evaluated.filter(({ decision, candidate }) =>
    decision.status === "TRADEABLE" &&
    candidate.signalDate === sessionDate &&
    Boolean(candidate.signalSource) &&
    (candidate.market === "SE" || candidate.market === "US"),
  );
  const selectedIds = new Set<number>();
  const selectedTickerDirection = new Map<string, "LONG" | "SHORT">();

  // Group order is policy-versioned and resolves opposing signals consistently.
  for (const market of ["SE", "US"] as const) {
    for (const direction of ["LONG", "SHORT"] as const) {
      const pool = eligible
        .filter(({ candidate }) => candidate.market === market && candidate.direction === direction)
        .map(({ candidate }) => candidate);
      const ranked = selectSourceBalancedCandidates(pool, pool.length);
      const seenGroupTickers = new Set<string>();
      let groupSelected = 0;
      for (const candidate of ranked) {
        const key = tickerConflictKey(candidate.ticker);
        const priorDirection = selectedTickerDirection.get(key);
        if (seenGroupTickers.has(key) || (priorDirection && priorDirection !== direction)) continue;
        seenGroupTickers.add(key);
        selectedIds.add(candidate.id);
        if (!priorDirection) selectedTickerDirection.set(key, direction);
        groupSelected++;
        if (groupSelected === 3) break;
      }
    }
  }

  const eligibleRanks = new Map<number, number>();
  for (const market of ["SE", "US"] as const) {
    for (const direction of ["LONG", "SHORT"] as const) {
      const pool = eligible
        .filter(({ candidate }) => candidate.market === market && candidate.direction === direction)
        .map(({ candidate }) => candidate);
      selectSourceBalancedCandidates(pool, pool.length)
        .forEach((candidate, index) => eligibleRanks.set(candidate.id, index + 1));
    }
  }

  return evaluated.map(({ candidate, review, decision, score }) => ({
    sessionId,
    candidateId: candidate.id,
    ticker: candidate.ticker,
    category: candidate.category,
    selected: selectedIds.has(candidate.id),
    rank: eligibleRanks.get(candidate.id) ?? null,
    score,
    review,
    decision,
    earningsWarning: candidate.earningsKnowledge === "SIGNAL_TIME" &&
      candidate.earningsInDays != null && candidate.earningsInDays >= 0 && candidate.earningsInDays <= 5,
    policyVersion: TOP3_POLICY_VERSION,
    selectedAt,
    type: TOP3_SELECTION_TYPE,
    market: candidate.market,
    direction: candidate.direction,
    source: candidate.signalSource,
  }));
}

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";
import { snapshotNewSessionTop3 } from "./top3SelectionPolicy.ts";

function stockholmDate() {
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", {
    timeZone: "Europe/Stockholm",
    year: "numeric",
    month: "2-digit",
    day: "2-digit",
  }).formatToParts(new Date());
  const values = Object.fromEntries(parts.map((part) => [part.type, part.value]));
  return `${values.year}-${values.month}-${values.day}`;
}

function priorDate(date: string) {
  const value = new Date(`${date}T12:00:00.000Z`);
  value.setUTCDate(value.getUTCDate() - 1);
  return value.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

function candidate(id: number, ticker: string, signalDate: string, signalSource: "manual" | "telegram") {
  return {
    id,
    ticker,
    category: "MOMENTUM",
    rank: id,
    market: "SE",
    direction: "LONG",
    signalSource,
    signalDate,
    price: 100,
    perf1m: 2,
    rs3m: 3,
    rsi: 50,
    pctB: 0.5,
    distFrom20dH: 1,
    edgeExpectancyR: null,
    edgeSampleN: null,
    signalAgeBars: null,
    maxHoldDays: 10,
    signalRsi: null,
    signalGapPct: null,
    volMultiplier: 1,
    volumeAsOf: "2020-01-01",
    earningsInDays: 30,
    earningsKnowledge: "SIGNAL_TIME",
    entryPrice: 100,
    stopPrice: 95,
    targetPrice: 106,
    rr: 1.2,
  };
}

function transaction() {
  let manifest: Date | null = null;
  const inserted: any[] = [];
  return {
    inserted,
    getManifest: () => manifest,
    select: () => ({
      from: () => ({
        where: async () => [{ top3SnapshotAt: manifest }],
      }),
    }),
    insert: () => ({
      values: async (rows: any[]) => {
        inserted.push(...rows);
      },
    }),
    update: () => ({
      set: (values: { top3SnapshotAt?: Date }) => ({
        where: async () => {
          if (values.top3SnapshotAt) manifest = values.top3SnapshotAt;
        },
      }),
    }),
  };
}

test("old manual signal leaves session unsealed; same-day import seals once and reimports cannot rewrite it", async () => {
  const date = stockholmDate();
  const tx = transaction();
  const session = { id: 900, date, source: "manual" };
  const oldManual = candidate(1, "OLD", priorDate(date), "manual");

  await snapshotNewSessionTop3(tx as any, session, [oldManual] as any);
  assert.equal(tx.getManifest(), null);
  assert.equal(tx.inserted.length, 0);

  const freshTelegram = candidate(2, "FRESH", date, "telegram");
  await snapshotNewSessionTop3(tx as any, { ...session, source: "telegram" }, [oldManual, freshTelegram] as any);

  const manifestAfterSignal = tx.getManifest();
  assert.ok(manifestAfterSignal instanceof Date);
  assert.deepEqual(tx.inserted.map((row) => row.candidateId), [2]);
  assert.equal(tx.inserted[0].selected, true);
  const frozenRows = structuredClone(tx.inserted);
  const frozenManifest = manifestAfterSignal?.getTime();

  await snapshotNewSessionTop3(
    tx as any,
    { ...session, source: "manual" },
    [oldManual, { ...freshTelegram, perf1m: -50, signalSource: "manual" }] as any,
  );

  assert.deepEqual(tx.inserted, frozenRows);
  assert.equal(tx.getManifest()?.getTime(), frozenManifest);
});

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import { resolveTradePerformance, type TradePerformanceInput } from "./tradePerformance.ts";

const trade = (overrides: Partial<TradePerformanceInput> = {}): TradePerformanceInput => ({
  outcome: "TIME_EXIT",
  realizedR: null,
  exitPrice: null,
  entryPrice: 100,
  stopPrice: 90,
  direction: "LONG",
  resolutionEntryPrice: null,
  resolutionStopPrice: null,
  resolutionDirection: null,
  ...overrides,
});

test("TIME_EXIT classifies positive, negative, and zero realized R by sign", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(resolveTradePerformance(trade({ realizedR: 1.25 })), { r: 1.25, result: "WIN" });
  assert.deepEqual(resolveTradePerformance(trade({ realizedR: -0.5 })), { r: -0.5, result: "LOSS" });
  assert.deepEqual(resolveTradePerformance(trade({ realizedR: 0 })), { r: 0, result: "FLAT" });
});

test("persisted realized R is usable without an exit price", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(
    resolveTradePerformance(trade({ outcome: "WIN", realizedR: 0.75 })),
    { r: 0.75, result: "WIN" },
  );
});

test("WIN and LOSS with malformed realized-R signs are excluded", () => {
  assert.equal(resolveTradePerformance(trade({ outcome: "WIN", realizedR: -1 })), null);
  assert.equal(resolveTradePerformance(trade({ outcome: "LOSS", realizedR: 0 })), null);
});

test("legacy exits are calculated using saved resolution levels and direction", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(
    resolveTradePerformance(trade({
      outcome: "LOSS",
      exitPrice: 105,
      resolutionEntryPrice: 100,
      resolutionStopPrice: 110,
      resolutionDirection: "SHORT",
    })),
    { r: -0.5, result: "LOSS" },
  );
});

test("saved resolution levels remain usable when current plan prices are missing", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(
    resolveTradePerformance(trade({
      outcome: "WIN",
      exitPrice: 110,
      entryPrice: null,
      stopPrice: null,
      resolutionEntryPrice: 100,
      resolutionStopPrice: 90,
      resolutionDirection: "LONG",
    })),
    { r: 1, result: "WIN" },
  );
});

test("legacy outcomes without a reconstructable exit and risk unit stay unresolved", () => {
  assert.equal(resolveTradePerformance(trade({ outcome: "WIN" })), null);
  assert.equal(resolveTradePerformance(trade({ exitPrice: 100, stopPrice: 100 })), null);
});

export type PerformanceResult = "WIN" | "LOSS" | "FLAT";

export interface TradePerformanceInput {
  outcome: string | null;
  realizedR: number | null;
  exitPrice: number | null;
  entryPrice: number | null;
  stopPrice: number | null;
  direction: string | null;
  resolutionEntryPrice: number | null;
  resolutionStopPrice: number | null;
  resolutionDirection: string | null;
}

export interface TradePerformance {
  r: number;
  result: PerformanceResult;
}

/**
 * Resolve the authoritative realized R and classify it by signed outcome.
 * Persisted R is sufficient by itself; legacy rows require an exit and a
 * usable risk unit. WIN/LOSS labels whose R sign disagrees are not performance.
 */
export function resolveTradePerformance(
  trade: TradePerformanceInput,
): TradePerformance | null {
  let r: number | null = null;

  if (trade.realizedR != null) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(trade.realizedR)) return null;
    r = trade.realizedR;
  } else if (
    trade.exitPrice != null &&
    Number.isFinite(trade.exitPrice)
  ) {
    const entry = trade.resolutionEntryPrice ?? trade.entryPrice;
    const stop = trade.resolutionStopPrice ?? trade.stopPrice;
    const direction = trade.resolutionDirection ?? trade.direction;
    if (
      entry != null &&
      stop != null &&
      Number.isFinite(entry) &&
      Number.isFinite(stop) &&
      entry !== stop &&
      (direction === "LONG" || direction === "SHORT")
    ) {
      const oneR = Math.abs(entry - stop);
      r = direction === "LONG"
        ? (trade.exitPrice - entry) / oneR
        : (entry - trade.exitPrice) / oneR;
    }
  }

  if (r == null || !Number.isFinite(r)) return null;
  if (trade.outcome === "WIN") return r > 0 ? { r, result: "WIN" } : null;
  if (trade.outcome === "LOSS") return r < 0 ? { r, result: "LOSS" } : null;
  if (trade.outcome === "TIME_EXIT") {
    return { r, result: r > 0 ? "WIN" : r < 0 ? "LOSS" : "FLAT" };
  }
  return null;
}

FILE: artifacts/api-server/src/middlewares/authMiddleware.ts

import type { AuthUser } from '@workspace/api-zod';
import { type NextFunction, type Request, type Response } from 'express';
import * as oidc from 'openid-client';

import {
  clearSession,
  getOidcConfig,
  getSession,
  getSessionId,
  updateSession,
  type SessionData,
} from '../lib/auth';
import { logger } from '../lib/logger';

declare global {
  namespace Express {
    interface User extends AuthUser {}

    interface Request {
      isAuthenticated(): this is AuthedRequest;

      user?: User | undefined;
    }

    export interface AuthedRequest {
      user: User;
    }
  }
}

async function refreshIfExpired(
  sid: string,
  session: SessionData,
): Promise<SessionData | null> {
  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  if (!session.expires_at || now <= session.expires_at) return session;

  if (!session.refresh_token) return null;

  try {
    const config = await getOidcConfig();
    const tokens = await oidc.refreshTokenGrant(config, session.refresh_token);
    session.access_token = tokens.access_token;
    session.refresh_token = tokens.refresh_token ?? session.refresh_token;
    session.expires_at = tokens.expiresIn()
      ? now + tokens.expiresIn()!
      : session.expires_at;
    await updateSession(sid, session);
    return session;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export async function authMiddleware(
  req: Request,
  res: Response,
  next: NextFunction,
) {
  req.isAuthenticated = function (this: Request) {
    return this.user != null;
  } as Request['isAuthenticated'];

  const sid = getSessionId(req);
  if (!sid) {
    next();
    return;
  }

  try {
    const session = await getSession(sid);
    if (!session?.user?.id) {
      await clearSession(res, sid);
      next();
      return;
    }

    const refreshed = await refreshIfExpired(sid, session);
    if (!refreshed) {
      await clearSession(res, sid);
      next();
      return;
    }

    req.user = refreshed.user;
  } catch {
    // DB/session error — treat as unauthenticated, don't crash the request
  }

  next();
}

/** Require a valid browser or mobile session after authMiddleware has hydrated req.user. */
export function requireAuthentication(
  req: Request,
  res: Response,
  next: NextFunction,
) {
  if (!req.isAuthenticated()) {
    res.status(401).json({ error: "Authentication required" });
    return;
  }
  next();
}

/**
 * Trading data is private. The Repl owner is always the bootstrap administrator;
 * optional allowlists make it possible to grant a second explicitly approved
 * account access without turning ordinary login into authorization.
 */
export function requireAdministrator(
  req: Request,
  res: Response,
  next: NextFunction,
) {
  if (!req.isAuthenticated()) {
    res.status(401).json({ error: "Authentication required" });
    return;
  }

  if (isAdministrator(req.user)) {
    next();
    return;
  }

  logger.warn({ userId: req.user.id }, "Denied trading-data access for non-admin user");
  res.status(403).json({ error: "This account is not approved to access trading data" });
}

export function isAdministrator(user: Express.User): boolean {
  const allowedIds = new Set(
    [
      process.env.REPL_OWNER_ID,
      process.env.REPL_USERID,
      ...(process.env.ADMIN_USER_IDS ?? "").split(","),
    ]
      .map((value) => value?.trim())
      .filter((value): value is string => Boolean(value)),
  );
  const allowedEmails = new Set(
    (process.env.ADMIN_EMAILS ?? "")
      .split(",")
      .map((value) => value.trim().toLowerCase())
      .filter(Boolean),
  );
  const email = user.email?.trim().toLowerCase();

  return allowedIds.has(user.id) || Boolean(email && allowedEmails.has(email));
}

/**
 * Official Top 3 performance from immutable signal-time selection snapshots.
 * Legacy sessions without snapshots are returned as unavailable and are never
 * selected, ranked, or backfilled from their current candidate fields.
 */
import { Router, type IRouter } from "express";
import { asc } from "drizzle-orm";
import {
  db,
  screenerSessionsTable,
  candidatesTable,
  top3SelectionSnapshotsTable,
} from "@workspace/db";
import { resolveTradePerformance } from "../lib/tradePerformance.ts";

const router: IRouter = Router();

router.get("/screener/analytics/top3", async (_req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const sessions = await db
    .select({
      id: screenerSessionsTable.id,
      date: screenerSessionsTable.date,
      source: screenerSessionsTable.source,
      edgeWinRate: screenerSessionsTable.edgeWinRate,
      snapshotAt: screenerSessionsTable.top3SnapshotAt,
      policyVersion: screenerSessionsTable.top3PolicyVersion,
    })
    .from(screenerSessionsTable)
    .orderBy(asc(screenerSessionsTable.date));

  if (sessions.length === 0) {
    res.json({ sessions: [], stats: emptyStats() });
    return;
  }

  const [allCandidates, allSnapshots] = await Promise.all([
    db.select().from(candidatesTable),
    db.select().from(top3SelectionSnapshotsTable)
      .orderBy(
        asc(top3SelectionSnapshotsTable.sessionId),
        asc(top3SelectionSnapshotsTable.market),
        asc(top3SelectionSnapshotsTable.direction),
        asc(top3SelectionSnapshotsTable.rank),
      ),
  ]);
  const candidateById = new Map(allCandidates.map((candidate) => [candidate.id, candidate]));
  const snapshotsBySession = new Map<number, typeof allSnapshots>();
  for (const snapshot of allSnapshots) {
    const group = snapshotsBySession.get(snapshot.sessionId) ?? [];
    group.push(snapshot);
    snapshotsBySession.set(snapshot.sessionId, group);
  }

  let cumulativeR = 0;
  let totalTrades = 0;
  let wins = 0;
  let losses = 0;
  const byDirection = {
    LONG: { totalTrades: 0, wins: 0, losses: 0, totalR: 0 },
    SHORT: { totalTrades: 0, wins: 0, losses: 0, totalR: 0 },
  };

  const sessionResults = sessions.map((session) => {
    const snapshots = session.snapshotAt
      ? (snapshotsBySession.get(session.id) ?? []).filter((snapshot) => snapshot.selected)
      : [];
    const mapPick = (snapshot: (typeof allSnapshots)[number]) => {
      const candidate = candidateById.get(snapshot.candidateId);
      const performance = candidate ? resolveTradePerformance(candidate) : null;
      const direction = snapshot.direction === "SHORT" ? "SHORT" : "LONG";
      if (performance) {
        totalTrades++;
        cumulativeR += performance.r;
        const bucket = byDirection[direction];
        bucket.totalTrades++;
        bucket.totalR += performance.r;
        if (performance.result === "WIN") {
          wins++;
          bucket.wins++;
        } else if (performance.result === "LOSS") {
          losses++;
          bucket.losses++;
        }
      }
      return {
        candidateId: snapshot.candidateId,
        ticker: snapshot.ticker,
        category: snapshot.category,
        market: snapshot.market,
        direction: snapshot.direction,
        signalSource: snapshot.source ?? null,
        edgeScore: snapshot.score,
        rank: snapshot.rank,
        type: snapshot.type,
        policyVersion: snapshot.policyVersion,
        selectedAt: snapshot.selectedAt,
        review: snapshot.review,
        decision: snapshot.decision,
        earningsWarning: snapshot.earningsWarning,
        outcome: candidate?.outcome ?? "PENDING",
        r: performance?.r ?? null,
      };
    };

    let sessionR = 0;
    const picks = snapshots.map((snapshot) => {
      const pick = mapPick(snapshot);
      if (pick.r != null) sessionR += pick.r;
      return pick;
    });
    const sessionHasResolved = picks.some((pick) => pick.r != null);
    return {
      date: session.date,
      sessionId: session.id,
      source: session.source ?? null,
      selectionStatus: session.snapshotAt ? "AVAILABLE" : "UNAVAILABLE",
      selectionUnavailableReason: session.snapshotAt ? null : "No signal-time Top 3 snapshot was recorded for this legacy session.",
      selectedAt: session.snapshotAt,
      policyVersion: session.policyVersion,
      picks,
      longPicks: picks.filter((pick) => pick.direction === "LONG"),
      shortPicks: picks.filter((pick) => pick.direction === "SHORT"),
      edgeWinRate: session.edgeWinRate ?? null,
      sessionR: sessionHasResolved ? sessionR : null,
      cumulativeR,
    };
  });

  const winRate = totalTrades > 0 ? wins / totalTrades : null;
  const avgRPerTrade = totalTrades > 0 ? cumulativeR / totalTrades : null;
  const summarizeDirection = (bucket: { totalTrades: number; wins: number; losses: number; totalR: number }) => ({
    totalTrades: bucket.totalTrades,
    wins: bucket.wins,
    losses: bucket.losses,
    winRate: bucket.totalTrades > 0 ? bucket.wins / bucket.totalTrades : null,
    totalR: bucket.totalR,
    avgRPerTrade: bucket.totalTrades > 0 ? bucket.totalR / bucket.totalTrades : null,
  });

  res.json({
    sessions: sessionResults,
    stats: {
      totalSessions: sessions.length,
      availableSessions: sessions.filter((session) => session.snapshotAt != null).length,
      unavailableSessions: sessions.filter((session) => session.snapshotAt == null).length,
      completedSessions: sessionResults.filter((session) => session.sessionR !== null).length,
      totalTrades,
      wins,
      losses,
      winRate,
      totalR: cumulativeR,
      avgRPerTrade,
      byDirection: {
        LONG: summarizeDirection(byDirection.LONG),
        SHORT: summarizeDirection(byDirection.SHORT),
      },
    },
  });
});

function emptyStats() {
  return {
    totalSessions: 0,
    availableSessions: 0,
    unavailableSessions: 0,
    completedSessions: 0,
    totalTrades: 0,
    wins: 0,
    losses: 0,
    winRate: null,
    totalR: 0,
    avgRPerTrade: null,
    byDirection: {
      LONG: { totalTrades: 0, wins: 0, losses: 0, winRate: null, totalR: 0, avgRPerTrade: null },
      SHORT: { totalTrades: 0, wins: 0, losses: 0, winRate: null, totalR: 0, avgRPerTrade: null },
    },
  };
}

export default router;

import {
  ExchangeMobileAuthorizationCodeBody,
  ExchangeMobileAuthorizationCodeResponse,
  GetCurrentAuthUserResponse,
  LogoutMobileSessionResponse,
} from '@workspace/api-zod';
import { db, usersTable } from '@workspace/db';
import { Router, type IRouter, type Request, type Response } from 'express';
import * as oidc from 'openid-client';

import {
  clearSession,
  createSession,
  deleteSession,
  getOidcConfig,
  getSessionId,
  ISSUER_URL,
  SESSION_COOKIE,
  SESSION_TTL,
  type SessionData,
} from '../lib/auth';
import { isAdministrator } from '../middlewares/authMiddleware';

const OIDC_COOKIE_TTL = 10 * 60 * 1000;

const router: IRouter = Router();

function getOrigin(req: Request): string {
  const proto = req.headers['x-forwarded-proto'] || 'https';
  const host =
    req.headers['x-forwarded-host'] || req.headers['host'] || 'localhost';
  return `${proto}://${host}`;
}

function setSessionCookie(res: Response, sid: string) {
  res.cookie(SESSION_COOKIE, sid, {
    httpOnly: true,
    secure: true,
    sameSite: 'lax',
    path: '/',
    maxAge: SESSION_TTL,
  });
}

function setOidcCookie(res: Response, name: string, value: string) {
  res.cookie(name, value, {
    httpOnly: true,
    secure: true,
    sameSite: 'lax',
    path: '/',
    maxAge: OIDC_COOKIE_TTL,
  });
}

function getSafeReturnTo(value: unknown): string {
  if (
    typeof value !== 'string' ||
    !value.startsWith('/') ||
    value.startsWith('//') ||
    value.includes('\\') ||
    value.includes('\0')
  ) {
    return '/';
  }
  return value;
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null;
}

function getErrorStatus(
  value: Record<string, unknown>,
): number | string | undefined {
  if (typeof value.status === 'number' || typeof value.status === 'string') {
    return value.status;
  }
  if (
    typeof value.statusCode === 'number' ||
    typeof value.statusCode === 'string'
  ) {
    return value.statusCode;
  }
  return undefined;
}

function getSafeErrorMetadata(error: unknown) {
  if (!isRecord(error)) {
    return { errorName: typeof error };
  }

  const errorStatus = getErrorStatus(error);
  const causeStatus = isRecord(error.cause)
    ? getErrorStatus(error.cause)
    : undefined;

  return {
    errorName: error instanceof Error ? error.name : 'Error',
    errorStatus: errorStatus ?? causeStatus,
  };
}

async function upsertUser(claims: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const userData = {
    id: claims.sub as string,
    email: (claims.email as string) || null,
    firstName: (claims.first_name as string) || null,
    lastName: (claims.last_name as string) || null,
    profileImageUrl: (claims.profile_image_url || claims.picture) as
      | string
      | null,
  };

  const [user] = await db
    .insert(usersTable)
    .values(userData)
    .onConflictDoUpdate({
      target: usersTable.id,
      set: {
        ...userData,
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      },
    })
    .returning();
  return user;
}

          : null,
    }),

});

router.get('/login', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  let config: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getOidcConfig>>;
  try {
    config = await getOidcConfig();
  } catch {
    res.status(503).send('Authentication service unavailable. Please try again.');
    return;
  }

  const callbackUrl = `${getOrigin(req)}/api/callback`;
  const returnTo = getSafeReturnTo(req.query.returnTo);

  const state = oidc.randomState();
  const nonce = oidc.randomNonce();
  const codeVerifier = oidc.randomPKCECodeVerifier();
  const codeChallenge = await oidc.calculatePKCECodeChallenge(codeVerifier);

  const redirectTo = oidc.buildAuthorizationUrl(config, {
    redirect_uri: callbackUrl,
    scope: 'openid email profile offline_access',
    code_challenge: codeChallenge,
    code_challenge_method: 'S256',
    prompt: 'login consent',
    state,
    nonce,
  });

  setOidcCookie(res, 'code_verifier', codeVerifier);
  setOidcCookie(res, 'nonce', nonce);
  setOidcCookie(res, 'state', state);
  setOidcCookie(res, 'return_to', returnTo);

  res.redirect(redirectTo.href);
});

// Query params are not validated because the OIDC provider may include
// parameters not expressed in the schema.
router.get('/callback', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  let config: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getOidcConfig>>;
  try {
    config = await getOidcConfig();
  } catch {
    res.redirect('/api/login');
    return;
  }

  const callbackUrl = `${getOrigin(req)}/api/callback`;

  const codeVerifier = req.cookies?.code_verifier;
  const nonce = req.cookies?.nonce;
  const expectedState = req.cookies?.state;

  if (!codeVerifier || !expectedState) {
    res.redirect('/api/login');
    return;
  }

  const currentUrl = new URL(
    `${callbackUrl}?${new URL(req.url, `http://${req.headers.host}`).searchParams}`,
  );

  let tokens: oidc.TokenEndpointResponse & oidc.TokenEndpointResponseHelpers;
  try {
    tokens = await oidc.authorizationCodeGrant(config, currentUrl, {
      pkceCodeVerifier: codeVerifier,
      expectedNonce: nonce,
      expectedState,
      idTokenExpected: true,
    });
  } catch {
    res.redirect('/api/login');
    return;
  }

  const returnTo = getSafeReturnTo(req.cookies?.return_to);

  res.clearCookie('code_verifier', { path: '/' });
  res.clearCookie('nonce', { path: '/' });
  res.clearCookie('state', { path: '/' });
  res.clearCookie('return_to', { path: '/' });

  const claims = tokens.claims();
  if (!claims) {
    res.redirect('/api/login');
    return;
  }

  let dbUser: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof upsertUser>>;
  try {
    dbUser = await upsertUser(claims as unknown as Record<string, unknown>);
  } catch {
    res.redirect('/api/login');
    return;
  }

  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  const sessionData: SessionData = {
    user: {
      id: dbUser.id,
      email: dbUser.email,
      firstName: dbUser.firstName,
      lastName: dbUser.lastName,
      profileImageUrl: dbUser.profileImageUrl,
    },
    access_token: tokens.access_token,
    refresh_token: tokens.refresh_token,
    expires_at: tokens.expiresIn() ? now + tokens.expiresIn()! : claims.exp,
  };

  const sid = await createSession(sessionData);
  setSessionCookie(res, sid);
  res.redirect(returnTo);
});

router.get('/logout', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  const config = await getOidcConfig();
  const origin = getOrigin(req);
  const returnTo = getSafeReturnTo(req.query.returnTo);
  const postLogoutRedirectUrl = new URL(returnTo, `${origin}/`).href;

  const sid = getSessionId(req);
  await clearSession(res, sid);

  const endSessionUrl = oidc.buildEndSessionUrl(config, {
    client_id: process.env.REPL_ID!,
    post_logout_redirect_uri: postLogoutRedirectUrl,
  });

  res.redirect(endSessionUrl.href);
});

router.post(
  '/mobile-auth/token-exchange',
  async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    const parsed = ExchangeMobileAuthorizationCodeBody.safeParse(req.body);
    if (!parsed.success) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Missing or invalid required parameters' });
      return;
    }

    const { code, code_verifier, redirect_uri, state, nonce } = parsed.data;

    try {
      const config = await getOidcConfig();

      const callbackUrl = new URL(redirect_uri);
      callbackUrl.searchParams.set('code', code);
      callbackUrl.searchParams.set('state', state);
      callbackUrl.searchParams.set('iss', ISSUER_URL);

      const tokens = await oidc.authorizationCodeGrant(config, callbackUrl, {
        pkceCodeVerifier: code_verifier,
        expectedNonce: nonce ?? undefined,
        expectedState: state,
        idTokenExpected: true,
      });

      const claims = tokens.claims();
      if (!claims) {
        res.status(401).json({ error: 'No claims in ID token' });
        return;
      }

      const dbUser = await upsertUser(
        claims as unknown as Record<string, unknown>,
      );

      const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
      const sessionData: SessionData = {
        user: {
          id: dbUser.id,
          email: dbUser.email,
          firstName: dbUser.firstName,
          lastName: dbUser.lastName,
          profileImageUrl: dbUser.profileImageUrl,
        },
        access_token: tokens.access_token,
        refresh_token: tokens.refresh_token,
        expires_at: tokens.expiresIn() ? now + tokens.expiresIn()! : claims.exp,
      };

      const sid = await createSession(sessionData);
      res.json(ExchangeMobileAuthorizationCodeResponse.parse({ token: sid }));
    } catch (err) {
      req.log.error(getSafeErrorMetadata(err), 'Mobile token exchange error');
      res.status(500).json({ error: 'Token exchange failed' });
    }
  },
);

router.post('/mobile-auth/logout', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  const sid = getSessionId(req);
  if (sid) {
    await deleteSession(sid);
  }
  res.json(LogoutMobileSessionResponse.parse({ success: true }));
});

export default router;

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

process.env.DATABASE_URL ??= "postgres://test:test@localhost:5432/test";
const { resolveOutcome } = await import("./candidates.ts");

const candidate = {
  entryPrice: 100,
  stopPrice: 95,
  targetPrice: 110,
  direction: "LONG",
};

test("confirmed TIME_EXIT accepts the actual exit price rather than matching target or stop", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(
    resolveOutcome(candidate, {
      outcome: "TIME_EXIT",
      resolutionMethod: "TIME_EXIT",
      exitPrice: 103,
      actualExitConfirmed: true,
    }),
    {
      success: true,
      exitPrice: 103,
      realizedR: 0.6,
      resolutionMethod: "TIME_EXIT",
      resolutionQuality: "RECORDED_EXIT",
    },
  );
});

test("TIME_EXIT still requires explicit actual-exit confirmation", () => {
  const result = resolveOutcome(candidate, {
    outcome: "TIME_EXIT",
    resolutionMethod: "TIME_EXIT",
    exitPrice: 103,
  });
  assert.equal(result.success, false);
});

test("TARGET_HIT and STOP_HIT still reject prices that differ from their levels", () => {
  assert.equal(resolveOutcome(candidate, {
    outcome: "WIN",
    resolutionMethod: "TARGET_HIT",
    exitPrice: 109,
  }).success, false);
  assert.equal(resolveOutcome(candidate, {
    outcome: "LOSS",
    resolutionMethod: "STOP_HIT",
    exitPrice: 96,
  }).success, false);
});
