import { Router, type IRouter } from "express";
import { eq, and, inArray } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db, candidatesTable, screenerSessionsTable, survivalTradesTable } from "@workspace/db";
import {
  ListCandidatesQueryParams,
  UpdateCandidateOutcomeParams,
  UpdateCandidateOutcomeBody,
  ListCandidatesResponse,
  UpdateCandidateOutcomeResponse,
} from "@workspace/api-zod";
import { lockScreenerSession } from "../lib/candidateSynchronization";
import { afterSessionWriteLock } from "../lib/sessionWriteSerialization";

const router: IRouter = Router();
type ChallengeTradeInput = {
  date: string;
  ticker: string;
  strategy: string;
  direction: "LONG" | "SHORT";
  pnlKr: number;
  flag: "LAST" | "REFLEX";
  followedPlan: boolean;
  boughtBeforeReport?: boolean;
  riskAllocationKr?: number;
};

type ResolutionMethod = "MANUAL_EXIT" | "TARGET_HIT" | "STOP_HIT" | "TIME_EXIT";

/**
 * Resolve an outcome without inventing a price path. A manually recorded exit
 * always produces its actual R. Planned stop/target levels remain available
 * only as deliberate, auditable assumptions.
 */
export function resolveOutcome(
  candidate: {
    entryPrice: number; stopPrice: number; targetPrice: number; direction: string;
    resolutionEntryPrice?: number | null; resolutionStopPrice?: number | null; resolutionDirection?: string | null;
  },
  input: {
    outcome: string; exitPrice?: number | null; resolutionMethod?: ResolutionMethod | null;
    actualExitConfirmed?: boolean;
  },
):
  | { success: true; exitPrice: number | null; realizedR: number | null; resolutionMethod: ResolutionMethod | null; resolutionQuality: "RECORDED_EXIT" | "ASSUMED_LEVEL" | null }
  | { success: false; error: string } {
  if (input.outcome !== "WIN" && input.outcome !== "LOSS" && input.outcome !== "TIME_EXIT") {
    return { success: true, exitPrice: null, realizedR: null, resolutionMethod: null, resolutionQuality: null };
  }

  const method = input.resolutionMethod ??
    (input.outcome === "TIME_EXIT" ? "TIME_EXIT" : input.exitPrice != null ? "MANUAL_EXIT" : null);
  if (!method) {
    return { success: false, error: "WIN eller LOSS kräver ett registrerat exit-pris eller en uttrycklig target/stop-anta­gande." };
  }
  if (method === "TARGET_HIT" && input.outcome !== "WIN") {
    return { success: false, error: "TARGET_HIT kan bara användas för WIN." };
  }
  if (method === "STOP_HIT" && input.outcome !== "LOSS") {
    return { success: false, error: "STOP_HIT kan bara användas för LOSS." };
  }
  if (method === "TIME_EXIT" && input.outcome !== "TIME_EXIT") {
    return { success: false, error: "TIME_EXIT-metoden kan bara användas för TIME_EXIT-utfall." };
  }
  if (input.outcome === "TIME_EXIT" && method !== "TIME_EXIT") {
    return { success: false, error: "TIME_EXIT-utfall måste registreras med TIME_EXIT-metoden." };
  }

  const assumedPrice = method === "TARGET_HIT" ? candidate.targetPrice : method === "STOP_HIT" ? candidate.stopPrice : null;
  if ((method === "TARGET_HIT" || method === "STOP_HIT") && input.exitPrice != null && Math.abs(input.exitPrice - assumedPrice!) > 0.0001) {
    return { success: false, error: `${method} måste använda signalens ${method === "TARGET_HIT" ? "target" : "stop"}-pris.` };
  }
  if ((method === "MANUAL_EXIT" || method === "TIME_EXIT") && input.actualExitConfirmed !== true) {
    return { success: false, error: `${method} kräver att ett faktiskt genomfört exit-fyllnad uttryckligen bekräftas. En Yahoo/live-kurs är inte ett registrerat exit.` };
  }
  const exitPrice = assumedPrice ?? input.exitPrice;
  if (exitPrice == null || !Number.isFinite(exitPrice)) {
    return { success: false, error: `${method} kräver ett giltigt faktiskt exit-pris.` };
  }
  // Keep the first resolution's inputs immutable. Legacy rows have no
  // snapshot, so only an explicit new resolution may establish one; we never
  // infer historic execution provenance from their current signal fields.
  const entryPrice = candidate.resolutionEntryPrice ?? candidate.entryPrice;
  const stopPrice = candidate.resolutionStopPrice ?? candidate.stopPrice;
  const direction = candidate.resolutionDirection ?? candidate.direction;
  const oneR = Math.abs(entryPrice - stopPrice);
  if (!Number.isFinite(oneR) || oneR === 0) {
    return { success: false, error: "Kan inte beräkna R: entry och stop måste ha olika giltiga priser." };
  }
  const realizedR = direction === "LONG"
    ? (exitPrice - entryPrice) / oneR
    : (entryPrice - exitPrice) / oneR;
  if ((input.outcome === "WIN" && realizedR <= 0) || (input.outcome === "LOSS" && realizedR >= 0)) {
    return { success: false, error: `${input.outcome} stämmer inte med tecknet på beräknat realiserat R (${realizedR.toFixed(3)}R).` };
  }
  return {
    success: true,
    exitPrice,
    realizedR,
    resolutionMethod: method,
    resolutionQuality: method === "MANUAL_EXIT" || method === "TIME_EXIT" ? "RECORDED_EXIT" : "ASSUMED_LEVEL",
  };
}

function parseChallengeTrade(value: unknown):
  | { success: true; data: ChallengeTradeInput }
  | { success: false; error: string } {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
    return { success: false, error: "challengeTrade must be an object" };
  }
  const input = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  const isDate = typeof input.date === "string" && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(input.date);
  const isText = (field: "ticker" | "strategy", max: number) =>
    typeof input[field] === "string" && input[field].trim().length > 0 && input[field].length <= max;
  if (
    !isDate ||
    !isText("ticker", 32) ||
    !isText("strategy", 120) ||
    (input.direction !== "LONG" && input.direction !== "SHORT") ||
    typeof input.pnlKr !== "number" ||
    !Number.isFinite(input.pnlKr) ||
    (input.flag !== "LAST" && input.flag !== "REFLEX") ||
    typeof input.followedPlan !== "boolean" ||
    (input.boughtBeforeReport !== undefined && typeof input.boughtBeforeReport !== "boolean")
    || (input.riskAllocationKr !== undefined &&
      (typeof input.riskAllocationKr !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(input.riskAllocationKr) || input.riskAllocationKr <= 0))
  ) {
    return { success: false, error: "Invalid challengeTrade payload" };
  }
  return {
    success: true,
    data: {
      date: input.date as string,
      ticker: input.ticker as string,
      strategy: input.strategy as string,
      direction: input.direction as "LONG" | "SHORT",
      pnlKr: input.pnlKr as number,
      flag: input.flag as "LAST" | "REFLEX",
      followedPlan: input.followedPlan as boolean,
      boughtBeforeReport: input.boughtBeforeReport as boolean | undefined,
      riskAllocationKr: input.riskAllocationKr as number | undefined,
    },
  };
}

/** Fetch which of the given candidate ids have a linked Challenge Tracker trade. */
async function fetchLinkedTradeIds(candidateIds: number[]): Promise<Set<number>> {
  if (candidateIds.length === 0) return new Set();
  const rows = await db
    .select({ sourceCandidateId: survivalTradesTable.sourceCandidateId })
    .from(survivalTradesTable)
    .where(inArray(survivalTradesTable.sourceCandidateId, candidateIds));
  return new Set(rows.map((r) => r.sourceCandidateId).filter((id): id is number => id != null));
}

// GET /candidates
router.get("/candidates", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const queryParams = ListCandidatesQueryParams.safeParse(req.query);
  if (!queryParams.success) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: queryParams.error.message });
    return;
  }

  const { category, outcome, direction } = queryParams.data;

  const conditions = [];
  if (category) conditions.push(eq(candidatesTable.category, category));
  if (outcome) conditions.push(eq(candidatesTable.outcome, outcome));
  if (direction) conditions.push(eq(candidatesTable.direction, direction));

  const rows = await db
    .select({
      id: candidatesTable.id,
      sessionId: candidatesTable.sessionId,
      signalDate: candidatesTable.signalDate,
      category: candidatesTable.category,
      rank: candidatesTable.rank,
      ticker: candidatesTable.ticker,
      price: candidatesTable.price,
      rs3m: candidatesTable.rs3m,
      perf1m: candidatesTable.perf1m,
      rsi: candidatesTable.rsi,
      pctB: candidatesTable.pctB,
      atr: candidatesTable.atr,
      volMultiplier: candidatesTable.volMultiplier,
      volumeAsOf: candidatesTable.volumeAsOf,
      edgeWinRate: candidatesTable.edgeWinRate,
      edgeExpectancyR: candidatesTable.edgeExpectancyR,
      edgeSampleN: candidatesTable.edgeSampleN,
      signalAgeBars: candidatesTable.signalAgeBars,
      maxHoldDays: candidatesTable.maxHoldDays,
      distFrom20dH: candidatesTable.distFrom20dH,
      gapWarning: candidatesTable.gapWarning,
      direction: candidatesTable.direction,
      entryPrice: candidatesTable.entryPrice,
      stopPrice: candidatesTable.stopPrice,
      targetPrice: candidatesTable.targetPrice,
      rr: candidatesTable.rr,
      oneR: candidatesTable.oneR,
      outcome: candidatesTable.outcome,
      exitPrice: candidatesTable.exitPrice,
      outcomeNotes: candidatesTable.outcomeNotes,
      resolutionMethod: candidatesTable.resolutionMethod,
      resolutionQuality: candidatesTable.resolutionQuality,
      realizedR: candidatesTable.realizedR,
        resolutionEntryPrice: candidatesTable.resolutionEntryPrice,
        resolutionStopPrice: candidatesTable.resolutionStopPrice,
        resolutionDirection: candidatesTable.resolutionDirection,
      sessionDate: screenerSessionsTable.date,
    })
    .from(candidatesTable)
    .innerJoin(screenerSessionsTable, eq(candidatesTable.sessionId, screenerSessionsTable.id))
    .where(conditions.length > 0 ? and(...conditions) : undefined)
    .orderBy(screenerSessionsTable.date, candidatesTable.category, candidatesTable.rank);

  const linkedIds = await fetchLinkedTradeIds(rows.map((r) => r.id));

  res.json(
    ListCandidatesResponse.parse(
      rows.map((r) => ({
        ...r,
        gapWarning: r.gapWarning ?? null,
        exitPrice: r.exitPrice ?? null,
        outcomeNotes: r.outcomeNotes ?? null,
        resolutionMethod: r.resolutionMethod ?? null,
        resolutionQuality: r.resolutionQuality ?? null,
        realizedR: r.realizedR ?? null,
        resolutionEntryPrice: r.resolutionEntryPrice ?? null,
        resolutionStopPrice: r.resolutionStopPrice ?? null,
        resolutionDirection: r.resolutionDirection ?? null,
        hasLinkedTrade: linkedIds.has(r.id),
      }))
    )
  );
});

// PATCH /candidates/:id/outcome
router.patch("/candidates/:id/outcome", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const params = UpdateCandidateOutcomeParams.safeParse(req.params);
  if (!params.success) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: params.error.message });
    return;
  }

  const body = UpdateCandidateOutcomeBody.safeParse(req.body);
  if (!body.success) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: body.error.message });
    return;
  }

  const challengeInput =
    req.body?.challengeTrade === undefined
      ? null
      : parseChallengeTrade(req.body.challengeTrade);
  if (challengeInput && !challengeInput.success) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: challengeInput.error });
    return;
  }
  const isResolvedOutcome =
    body.data.outcome === "WIN" ||
    body.data.outcome === "LOSS" ||
    body.data.outcome === "TIME_EXIT";
  if (challengeInput && !isResolvedOutcome) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: "A Challenge Tracker trade requires a priced resolved outcome" });
    return;
  }
  // Explicit confirmation required to drop a linked Challenge Tracker trade —
  // financial history must never disappear as a side effect of an outcome edit.
  const removeChallengeTrade = req.body?.removeChallengeTrade === true;

  const revertingOutcome = !isResolvedOutcome;

  // This lookup supplies only the advisory-lock key. Candidate, resolution and
  // link state are deliberately re-read after the lock has been acquired.
  const [locator] = await db
    .select({ date: screenerSessionsTable.date })
    .from(candidatesTable)
    .innerJoin(screenerSessionsTable, eq(candidatesTable.sessionId, screenerSessionsTable.id))
    .where(eq(candidatesTable.id, params.data.id));
  if (!locator) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: "Candidate not found" });
    return;
  }

  const result = await db.transaction((tx) =>
    afterSessionWriteLock(
      () => lockScreenerSession(tx, locator.date),
      async () => {
    const [candidate] = await tx
      .select()
      .from(candidatesTable)
      .where(eq(candidatesTable.id, params.data.id));
    if (!candidate) return null;

    const resolution = resolveOutcome(candidate, body.data);
    if (!resolution.success) {
      return { error: resolution.error };
    }

    const [existingLink] = await tx
      .select()
      .from(survivalTradesTable)
      .where(eq(survivalTradesTable.sourceCandidateId, candidate.id));
    if (existingLink && revertingOutcome && !removeChallengeTrade) {
      return {
        error: `Detta utfall är kopplat till en loggad Challenge Tracker-trade (${existingLink.pnlKr} kr). Bekräfta borttagning för att fortsätta.`,
        status: 409,
        existingChallengeTrade: existingLink,
      };
    }

    const [session] = await tx
      .select({ date: screenerSessionsTable.date })
      .from(screenerSessionsTable)
      .where(eq(screenerSessionsTable.id, candidate.sessionId));
    if (!session) return { error: "Candidate session not found" };

    type SynchronizedChallengeTrade = ChallengeTradeInput & { riskAllocationKr: number };
    let synchronizedChallenge: SynchronizedChallengeTrade | null = null;
    if (!revertingOutcome && resolution.realizedR != null && challengeInput) {
      const submitted = challengeInput.data;
      const authoritativeTicker = candidate.ticker.trim().toUpperCase().replace(/\.ST$/i, "");
      const authoritativeDirection = candidate.resolutionDirection ?? candidate.direction;
      const submittedTicker = submitted.ticker.trim().toUpperCase().replace(/\.ST$/i, "");
      if (
        submittedTicker !== authoritativeTicker ||
        submitted.direction !== authoritativeDirection ||
        submitted.date !== session.date
      ) {
        return {
          error: "Challenge Tracker-identitet måste matcha kandidatens ticker, riktning och sessionsdatum.",
        };
      }
      if (
        (resolution.realizedR > 0 && submitted.pnlKr <= 0) ||
        (resolution.realizedR < 0 && submitted.pnlKr >= 0)
      ) {
        return { error: "Challenge Tracker P&L måste ha samma tecken som kandidatens R." };
      }
      const riskAllocationKr = submitted.riskAllocationKr ??
        Math.abs(submitted.pnlKr / resolution.realizedR);
      const pnlKr = Math.round(riskAllocationKr * resolution.realizedR);
      if (!Number.isFinite(riskAllocationKr) || riskAllocationKr <= 0 || pnlKr !== submitted.pnlKr) {
        return {
          error: `Challenge Tracker P&L måste vara ${pnlKr} kr för angiven risk och ${resolution.realizedR.toFixed(3)}R.`,
        };
      }
      synchronizedChallenge = {
        ...submitted,
        date: session.date,
        ticker: authoritativeTicker,
        direction: authoritativeDirection,
        pnlKr,
        riskAllocationKr,
      };
    } else if (!revertingOutcome && resolution.realizedR != null && existingLink) {
      const oldR = candidate.realizedR;
      const riskAllocationKr = existingLink.riskAllocationKr ??
        (oldR != null && Number.isFinite(oldR) && oldR !== 0
          ? Math.abs(existingLink.pnlKr / oldR)
          : null);
      if (riskAllocationKr == null || !Number.isFinite(riskAllocationKr) || riskAllocationKr <= 0) {
        return {
          error: "Den äldre kopplade traden saknar en säker riskallokering. Ange en uppdaterad Challenge Tracker-trade med riskAllocationKr.",
          status: 409,
          existingChallengeTrade: existingLink,
        };
      }
      synchronizedChallenge = {
        date: session.date,
        ticker: candidate.ticker.trim().toUpperCase().replace(/\.ST$/i, ""),
        strategy: existingLink.strategy,
        direction: candidate.resolutionDirection ?? candidate.direction,
        pnlKr: Math.round(riskAllocationKr * resolution.realizedR),
        riskAllocationKr,
        flag: existingLink.flag,
        followedPlan: existingLink.followedPlan,
        boughtBeforeReport: existingLink.boughtBeforeReport,
      };
    }

    const [updated] = await tx
      .update(candidatesTable)
      .set({
        outcome: body.data.outcome,
        exitPrice: resolution.exitPrice,
        outcomeNotes: body.data.outcomeNotes ?? null,
        resolutionMethod: resolution.resolutionMethod,
        resolutionQuality: resolution.resolutionQuality,
        realizedR: resolution.realizedR,
        resolutionEntryPrice: resolution.realizedR == null
          ? candidate.resolutionEntryPrice
          : (candidate.resolutionEntryPrice ?? candidate.entryPrice),
        resolutionStopPrice: resolution.realizedR == null
          ? candidate.resolutionStopPrice
          : (candidate.resolutionStopPrice ?? candidate.stopPrice),
        resolutionDirection: resolution.realizedR == null
          ? candidate.resolutionDirection
          : (candidate.resolutionDirection ?? candidate.direction),
      })
      .where(eq(candidatesTable.id, params.data.id))
      .returning();

    let hasLinkedTrade = false;

    if (synchronizedChallenge) {
      // Insert on first log, update in place on any later correction — a
      // resubmitted outcome must overwrite the old Challenge Tracker entry,
      // never sit silently next to it or get dropped.
      await tx
        .insert(survivalTradesTable)
        .values({
          date: synchronizedChallenge.date,
          ticker: synchronizedChallenge.ticker,
          strategy: synchronizedChallenge.strategy,
          direction: synchronizedChallenge.direction,
          pnlKr: synchronizedChallenge.pnlKr,
          riskAllocationKr: synchronizedChallenge.riskAllocationKr,
          flag: synchronizedChallenge.flag,
          followedPlan: synchronizedChallenge.followedPlan,
          sourceCandidateId: candidate.id,
          boughtBeforeReport: synchronizedChallenge.boughtBeforeReport ?? false,
        })
        .onConflictDoUpdate({
          target: survivalTradesTable.sourceCandidateId,
          set: {
            date: synchronizedChallenge.date,
            ticker: synchronizedChallenge.ticker,
            strategy: synchronizedChallenge.strategy,
            direction: synchronizedChallenge.direction,
            pnlKr: synchronizedChallenge.pnlKr,
            riskAllocationKr: synchronizedChallenge.riskAllocationKr,
            flag: synchronizedChallenge.flag,
            followedPlan: synchronizedChallenge.followedPlan,
            boughtBeforeReport: synchronizedChallenge.boughtBeforeReport ?? false,
          },
        });
      hasLinkedTrade = true;
    } else if (revertingOutcome && removeChallengeTrade) {
      const deleted = await tx
        .delete(survivalTradesTable)
        .where(eq(survivalTradesTable.sourceCandidateId, candidate.id))
        .returning({ id: survivalTradesTable.id });
      hasLinkedTrade = false;
      void deleted;
    } else {
      hasLinkedTrade = !!existingLink;
    }

        return { updated, hasLinkedTrade };
      },
    ),
  );

  if (!result) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: "Candidate not found" });
    return;
  }
  if ("error" in result) {
    res.status("status" in result && typeof result.status === "number" ? result.status : 400).json({
      error: result.error,
      ...("existingChallengeTrade" in result ? { existingChallengeTrade: result.existingChallengeTrade } : {}),
    });
    return;
  }

  const { updated: result_, hasLinkedTrade } = result;

  res.json(
    UpdateCandidateOutcomeResponse.parse({
      id: result_.id,
      sessionId: result_.sessionId,
      category: result_.category,
      rank: result_.rank,
      ticker: result_.ticker,
      price: result_.price,
      rs3m: result_.rs3m,
      perf1m: result_.perf1m,
      rsi: result_.rsi,
      pctB: result_.pctB,
      atr: result_.atr,
      volMultiplier: result_.volMultiplier,
      volumeAsOf: result_.volumeAsOf ?? null,
      edgeWinRate: result_.edgeWinRate ?? null,
      edgeExpectancyR: result_.edgeExpectancyR ?? null,
      edgeSampleN: result_.edgeSampleN ?? null,
      signalAgeBars: result_.signalAgeBars ?? null,
      maxHoldDays: result_.maxHoldDays ?? null,
      distFrom20dH: result_.distFrom20dH,
      gapWarning: result_.gapWarning ?? null,
      direction: result_.direction,
      entryPrice: result_.entryPrice,
      stopPrice: result_.stopPrice,
      targetPrice: result_.targetPrice,
      rr: result_.rr,
      oneR: result_.oneR,
      outcome: result_.outcome,
      exitPrice: result_.exitPrice ?? null,
      outcomeNotes: result_.outcomeNotes ?? null,
      resolutionMethod: result_.resolutionMethod ?? null,
      resolutionQuality: result_.resolutionQuality ?? null,
      realizedR: result_.realizedR ?? null,
      resolutionEntryPrice: result_.resolutionEntryPrice ?? null,
      resolutionStopPrice: result_.resolutionStopPrice ?? null,
      resolutionDirection: result_.resolutionDirection ?? null,
      hasLinkedTrade,
    })
  );
});

export default router;

import { Router, type IRouter } from "express";
import { sql, eq, inArray } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db, candidatesTable, screenerSessionsTable } from "@workspace/db";
import { GetDashboardSummaryResponse } from "@workspace/api-zod";
import { resolveTradePerformance } from "../lib/tradePerformance.ts";

const router: IRouter = Router();

// GET /dashboard/summary
router.get("/dashboard/summary", async (_req, res): Promise<void> => {
  // Total sessions
  const [sessionCountRow] = await db
    .select({ count: sql<number>`cast(count(*) as integer)` })
    .from(screenerSessionsTable);
  const totalSessions = Number(sessionCountRow?.count ?? 0);

  let wins = 0;
  let losses = 0;
  let resolvedTrades = 0;

  const categoryMap: Record<
    string,
    { total: number; resolved: number; wins: number; losses: number; skips: number; pending: number }
  > = {};

  // All-candidate performance is intentionally distinct from the retrospectively
  // selected Top3 population. Keep count aggregation in SQL rather than loading
  // every still-pending candidate just to count it.
  const categoryCounts = await db
    .select({
      category: candidatesTable.category,
      outcome: candidatesTable.outcome,
      count: sql<number>`cast(count(*) as integer)`,
    })
    .from(candidatesTable)
    .groupBy(candidatesTable.category, candidatesTable.outcome);
  let totalCandidates = 0;
  for (const row of categoryCounts) {
    const count = Number(row.count);
    totalCandidates += count;
    const stats = categoryMap[row.category] ??= {
      total: 0, resolved: 0, wins: 0, losses: 0, skips: 0, pending: 0,
    };
    stats.total += count;
    if (row.outcome === "SKIP") stats.skips += count;
    if (row.outcome === "PENDING") stats.pending += count;
  }

  const resolvedRows = await db
    .select({
      category: candidatesTable.category,
      ticker: candidatesTable.ticker,
      outcome: candidatesTable.outcome,
      direction: candidatesTable.direction,
      entryPrice: candidatesTable.entryPrice,
      stopPrice: candidatesTable.stopPrice,
      exitPrice: candidatesTable.exitPrice,
      realizedR: candidatesTable.realizedR,
      resolutionEntryPrice: candidatesTable.resolutionEntryPrice,
      resolutionStopPrice: candidatesTable.resolutionStopPrice,
      resolutionDirection: candidatesTable.resolutionDirection,
      sessionDate: screenerSessionsTable.date,
    })
    .from(candidatesTable)
    .innerJoin(screenerSessionsTable, eq(candidatesTable.sessionId, screenerSessionsTable.id))
    .where(inArray(candidatesTable.outcome, ["WIN", "LOSS", "TIME_EXIT"]))
    .orderBy(screenerSessionsTable.date, candidatesTable.id);

  // Calculate R for each trade: R = signed gain / |entry - stop|
  interface TradeR {
    r: number;
    date: string;
    ticker: string;
    outcome: "WIN" | "LOSS" | "TIME_EXIT";
    result: "WIN" | "LOSS" | "FLAT";
  }
  const tradeRs: TradeR[] = [];

  for (const row of resolvedRows) {
    const performance = resolveTradePerformance(row);
    if (!performance) continue;

    const stats = categoryMap[row.category];
    resolvedTrades++;
    stats.resolved++;
    if (performance.result === "WIN") {
      wins++;
      stats.wins++;
    } else if (performance.result === "LOSS") {
      losses++;
      stats.losses++;
    }
    tradeRs.push({
      r: performance.r,
      date: row.sessionDate,
      ticker: row.ticker,
      outcome: row.outcome as TradeR["outcome"],
      result: performance.result,
    });
  }
  const overallWinRate = resolvedTrades > 0 ? wins / resolvedTrades : null;

  const allCategories = ["MOMENTUM", "SQUEEZE", "STUDS", "WEAKEST"] as const;
  const byCategory = allCategories.map((cat) => {
    const stats = categoryMap[cat] ?? { total: 0, resolved: 0, wins: 0, losses: 0, skips: 0, pending: 0 };
    return {
      category: cat,
      total: stats.total,
      wins: stats.wins,
      losses: stats.losses,
      skips: stats.skips,
      pending: stats.pending,
      winRate: stats.resolved > 0 ? stats.wins / stats.resolved : null,
    };
  });

  // Equity curve
  let cumulative = 0;
  const equityCurve = tradeRs.map((t, i) => {
    cumulative += t.r;
    return {
      tradeIndex: i + 1,
      cumulativeR: Math.round(cumulative * 1000) / 1000,
      r: Math.round(t.r * 1000) / 1000,
      date: t.date,
      ticker: t.ticker,
      outcome: t.outcome,
    };
  });

  // Aggregate stats
  const winRs = tradeRs.filter((t) => t.result === "WIN").map((t) => t.r);
  const lossRs = tradeRs.filter((t) => t.result === "LOSS").map((t) => t.r);

  const avgRWin =
    winRs.length > 0 ? winRs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / winRs.length : null;
  const avgRLoss =
    lossRs.length > 0 ? lossRs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / lossRs.length : null;

  const payoffRatio =
    avgRWin != null && avgRLoss != null && avgRLoss !== 0
      ? avgRWin / Math.abs(avgRLoss)
      : null;

  const expectedValue = tradeRs.length > 0
    ? tradeRs.reduce((sum, trade) => sum + trade.r, 0) / tradeRs.length
    : null;

  res.json(
    GetDashboardSummaryResponse.parse({
      totalSessions,
      totalCandidates,
      resolvedTrades,
      wins,
      losses,
      overallWinRate,
      byCategory,
      avgRWin,
      avgRLoss,
      payoffRatio,
      expectedValue,
      equityCurve,
    })
  );
});

export default router;

/**
 * GET /api/screener/earnings-screener
 *
 * Scans the OMXS30 universe + current EdgeAI US picks for upcoming earnings
 * (next 21 days) and recently reported (last 7 days). For each relevant stock:
 *   - Historical beat/miss rate + average EPS surprise %
 *   - Analyst estimate revisions (last 30 days)
 *   - Average day +1 price reaction across past earnings events
 *   - Current live price + next EPS estimate
 *
 * NOTE: This is historical fundamental data, not a technical signal.
 * Day +1 return = (close[date+1] - close[date-1]) / close[date-1] × 100.
 */
import { Router, type IRouter } from "express";
import YahooFinance from "yahoo-finance2";
import { db, screenerSessionsTable, candidatesTable } from "@workspace/db";
import { desc, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { calendarDaysBetween, utcCalendarDate } from "../lib/marketCalendar";

const router: IRouter = Router();
const yf = new YahooFinance({ suppressNotices: ["yahooSurvey", "ripHistorical"] });

// ── Simple in-memory cache (10 min TTL) ──────────────────────────────────────
let cache: { data: unknown; expiresAt: number } | null = null;
const CACHE_TTL_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000;

/**
 * yahoo-finance2 has returned both QuoteSummary modules with `{ raw }`
 * wrappers and plain primitive values across versions. Keep the route tolerant
 * of both shapes so valid earnings data does not become null in the UI.
 */
function yahooValue(value: unknown): unknown {
  if (value == null) return null;
  if (typeof value === "object" && "raw" in value) {
    return (value as { raw?: unknown }).raw ?? null;
  }
  return value;
}

function yahooNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
  const raw = yahooValue(value);
  if (raw == null || raw === "") return null;
  const number = typeof raw === "number" ? raw : Number(raw);
  return Number.isFinite(number) ? number : null;
}

function yahooDate(value: unknown): Date | null {
  const raw = yahooValue(value);
  if (raw instanceof Date) {
    return Number.isFinite(raw.getTime()) ? raw : null;
  }
  if (typeof raw === "number") {
    const date = new Date(raw < 1_000_000_000_000 ? raw * 1_000 : raw);
    return Number.isFinite(date.getTime()) ? date : null;
  }
  if (typeof raw === "string" && raw.trim()) {
    const date = new Date(raw);
    return Number.isFinite(date.getTime()) ? date : null;
  }
  return null;
}

// ── Concurrency limiter ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
async function withConcurrency<T>(
  tasks: (() => Promise<T>)[],
  limit: number,
): Promise<(T | null)[]> {
  const results: (T | null)[] = new Array(tasks.length).fill(null);
  const queue = tasks.map((task, i) => ({ task, i }));
  async function worker() {
    while (queue.length > 0) {
      const item = queue.shift();
      if (!item) break;
      try { results[item.i] = await item.task(); } catch { /* null stays */ }
    }
  }
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.min(limit, tasks.length) }, () => worker()));
  return results;
}

// ── Days from today ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function daysFromToday(dt: Date | string | null | undefined): number | null {
  if (!dt) return null;
  const eventDate = dt instanceof Date ? dt : new Date(dt);
  return calendarDaysBetween(eventDate);
}

// ── Day-of-earnings price reaction ────────────────────────────────────────────
function computeDayPlusOneReturn(
  history: { date: Date; close: number }[],
  earningsDate: Date | string,
): number | null {
  const targetMs = new Date(earningsDate).getTime();
  if (isNaN(targetMs)) return null;
  const sorted = [...history]
    .map((h) => ({ ms: new Date(h.date).getTime(), close: h.close }))
    .sort((a, b) => a.ms - b.ms);

  // Find the last trading day on or before earningsDate
  let beforeIdx = -1;
  for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
    if (sorted[i].ms <= targetMs + 86_400_000) beforeIdx = i; // +1 day buffer
    else break;
  }
  // Clamp: we want the day *before* the earnings date
  while (beforeIdx > 0 && sorted[beforeIdx].ms > targetMs) beforeIdx--;

  if (beforeIdx < 0 || beforeIdx >= sorted.length - 1) return null;
  const before = sorted[beforeIdx].close;
  const after = sorted[beforeIdx + 1].close;
  if (!before) return null;
  return Number((((after - before) / before) * 100).toFixed(2));
}

// ── Main route ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
router.get("/screener/earnings-screener", async (_req, res): Promise<void> => {
  // Serve from cache if still fresh
  if (cache && Date.now() < cache.expiresAt) {
    res.json(cache.data);
    return;
  }
  // 1. Get US tickers from latest EdgeAI session
  const omxsYahooSet = new Set(OMXS30_TICKERS.map((t) => t.yahoo));
  let usTickers: { yahoo: string; display: string }[] = [];
  try {
    // Use the most recent session regardless of source (edgeai, telegram, or manual)
    const [latestSession] = await db
      .select({ id: screenerSessionsTable.id })
      .from(screenerSessionsTable)
      .orderBy(desc(screenerSessionsTable.date))
      .limit(1);

    if (latestSession) {
      const cands = await db
        .select({ ticker: candidatesTable.ticker })
        .from(candidatesTable)
        .where(eq(candidatesTable.sessionId, latestSession.id));

      usTickers = cands
        .map((c) => c.ticker.replace(/\.ST$/i, ""))
        .filter((t) => !omxsYahooSet.has(t + ".ST") && !omxsYahooSet.has(t))
        .filter((t, i, arr) => arr.indexOf(t) === i) // dedupe
        .map((t) => ({ yahoo: t, display: t }));
    }
  } catch {
    // non-fatal — proceed with OMXS30 only
  }

  // Merge permanent US large-caps with session picks (deduplicate by yahoo ticker)
  const usTickerSet = new Set(US_LARGE_CAP_TICKERS.map((t) => t.yahoo.toUpperCase()));
  const sessionOnlyTickers = usTickers.filter((t) => !usTickerSet.has(t.yahoo.toUpperCase()));
  const allUsTickers = [...US_LARGE_CAP_TICKERS, ...sessionOnlyTickers];

  const universe: { yahoo: string; display: string; market: "SE" | "US" }[] = [
    ...OMXS30_TICKERS.map((t) => ({ ...t, market: "SE" as const })),
    ...SE_WATCHLIST_TICKERS.map((t) => ({ ...t, market: "SE" as const })),
    ...allUsTickers.map((t) => ({ ...t, market: "US" as const })),
  ];

  // 2. Fetch quotes (earnings date) for all — concurrency 8
  const quoteResults = await withConcurrency(
    universe.map((stock) => async () => {
      const q = await yf.quote(stock.yahoo, {}, { validateResult: false });
      return {
        ...stock,
        earningsTimestamp: (q as any).earningsTimestamp as Date | null | undefined,
        livePrice: (q.regularMarketPrice ?? null) as number | null,
        changePct: (q.regularMarketChangePercent ?? null) as number | null,
      };
    }),
    8,
  );

  // 3. Filter to earnings within -7 to +21 days
  const relevant = quoteResults
    .filter(Boolean)
    .map((q) => ({ ...q!, earningsInDays: daysFromToday(q!.earningsTimestamp) }))
    .filter((q) => q.earningsInDays != null && q.earningsInDays >= -7 && q.earningsInDays <= 21)
    .sort((a, b) => (a.earningsInDays ?? 99) - (b.earningsInDays ?? 99));

  if (relevant.length === 0) {
    res.json({ stocks: [], generatedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
    return;
  }

  // 4. Fetch quoteSummary (earningsHistory + earningsTrend + financialData) — concurrency 4
  const summaryResults = await withConcurrency(
    relevant.map((stock) => async () => {
      const s = await yf.quoteSummary(stock.yahoo, {
        modules: ["earningsHistory", "earningsTrend", "financialData"],
      });
      return { ticker: stock.yahoo, summary: s };
    }),
    4,
  );

  // 5. Fetch 1-year historical prices — concurrency 4
  const now = new Date();
  const oneYearAgo = new Date(now.getTime() - 365 * 86_400_000);
  const historicalResults = await withConcurrency(
    relevant.map((stock) => async () => {
      const h = await yf.historical(stock.yahoo, {
        period1: oneYearAgo,
        period2: now,
        interval: "1d",
      });
      return { ticker: stock.yahoo, history: h as { date: Date; close: number }[] };
    }),
    4,
  );

  // 6. Build lookup maps
  const summaryMap = new Map(
    summaryResults.filter(Boolean).map((s) => [s!.ticker, s!.summary]),
  );
  const historyMap = new Map(
    historicalResults.filter(Boolean).map((h) => [h!.ticker, h!.history]),
  );

  // 7. Compute metrics per stock
  const stocks = relevant.map((stock) => {
    const summary = summaryMap.get(stock.yahoo);
    const history = historyMap.get(stock.yahoo) ?? [];

    // earningsHistory
    const rawHistory: any[] = (summary?.earningsHistory as any)?.history ?? [];
    type EarningsItem = {
      date: string;
      estimate: number | null;
      actual: number | null;
      surprisePct: number | null;
      dayPlusOneReturn: number | null;
      beat: boolean | null;
    };
    const historicalEarnings: EarningsItem[] = rawHistory.map((h: any) => {
      const estimate = yahooNumber(h.epsEstimate);
      const actual = yahooNumber(h.epsActual);
      const surpriseRaw = yahooNumber(h.surprisePercent);
      const surprisePct = surpriseRaw != null
        ? Number((surpriseRaw * 100).toFixed(2))
        : estimate != null && actual != null && estimate !== 0
        ? Number((((actual - estimate) / Math.abs(estimate)) * 100).toFixed(2))
        : null;
      const quarterDate = yahooDate(h.quarter);
      const dayPlusOneReturn = quarterDate
        ? computeDayPlusOneReturn(history, quarterDate)
        : null;
      return {
        date: utcCalendarDate(quarterDate) ?? h.period ?? "?",
        estimate,
        actual,
        surprisePct,
        dayPlusOneReturn,
        beat: actual != null && estimate != null ? actual > estimate : null,
      };
    });

    const resolved = historicalEarnings.filter((e) => e.beat !== null);
    const beatRate = resolved.length > 0
      ? resolved.filter((e) => e.beat).length / resolved.length
      : null;
    const avgSurprisePct = historicalEarnings.filter((e) => e.surprisePct != null).length > 0
      ? Number(
          (
            historicalEarnings
              .filter((e) => e.surprisePct != null)
              .reduce((s, e) => s + e.surprisePct!, 0) /
            historicalEarnings.filter((e) => e.surprisePct != null).length
          ).toFixed(2),
        )
      : null;
    const d1Returns = historicalEarnings.filter((e) => e.dayPlusOneReturn != null);
    const avgDayPlusOneReturn = d1Returns.length > 0
      ? Number(
          (d1Returns.reduce((s, e) => s + e.dayPlusOneReturn!, 0) / d1Returns.length).toFixed(2),
        )
      : null;

    // earningsTrend — grab current quarter revision counts
    const trendArr: any[] = (summary?.earningsTrend as any)?.trend ?? [];
    const currentTrend = trendArr.find((t: any) => t.period === "0q") ?? trendArr[0];
    const revUp = yahooNumber(currentTrend?.epsRevisions?.upLast30days) ?? 0;
    const revDown = yahooNumber(currentTrend?.epsRevisions?.downLast30days) ?? 0;
    const nextEpsEstimate = yahooNumber(currentTrend?.earningsEstimate?.avg);

    // financialData — analyst consensus + price target
    const fd = (summary as any)?.financialData ?? {};
    const recommendationKey = (yahooValue(fd.recommendationKey) as string | null) ?? null; // "strong_buy" | "buy" | "hold" | "sell" | "strong_sell"
    const recommendationMean = yahooNumber(fd.recommendationMean); // 1.0–5.0
    const numberOfAnalystOpinions = yahooNumber(fd.numberOfAnalystOpinions);
    const targetMeanPrice = yahooNumber(fd.targetMeanPrice);
    const targetLowPrice = yahooNumber(fd.targetLowPrice);
    const targetHighPrice = yahooNumber(fd.targetHighPrice);
    const upsidePct: number | null =
      stock.livePrice && targetMeanPrice
        ? Number((((targetMeanPrice - stock.livePrice) / stock.livePrice) * 100).toFixed(1))
        : null;

    // ── Composite score (0–1) ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Weights: beat-rate 30%, avg EPS surprise 25%, dag+1 return 20%, consensus 25%
    let score = 0;
    let scoreComponents = 0;
    if (beatRate != null) { score += beatRate * 0.30; scoreComponents += 0.30; }
    if (avgSurprisePct != null) {
      // Normalize: -20% → 0, +20% → 1
      score += Math.min(Math.max((avgSurprisePct + 20) / 40, 0), 1) * 0.25;
      scoreComponents += 0.25;
    }
    if (avgDayPlusOneReturn != null) {
      // Normalize: -5% → 0, +5% → 1
      score += Math.min(Math.max((avgDayPlusOneReturn + 5) / 10, 0), 1) * 0.20;
      scoreComponents += 0.20;
    }
    if (recommendationMean != null) {
      // Invert: 1 (strong buy) → 1.0, 5 (strong sell) → 0.0
      score += ((5 - recommendationMean) / 4) * 0.25;
      scoreComponents += 0.25;
    }
    // Re-normalize to available components so partial data isn't penalized
    const compositeScore = scoreComponents > 0 ? Number((score / scoreComponents).toFixed(3)) : null;

    return {
      ticker: stock.yahoo.replace(/\.ST$/i, ""),
      yahooTicker: stock.yahoo,
      display: stock.display,
      market: stock.market,
      earningsDate: utcCalendarDate(stock.earningsTimestamp),
      earningsInDays: stock.earningsInDays,
      livePrice: stock.livePrice,
      changePct: stock.changePct,
      nextEpsEstimate,
      beatRate,
      avgSurprisePct,
      avgDayPlusOneReturn,
      revisionUpCount: revUp,
      revisionDownCount: revDown,
      recommendationKey,
      recommendationMean,
      numberOfAnalystOpinions,
      targetMeanPrice,
      targetLowPrice,
      targetHighPrice,
      upsidePct,
      compositeScore,
      historicalEarnings: historicalEarnings.slice(0, 4), // last 4 quarters
    };
  });

  // Sort: upcoming first by days, but within same urgency band sort by compositeScore desc
  const sorted = stocks.sort((a, b) => {
    const dA = a.earningsInDays ?? 99;
    const dB = b.earningsInDays ?? 99;
    // Past reports last
    if (dA < 0 && dB >= 0) return 1;
    if (dB < 0 && dA >= 0) return -1;
    if (dA < 0 && dB < 0) return dB - dA; // most recent first
    // Upcoming: sort by score within same day bucket
    const sameDayBucket = dA === dB;
    if (sameDayBucket || Math.abs(dA - dB) <= 2) {
      return (b.compositeScore ?? 0) - (a.compositeScore ?? 0);
    }
    return dA - dB;
  });

  const payload = { stocks: sorted, generatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
  cache = { data: payload, expiresAt: Date.now() + CACHE_TTL_MS };
  res.json(payload);
});

export default router;

/**
 * POST /screener/sessions/import-from-edgeai
 *
 * Fetches EdgeAI's public data.json, extracts SE market setups,
 * and creates a screener session — no copy-paste needed.
 */
import { Router, type IRouter } from "express";
import { and, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import {
  db,
  screenerSessionsTable,
  candidatesTable,
  top3SelectionSnapshotsTable,
} from "@workspace/db";
import YahooFinance from "yahoo-finance2";
import { resolveYahooTicker } from "../lib/omxs30TickerMap";
import { calculateWilderRsi } from "../lib/marketIndicators";
import { completedVolumeKey, fetchCompletedVolumeBatch } from "../lib/completedVolumeBatch";
import {
  edgeAiSessionDate,
  edgeAiDataFreshness,
  EdgeAiDataFreshnessError,
  fetchFreshEdgeAiData,
} from "../lib/edgeAiSource";
import { calendarDaysUntil } from "../lib/marketCalendar";
import { logger } from "../lib/logger";
import { withRetry } from "../lib/retry";
import {
  deduplicateCandidates,
  lockScreenerSession,
  mergeCandidateInputs,
  pendingCandidatesToRemove,
  synchronizeCandidates,
  candidateIdentity,
} from "../lib/candidateSynchronization";
import { mapEdgeAiSetup } from "../lib/edgeAiMapping";
import { aggregateSessionSource } from "../lib/candidateSynchronizationPolicy";
import { snapshotNewSessionTop3 } from "../lib/top3SelectionPolicy";

const yf = new YahooFinance({ suppressNotices: ["yahooSurvey", "ripHistorical"] });

const router: IRouter = Router();

function daysUntil(date: Date | number | null | undefined): number | null {
  return calendarDaysUntil(date);
}

router.post(
  "/screener/sessions/import-from-edgeai",
  async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
    // 1. Fetch latest EdgeAI data
    let edgeData: any;
    try {
      // A manual click should use the latest valid EdgeAI snapshot even when it
      // is from yesterday or a weekend. The freshness is returned to the UI as
      // a warning; the strict scheduler still uses the default behavior.
      edgeData = await fetchFreshEdgeAiData(10_000, { allowStale: true });
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (err instanceof EdgeAiDataFreshnessError) {
        res.status(422).json({ error: err.message, generatedAt: err.generatedAt });
        return;
      }
      res.status(502).json({ error: `Could not reach EdgeAI: ${err.message}` });
      return;
    }

    const markets = edgeData?.markets;
    const se = markets?.SE ?? {};
    const us = markets?.US ?? {};
    if (!markets || (!markets.SE && !markets.US)) {
      res.status(502).json({ error: "EdgeAI response missing SE market data" });
      return;
    }

    const setups: any[] = Array.isArray(se.setups) ? se.setups : [];
    const usRaw: any[] = Array.isArray(us.setups) ? us.setups : [];
    if (setups.length === 0 && usRaw.length === 0) {
      res.status(422).json({
        error: "EdgeAI has no SE or US setups in the latest snapshot.",
        generatedAt: edgeData.generatedAt,
      });
      return;
    }

    // The stored session date is the EdgeAI signal day, never the browser/server
    // clock. A manual import may intentionally use the latest prior trading day.
    const sessionDate = edgeAiSessionDate(edgeData);
    const freshness = edgeAiDataFreshness(edgeData);

    // 2b. Fetch OMXS30 market weather as it existed on the signal date.
    // A stale/manual EdgeAI import must not attach today's later market context
    // to an older signal, because that creates look-ahead bias in history.
    let omxsValue = 0, perf5d = 0, perf1m = 0, perf3m = 0, marketRsi = 0;
    try {
      const now = new Date();
      const todayUtc = now.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const signalDayStartMs = Date.parse(`${sessionDate}T00:00:00.000Z`);
      const historyEnd =
        sessionDate < todayUtc
          ? new Date(signalDayStartMs + 86_400_000)
          : now;
      const ninetyFiveDaysAgo = new Date(historyEnd.getTime() - 95 * 86_400_000);
      const history = await withRetry(() => yf.historical("^OMX", {
        period1: ninetyFiveDaysAgo,
        period2: historyEnd,
        interval: "1d",
      })) as Array<{ close: number }>;
      if (history.length > 0) {
        omxsValue = history[history.length - 1].close;
        if (history.length >= 6)  perf5d  = ((omxsValue - history[history.length - 6].close)  / history[history.length - 6].close)  * 100;
        if (history.length >= 22) perf1m  = ((omxsValue - history[history.length - 22].close) / history[history.length - 22].close) * 100;
        if (history.length >= 64) perf3m  = ((omxsValue - history[history.length - 64].close) / history[history.length - 64].close) * 100;
        marketRsi = calculateWilderRsi(history.map((bar) => Number(bar.close))) ?? 0;
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      logger.warn({ err: err.message }, "Manual EdgeAI import could not calculate OMXS30 weather");
    }

    // 3. Map setups → candidates (SE + US combined), rank each market separately.
    //    mapEdgeAiSetup is the single shared mapping function (see edgeAiMapping.ts) —
    //    also used by the scheduler auto-import, so both paths stay in sync. Computed
    //    up front (pure, no I/O) so the 409 conflict check below can preview exactly
    //    which pending candidates a force re-import would remove.
    const rankCounter: Record<string, number> = {};
    const mappedSetups = [
      ...setups.map((s: any) => mapEdgeAiSetup(s, "SE", rankCounter)),
      ...usRaw.map((s: any) => mapEdgeAiSetup(s, "US", rankCounter)),
    ];
    const { candidates: uniqueMappedSetups, skipped } = deduplicateCandidates(mappedSetups);
    uniqueMappedSetups.forEach((candidate) => {
      Object.assign(candidate, { signalSource: "edgeai" as const, signalDate: sessionDate });
    });
    if (skipped.length > 0) {
      logger.warn({ skipped }, "EdgeAI import skipped duplicate candidate identities");
    }

    // 4. Check for existing session (respect force flag)
    const force = req.body?.force === true;
    const existing = await db
      .select({ id: screenerSessionsTable.id, source: screenerSessionsTable.source })
      .from(screenerSessionsTable)
      .where(eq(screenerSessionsTable.date, sessionDate));

    if (existing.length > 0 && !force) {
      // Return same 409 shape as the regular import endpoint
      const existingId = existing[0].id;
      const existingRows = await db
        .select({
          id: candidatesTable.id,
          ticker: candidatesTable.ticker,
          category: candidatesTable.category,
          direction: candidatesTable.direction,
          market: candidatesTable.market,
          signalSource: candidatesTable.signalSource,
          outcome: candidatesTable.outcome,
          exitPrice: candidatesTable.exitPrice,
        })
        .from(candidatesTable)
        .where(eq(candidatesTable.sessionId, existingId));

      const affectedOutcomes = existingRows.filter((r) => r.outcome !== "PENDING");

      // Preview the exact effective input used by the force path. In
      // particular, candidates from a separate market or source are retained.
      const selectedSnapshotRows = await db
        .select({ candidateId: top3SelectionSnapshotsTable.candidateId })
        .from(top3SelectionSnapshotsTable)
        .where(and(
          eq(top3SelectionSnapshotsTable.sessionId, existingId),
          eq(top3SelectionSnapshotsTable.selected, true),
        ));
      const wouldRemove = pendingCandidatesToRemove(
        existingRows,
        uniqueMappedSetups,
        new Set(selectedSnapshotRows.map((row) => row.candidateId)),
      );

      res.status(409).json({
        error: `A session for ${sessionDate} already exists`,
        sessionId: existingId,
        date: sessionDate,
        affectedOutcomes,
        wouldRemove,
      });
      return;
    }

    if (existing.length > 0 && force) {
      const existingRows = await db
        .select()
        .from(candidatesTable)
        .where(eq(candidatesTable.sessionId, existing[0].id));
      const incomingByIdentity = new Map(
        uniqueMappedSetups.map((candidate) => [candidateIdentity(candidate), sessionDate] as const),
      );
      const mismatch = existingRows.find((candidate) =>
        candidate.signalDate != null &&
        incomingByIdentity.has(candidateIdentity(candidate)) &&
        incomingByIdentity.get(candidateIdentity(candidate)) !== candidate.signalDate,
      );
      if (mismatch) {
        res.status(409).json({
          error: `Signal date mismatch for ${mismatch.ticker}: stored ${mismatch.signalDate}, incoming ${sessionDate}`,
        });
        return;
      }
    }

    // Use the completed market-data day that produced the signal, not today's
    // partial live quote or the (possibly later) session/import date.
    const volumeRequests = uniqueMappedSetups.map((c) => ({
      ticker: c.ticker,
      market: c.market,
      asOfDate: String((c.market === "SE" ? se : us).dataAsOf ?? ""),
    }));
    const volumeMap = await fetchCompletedVolumeBatch(yf, volumeRequests);
    uniqueMappedSetups.forEach((c, index) => {
      const request = volumeRequests[index];
      const value = request.asOfDate <= sessionDate ? volumeMap.get(completedVolumeKey(request)) : null;
      if (value) {
        c.volMultiplier = value.multiplier;
        c.volumeAsOf = value.asOf;
      }
    });
    // Earnings calendar remains signal-time evidence only on the actual
    // import day; it does not reconstruct historical observations.
    await Promise.allSettled(
      uniqueMappedSetups.map(async (c) => {
        try {
          const isSignalDay = sessionDate === stockholmCalendarDate();
          if (isSignalDay) {
            const q = (await withRetry(() => yf.quote(resolveYahooTicker(c.ticker), {}, { validateResult: false }))) as any;
            const earningsInDays = daysUntil(q.earningsTimestamp);
            if (earningsInDays != null) {
              c.earningsInDays = earningsInDays;
              c.earningsKnowledge = "SIGNAL_TIME";
              c.earningsObservedAt = new Date();
            }
          }
        } catch (err: any) {
          logger.warn({ ticker: c.ticker, err: err.message }, "Volume enrichment failed");
        }
      }),
    );

    // 6. Handle force re-import: preserve existing outcomes
    let sessionId: number;

    if (existing.length > 0 && force) {
      const existingId = existing[0].id;
      sessionId = await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        await lockScreenerSession(tx, sessionDate);
        const existingCandidates = await tx
          .select()
          .from(candidatesTable)
          .where(eq(candidatesTable.sessionId, existingId));
        const [updated] = await tx
          .update(screenerSessionsTable)
          .set({
            trendLabel: se.regime?.label ?? "n/a",
            rawText: `EdgeAI import — generatedAt ${edgeData.generatedAt}`,
            omxsValue,
            perf5d,
            perf1m,
            perf3m,
            marketRsi,
          })
          .where(eq(screenerSessionsTable.id, existingId))
          .returning();
        const { candidates: synchronizedCandidates, diff } = await synchronizeCandidates(
          tx,
          updated.id,
          mergeCandidateInputs(
            uniqueMappedSetups,
            existingCandidates.map(({ id, createdAt, ...candidate }) => candidate),
          ),
        );
        const aggregateSource = aggregateSessionSource(
          existing[0].source,
          synchronizedCandidates.map((candidate) => candidate.signalSource),
        );
        await tx
          .update(screenerSessionsTable)
          .set({ lastImportDiff: diff, lastImportAt: new Date(), source: aggregateSource })
          .where(eq(screenerSessionsTable.id, updated.id));
        await snapshotNewSessionTop3(
          tx,
          { id: updated.id, date: sessionDate, source: aggregateSource },
          synchronizedCandidates,
        );
        return updated.id;
      });
    } else {
      // Fresh insert
      sessionId = await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        await lockScreenerSession(tx, sessionDate);
        const [alreadyStored] = await tx
          .select({ id: screenerSessionsTable.id })
          .from(screenerSessionsTable)
          .where(eq(screenerSessionsTable.date, sessionDate));
        if (alreadyStored) {
          throw new Error(`A session for ${sessionDate} already exists; refresh and use force to synchronize it`);
        }
        const [inserted] = await tx
          .insert(screenerSessionsTable)
          .values({
            date: sessionDate,
            omxsValue,
            perf5d,
            perf1m,
            perf3m,
            marketRsi,
            trendLabel: se.regime?.label ?? "n/a",
            rawText: `EdgeAI import — generatedAt ${edgeData.generatedAt}`,
            source: "edgeai",
            edgeRegime: JSON.stringify(se.regime ?? {}),
            edgeExpectancy: se.edge?.expectancyR ?? null,
            edgeWinRate: se.edge?.winRate != null
              ? (se.edge.winRate > 1 ? se.edge.winRate / 100 : se.edge.winRate)
              : null,
            edgePF: se.edge?.profitFactor ?? null,
            edgeN: se.edge?.n ?? null,
          })
          .returning();
        const { candidates: insertedCandidates } = await synchronizeCandidates(tx, inserted.id, uniqueMappedSetups);
        await snapshotNewSessionTop3(
          tx,
          { id: inserted.id, date: sessionDate, source: "edgeai" },
          insertedCandidates,
        );
        // Fresh insert: nothing existed before, so a diff would be all-"added" noise — skip it.
        return inserted.id;
      });
    }

    res.status(existing.length > 0 && force ? 200 : 201).json({
      id: sessionId,
      date: sessionDate,
      setupCount: uniqueMappedSetups.length,
      generatedAt: edgeData.generatedAt,
      stale: freshness.isDifferentUtcDate || freshness.ageMs > 30 * 60 * 60 * 1_000,
      ageDescription: freshness.ageDescription,
      regime: se.regime,
    });
  },
);

export default router;

function stockholmCalendarDate(): string {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("sv-SE", {
    timeZone: "Europe/Stockholm",
    year: "numeric",
    month: "2-digit",
    day: "2-digit",
  }).format(new Date());
}

/**
 * GET /market-intel
 * Returns Fear & Greed index (CNN) and trailing/forward P/E for major indices.
 * All data is free and cached 15 min server-side.
 */
import { Router, type IRouter } from "express";
import YahooFinance from "yahoo-finance2";

const router: IRouter = Router();
const yf = new YahooFinance({ suppressNotices: ["yahooSurvey", "ripHistorical"] });

interface MarketIntelData {
  fearGreed: {
    score: number;
    rating: string;
    previousClose: number;
    previousWeek: number;
    previousMonth: number;
  } | null;
  pe: {
    sp500: { trailing: number | null; forward: number | null };
    nasdaq: { trailing: number | null; forward: number | null };
    omxs30: { trailing: number | null; forward: number | null };
  };
  fetchedAt: string;
}

let cache: { data: MarketIntelData; ts: number } | null = null;
const CACHE_MS = 15 * 60_000; // 15 minutes

router.get("/market-intel", async (_req, res): Promise<void> => {
  if (cache && Date.now() - cache.ts < CACHE_MS) {
    res.json(cache.data);
    return;
  }

  const [fgResult, spyResult, qqqResult, omxResult] = await Promise.allSettled([
    fetch("https://production.dataviz.cnn.io/index/fearandgreed/graphdata", {
      headers: {
        "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; market-intel-proxy/1.0)",
        "Accept": "application/json",
      },
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8_000),
    }).then((r) => {
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`CNN F&G HTTP ${r.status}`);
      return r.json() as Promise<any>;
    }),
    yf.quoteSummary("SPY", { modules: ["summaryDetail"] }),
    yf.quoteSummary("QQQ", { modules: ["summaryDetail"] }),
    yf.quoteSummary("^OMX", { modules: ["summaryDetail"] }),
  ]);

  const fgRaw = fgResult.status === "fulfilled" ? fgResult.value : null;
  const spySummary = spyResult.status === "fulfilled" ? spyResult.value?.summaryDetail : null;
  const qqqSummary = qqqResult.status === "fulfilled" ? qqqResult.value?.summaryDetail : null;
  const omxSummary = omxResult.status === "fulfilled" ? omxResult.value?.summaryDetail : null;

  const data: MarketIntelData = {
    fearGreed: fgRaw?.fear_and_greed
      ? {
          score: Math.round(fgRaw.fear_and_greed.score ?? 0),
          rating: fgRaw.fear_and_greed.rating ?? "unknown",
          previousClose: Math.round(fgRaw.fear_and_greed.previous_close ?? 0),
          previousWeek: Math.round(fgRaw.fear_and_greed.previous_1_week ?? 0),
          previousMonth: Math.round(fgRaw.fear_and_greed.previous_1_month ?? 0),
        }
      : null,
    pe: {
      sp500: {
        trailing: spySummary?.trailingPE ?? null,
        forward: spySummary?.forwardPE ?? null,
      },
      nasdaq: {
        trailing: qqqSummary?.trailingPE ?? null,
        forward: qqqSummary?.forwardPE ?? null,
      },
      omxs30: {
        trailing: omxSummary?.trailingPE ?? null,
        forward: omxSummary?.forwardPE ?? null,
      },
    },
    fetchedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  cache = { data, ts: Date.now() };
  res.json(data);
});

export default router;



==============================================================================
FILE: artifacts/api-server/src/routes/news.ts
==============================================================================
import { Router, type IRouter } from "express";
import YahooFinance from "yahoo-finance2";
import { resolveYahooTicker } from "../lib/omxs30TickerMap";

const router: IRouter = Router();
const yf = new YahooFinance({ suppressNotices: ["yahooSurvey"] });

export interface NewsItem {
  uuid: string;
  title: string;
  publisher: string;
  link: string;
  publishedAt: number; // unix timestamp (seconds)
  relatedTickers?: string[];
}

// GET /screener/news?tickers=AAPL,ALFA
// Returns up to 5 news items per ticker (deduped by uuid across all tickers)
router.get("/screener/news", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const tickersParam = req.query.tickers;
  if (!tickersParam || typeof tickersParam !== "string") {
    res.status(400).json({ error: "tickers query param required" });
    return;
  }

  const tickers = tickersParam
    .split(",")
    .map((t) => t.trim())
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 26); // guard against too many

  // Fetch news for each ticker in parallel (search gives richer news than quote)
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const allNews: NewsItem[] = [];

  await Promise.all(
    tickers.map(async (ticker) => {
      const yahooTicker = resolveYahooTicker(ticker);
      try {
        const result = await yf.search(yahooTicker, { newsCount: 5 });
        for (const item of result.news ?? []) {
          if (seen.has(item.uuid)) continue;
          seen.add(item.uuid);
          allNews.push({
            uuid: item.uuid,
            title: item.title,
            publisher: item.publisher,
            link: item.link,
            publishedAt: item.providerPublishTime instanceof Date
              ? Math.floor(item.providerPublishTime.getTime() / 1000)
              : typeof item.providerPublishTime === "number"
                ? item.providerPublishTime
                : 0,
            relatedTickers: item.relatedTickers,
          });
        }
      } catch {
        // Non-fatal — ticker may have no news
      }
    }),
  );

  // Sort by newest first, cap at 20 total
  allNews.sort((a, b) => b.publishedAt - a.publishedAt);

  res.json(allNews.slice(0, 20));
});

export default router;

FILE: artifacts/api-server/src/routes/portfolio.ts
