/**
 * GET /api/portfolio
 *
 * Returns all open positions enriched with live Yahoo Finance quotes.
 * Each position is extended with:
 *   - livePrice, changePct
 *   - unrealised P&L in SEK and as a percentage
 *   - current R multiple (how many R the trade is currently up/down)
 *   - distance to stop (%) and distance to target (%)
 */
import { Router, type IRouter } from "express";
import { db, openPositionsTable } from "@workspace/db";
import { asc, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import YahooFinance from "yahoo-finance2";
import { resolveYahooTicker } from "../lib/omxs30TickerMap";
import {
  calculateProductPnl,
  countUnderlyingDirections,
  inferOwnedLeveragedProductSide,
} from "../lib/portfolioSemantics";

const router: IRouter = Router();
const yf = new YahooFinance({ suppressNotices: ["yahooSurvey", "ripHistorical"] });

type QuoteInfo = { livePrice: number | null; changePct: number | null; asOf: string | null };

async function fetchQuotes(tickers: string[]): Promise<Map<string, QuoteInfo>> {
  const map = new Map<string, QuoteInfo>();
  await Promise.allSettled(
    [...new Set(tickers)].map(async (ticker) => {
      try {
        const q = await yf.quote(resolveYahooTicker(ticker), {}, { validateResult: false }) as any;
        const marketTime: Date | null = q.regularMarketTime ?? null;
        map.set(ticker, {
          livePrice: q.regularMarketPrice ?? null,
          changePct: q.regularMarketChangePercent ?? null,
          asOf: marketTime instanceof Date ? marketTime.toISOString() : null,
        });
      } catch {
        map.set(ticker, { livePrice: null, changePct: null, asOf: null });
      }
    }),
  );
  return map;
}

router.get("/portfolio", async (_req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const positions = await db
    .select()
    .from(openPositionsTable)
    .orderBy(asc(openPositionsTable.createdAt));

  const fetchedAt = new Date().toISOString();

  if (positions.length === 0) {
    res.json({
      positions: [],
      summary: {
        count: 0,
        totalInvestedKr: 0,
        totalMarketValueKr: 0,
        totalUnrealisedKr: 0,
        totalUnrealisedPct: 0,
        maxStopLossKr: 0,
        longExposureKr: 0,
        shortExposureKr: 0,
        grossExposureKr: 0,
        netExposureKr: 0,
        underlyingLongCount: 0,
        underlyingShortCount: 0,
        underlyingDirectionUnknownCount: 0,
      },
      fetchedAt,
    });
    return;
  }

  const quoteMap = await fetchQuotes(
    positions.filter((p) => !p.instrument && !p.productType).map((p) => p.ticker),
  );

  const enriched = positions.map((p) => {
    const q = quoteMap.get(p.ticker) ?? { livePrice: null, changePct: null, asOf: null };
    const isProduct = p.instrument != null || p.productType != null;
    const live = isProduct ? (p.lastPrice ?? null) : q.livePrice;
    const changePct = isProduct ? null : q.changePct;
    // Instruments (leveraged products) are priced from the broker's last pasted
    // export, not a live feed — there is no market timestamp for those.
    const quoteAsOf = isProduct ? null : q.asOf;

    const effectiveProductSide = p.productSide ?? inferOwnedLeveragedProductSide(p.instrument) ?? p.direction;
    const isShort = effectiveProductSide === "SHORT";
    const risk1R = p.stopPrice != null ? Math.abs(p.entryPrice - p.stopPrice) : null;
    // Stop P&L is signed and applies to every valid stop, including
    // break-even, profit-locking, and trailing stops.
    const stopPnlKr = p.stopPrice != null
      ? (isShort ? p.entryPrice - p.stopPrice : p.stopPrice - p.entryPrice) * p.shares
      : null;
    const stopPnlPct = p.stopPrice != null
      ? (isShort ? p.entryPrice - p.stopPrice : p.stopPrice - p.entryPrice) / p.entryPrice * 100
      : null;
    // Only a stop on the loss side is a protective stop. Do not present a
    // profit-locking or incorrectly placed stop as a maximum potential loss.
    const hasProtectiveStop = stopPnlKr != null && stopPnlKr < 0;
    const riskToStopKr = hasProtectiveStop ? Math.abs(p.entryPrice - p.stopPrice!) * p.shares : null;
    const riskToStopPct = hasProtectiveStop
      ? (Math.abs(p.entryPrice - p.stopPrice!) / p.entryPrice) * 100
      : null;

    // Unrealised P&L
    let unrealisedPct: number | null = null;
    let unrealisedKr: number | null = null;
    let currentR: number | null = null;
    let distToStop: number | null = null;
    let distToTarget: number | null = null;

    if (live != null) {
      const pnl = calculateProductPnl(p.entryPrice, live, p.shares, p.productSide, p.direction, p.instrument);
      unrealisedPct = pnl.unrealisedPct;
      unrealisedKr = pnl.unrealisedKr;
      const priceDelta = (pnl.unrealisedKr ?? 0) / p.shares;
      if (risk1R != null && risk1R > 0) currentR = priceDelta / risk1R;

      if (p.stopPrice != null) {
        distToStop = isShort
          ? ((p.stopPrice - live) / live) * 100   // how far above live price stop is
          : ((live - p.stopPrice) / live) * 100;  // how far below live price stop is
      }
      if (p.targetPrice != null) {
        distToTarget = isShort
          ? ((live - p.targetPrice) / live) * 100  // how far to fall to target
          : ((p.targetPrice - live) / live) * 100; // how far to rise to target
      }
    }

    const positionSizeKr = p.entryPrice * p.shares;
    const marketValueKr = live != null ? live * p.shares : null;

    return {
      id: p.id,
      ticker: p.ticker,
      instrument: p.instrument ?? null,
      direction: p.direction,
      productType: p.productType ?? null,
      productSide: p.productSide ?? null,
      underlyingDirection: p.underlyingDirection ?? null,
      underlyingTicker: p.underlyingTicker ?? null,
      indicativeLeverage: p.indicativeLeverage ?? null,
      financingLevel: p.financingLevel ?? null,
      barrierLevel: p.barrierLevel ?? null,
      barrierType: p.barrierType ?? null,
      market: p.market ?? null,
      notes: p.notes ?? null,
      entryPrice: p.entryPrice,
      lastPrice: p.lastPrice ?? null,
      stopPrice: p.stopPrice ?? null,
      targetPrice: p.targetPrice ?? null,
      shares: p.shares,
      positionSizeKr,
      risk1R: risk1R != null ? risk1R * p.shares : null,
      riskToStopKr: riskToStopKr != null ? +riskToStopKr.toFixed(0) : null,
      riskToStopPct: riskToStopPct != null ? +riskToStopPct.toFixed(2) : null,
      stopPnlKr: stopPnlKr != null ? +stopPnlKr.toFixed(0) : null,
      stopPnlPct: stopPnlPct != null ? +stopPnlPct.toFixed(2) : null,
      createdAt: p.createdAt,
      livePrice: live,
      changePct,
      quoteAsOf,
      unrealisedPct: unrealisedPct != null ? +unrealisedPct.toFixed(2) : null,
      unrealisedKr: unrealisedKr != null ? +unrealisedKr.toFixed(0) : null,
      currentR: currentR != null ? +currentR.toFixed(2) : null,
      marketValueKr,
      distToStop: distToStop != null ? +distToStop.toFixed(2) : null,
      distToTarget: distToTarget != null ? +distToTarget.toFixed(2) : null,
    };
  });

  const totalUnrealisedKr = enriched.reduce((s, p) => s + (p.unrealisedKr ?? 0), 0);
  const totalMarketValueKr = enriched.reduce((s, p) => s + (p.marketValueKr ?? p.positionSizeKr), 0);
  const totalInvestedKr = enriched.reduce((s, p) => s + p.positionSizeKr, 0);
  const hasPositionWithoutStop = enriched.some((position) => position.stopPrice == null);
  const maxStopLossKr = hasPositionWithoutStop
    ? null
    : enriched.reduce(
        (sum, position) => sum + Math.max(0, -(position.stopPnlKr ?? 0)),
        0,
      );
  const longExposureKr = enriched
    .filter((p) => p.direction === "LONG")
    .reduce((s, p) => s + (p.marketValueKr ?? p.positionSizeKr), 0);
  const shortExposureKr = enriched
    .filter((p) => p.direction === "SHORT")
    .reduce((s, p) => s + (p.marketValueKr ?? p.positionSizeKr), 0);
  const underlyingDirectionCounts = countUnderlyingDirections(positions.map((p) => p.underlyingDirection));

  res.json({
    positions: enriched,
    summary: {
      count: enriched.length,
      totalInvestedKr: +totalInvestedKr.toFixed(0),
      totalMarketValueKr: +totalMarketValueKr.toFixed(0),
      totalUnrealisedKr: +totalUnrealisedKr.toFixed(0),
      totalUnrealisedPct: totalInvestedKr > 0 ? +((totalUnrealisedKr / totalInvestedKr) * 100).toFixed(2) : 0,
      maxStopLossKr: maxStopLossKr != null ? +maxStopLossKr.toFixed(0) : null,
      longExposureKr: +longExposureKr.toFixed(0),
      shortExposureKr: +shortExposureKr.toFixed(0),
      grossExposureKr: +(longExposureKr + shortExposureKr).toFixed(0),
      netExposureKr: +(longExposureKr - shortExposureKr).toFixed(0),
      ...underlyingDirectionCounts,
    },
    fetchedAt,
  });
});

// POST /portfolio  — add position
router.post("/portfolio", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const {
    ticker, instrument, direction, productType, productSide, underlyingDirection, underlyingTicker,
    indicativeLeverage, financingLevel, barrierLevel, barrierType,
    entryPrice, shares, stopPrice, targetPrice, market, notes,
  } = req.body ?? {};
  if (
    typeof ticker !== "string" || !ticker.trim() ||
    !["LONG", "SHORT"].includes(direction) ||
    typeof entryPrice !== "number" || !isFinite(entryPrice) || entryPrice <= 0 ||
    typeof shares !== "number" || !isFinite(shares) || shares <= 0
  ) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: "Ogiltiga fält: ticker, direction, entryPrice och shares krävs." });
    return;
  }
  if ((productSide != null && !["LONG", "SHORT"].includes(productSide)) ||
      (underlyingDirection != null && !["LONG", "SHORT"].includes(underlyingDirection))) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: "Ogiltig produkt- eller underliggande riktning." });
    return;
  }
  for (const [name, value] of Object.entries({ indicativeLeverage, financingLevel, barrierLevel })) {
    if (value != null && (typeof value !== "number" || !isFinite(value) || value <= 0)) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: `Ogiltigt värde för ${name}.` });
      return;
    }
  }
  const [pos] = await db
    .insert(openPositionsTable)
    .values({
      ticker: ticker.trim().toUpperCase(),
      instrument: typeof instrument === "string" && instrument.trim() ? instrument.trim() : null,
      direction,
      productType: typeof productType === "string" && productType.trim() ? productType.trim() : null,
      productSide: productSide ?? null,
      underlyingDirection: underlyingDirection ?? null,
      underlyingTicker: typeof underlyingTicker === "string" && underlyingTicker.trim() ? underlyingTicker.trim().toUpperCase() : null,
      indicativeLeverage: indicativeLeverage ?? null,
      financingLevel: financingLevel ?? null,
      barrierLevel: barrierLevel ?? null,
      barrierType: typeof barrierType === "string" && barrierType.trim() ? barrierType.trim() : null,
      entryPrice,
      lastPrice: null,
      shares,
      stopPrice: typeof stopPrice === "number" && isFinite(stopPrice) && stopPrice > 0 ? stopPrice : null,
      targetPrice: typeof targetPrice === "number" && isFinite(targetPrice) && targetPrice > 0 ? targetPrice : null,
      market: typeof market === "string" && market ? market.toUpperCase() : null,
      notes: typeof notes === "string" && notes.trim() ? notes.trim() : null,
    })
    .returning();
  res.status(201).json(pos);
});

// PATCH /portfolio/:id — edit an existing open position in place (no delete + re-add).
router.patch("/portfolio/:id", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const id = Number(req.params.id);
  if (isNaN(id)) { res.status(400).json({ error: "Ogiltigt id" }); return; }

  const [existing] = await db.select().from(openPositionsTable).where(eq(openPositionsTable.id, id));
  if (!existing) { res.status(404).json({ error: "Position hittades inte" }); return; }

  const {
    ticker, instrument, direction, productType, productSide, underlyingDirection, underlyingTicker,
    indicativeLeverage, financingLevel, barrierLevel, barrierType,
    entryPrice, shares, stopPrice, targetPrice, market, notes,
  } = req.body ?? {};
  const updates: Partial<typeof openPositionsTable.$inferInsert> = {};

  if (ticker !== undefined) {
    if (typeof ticker !== "string" || !ticker.trim()) { res.status(400).json({ error: "Ogiltig ticker." }); return; }
    updates.ticker = ticker.trim().toUpperCase();
  }
  if (instrument !== undefined) {
    updates.instrument = typeof instrument === "string" && instrument.trim() ? instrument.trim() : null;
  }
  if (direction !== undefined) {
    if (!["LONG", "SHORT"].includes(direction)) { res.status(400).json({ error: "Ogiltig riktning." }); return; }
    updates.direction = direction;
  }
  if (productType !== undefined) {
    updates.productType = typeof productType === "string" && productType.trim() ? productType.trim() : null;
  }
  for (const [field, value] of [["productSide", productSide], ["underlyingDirection", underlyingDirection]] as const) {
    if (value !== undefined) {
      if (value !== null && !["LONG", "SHORT"].includes(value)) {
        res.status(400).json({ error: "Ogiltig produkt- eller underliggande riktning." });
        return;
      }
      updates[field] = value;
    }
  }
  if (underlyingTicker !== undefined) {
    updates.underlyingTicker = typeof underlyingTicker === "string" && underlyingTicker.trim()
      ? underlyingTicker.trim().toUpperCase()
      : null;
  }
  for (const [field, value] of [["indicativeLeverage", indicativeLeverage], ["financingLevel", financingLevel], ["barrierLevel", barrierLevel]] as const) {
    if (value !== undefined) {
      if (value !== null && (typeof value !== "number" || !isFinite(value) || value <= 0)) {
        res.status(400).json({ error: `Ogiltigt värde för ${field}.` });
        return;
      }
      updates[field] = value;
    }
  }
  if (barrierType !== undefined) {
    updates.barrierType = typeof barrierType === "string" && barrierType.trim() ? barrierType.trim() : null;
  }
  if (entryPrice !== undefined) {
    if (typeof entryPrice !== "number" || !isFinite(entryPrice) || entryPrice <= 0) { res.status(400).json({ error: "Ogiltigt entry-pris." }); return; }
    updates.entryPrice = entryPrice;
  }
  if (shares !== undefined) {
    if (typeof shares !== "number" || !isFinite(shares) || shares <= 0) { res.status(400).json({ error: "Ogiltigt antal aktier." }); return; }
    updates.shares = shares;
  }
  if (stopPrice !== undefined) {
    updates.stopPrice = typeof stopPrice === "number" && isFinite(stopPrice) && stopPrice > 0 ? stopPrice : null;
  }
  if (targetPrice !== undefined) {
    updates.targetPrice = typeof targetPrice === "number" && isFinite(targetPrice) && targetPrice > 0 ? targetPrice : null;
  }
  if (market !== undefined) {
    updates.market = typeof market === "string" && market ? market.toUpperCase() : null;
  }
  if (notes !== undefined) {
    updates.notes = typeof notes === "string" && notes.trim() ? notes.trim() : null;
  }

  if (Object.keys(updates).length === 0) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: "Inga fält att uppdatera." });
    return;
  }

  const [updated] = await db
    .update(openPositionsTable)
    .set(updates)
    .where(eq(openPositionsTable.id, id))
    .returning();
  res.json(updated);
});

// POST /portfolio/import — update positions from a pasted broker export.
// Existing positions are matched by underlying ticker + instrument, so repeating
// an import refreshes the position instead of creating another row.
router.post("/portfolio/import", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const entries = req.body?.entries;
  if (!Array.isArray(entries) || entries.length === 0 || entries.length > 100) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: "Minst en och högst 100 positioner krävs." });
    return;
  }

  const validEntries: Array<{
    ticker: string;
    instrument: string;
    direction: "LONG" | "SHORT";
    productSide: "LONG" | "SHORT" | null;
    underlyingDirection: "LONG" | "SHORT" | null;
    entryPrice: number;
    lastPrice: number;
    shares: number;
    market: string | null;
  }> = [];

  for (const entry of entries) {
    if (
      typeof entry?.ticker !== "string" || !entry.ticker.trim() ||
      typeof entry?.instrument !== "string" || !entry.instrument.trim() ||
      !["LONG", "SHORT"].includes(entry.direction) ||
      typeof entry?.entryPrice !== "number" || !isFinite(entry.entryPrice) || entry.entryPrice <= 0 ||
      typeof entry?.lastPrice !== "number" || !isFinite(entry.lastPrice) || entry.lastPrice <= 0 ||
      typeof entry?.shares !== "number" || !isFinite(entry.shares) || entry.shares <= 0
    ) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: "Varje importposition måste ha ticker, instrument, riktning, antal, inköpskurs och aktuell kurs." });
      return;
    }
    for (const [field, value] of [["productSide", entry.productSide], ["underlyingDirection", entry.underlyingDirection]] as const) {
      if (value !== undefined && value !== null && !["LONG", "SHORT"].includes(value)) {
        res.status(400).json({ error: `Ogiltig riktning för ${field}.` });
        return;
      }
    }
    validEntries.push({
      ticker: entry.ticker.trim().toUpperCase(),
      instrument: entry.instrument.trim(),
      direction: entry.direction,
      productSide: entry.productSide ?? inferOwnedLeveragedProductSide(entry.instrument.trim()),
      underlyingDirection: entry.underlyingDirection ?? null,
      entryPrice: entry.entryPrice,
      lastPrice: entry.lastPrice,
      shares: entry.shares,
      market: typeof entry.market === "string" && entry.market.trim() ? entry.market.trim().toUpperCase() : null,
    });
  }

  const existing = await db.select().from(openPositionsTable);
  let created = 0;
  let updated = 0;

  for (const entry of validEntries) {
    const match = existing.find((position) =>
      position.ticker.toUpperCase() === entry.ticker &&
      (position.instrument ?? "").trim().toLowerCase() === entry.instrument.toLowerCase(),
    );

    if (match) {
      await db
        .update(openPositionsTable)
        .set({
          direction: entry.direction,
          productSide: entry.productSide ?? match.productSide,
          underlyingDirection: entry.underlyingDirection ?? match.underlyingDirection,
          entryPrice: entry.entryPrice,
          lastPrice: entry.lastPrice,
          shares: entry.shares,
          market: entry.market ?? match.market,
        })
        .where(eq(openPositionsTable.id, match.id));
      updated++;
    } else {
      const [createdPosition] = await db
        .insert(openPositionsTable)
        .values({
          ticker: entry.ticker,
          instrument: entry.instrument,
          direction: entry.direction,
          productSide: entry.productSide,
          underlyingDirection: entry.underlyingDirection,
          entryPrice: entry.entryPrice,
          lastPrice: entry.lastPrice,
          shares: entry.shares,
          market: entry.market,
          stopPrice: null,
          targetPrice: null,
          notes: null,
        })
        .returning();
      existing.push(createdPosition);
      created++;
    }
  }

  res.status(200).json({ created, updated, total: validEntries.length });
});

// DELETE /portfolio/:id
router.delete("/portfolio/:id", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const id = Number(req.params.id);
  if (isNaN(id)) { res.status(400).json({ error: "Ogiltigt id" }); return; }
  const [deleted] = await db
    .delete(openPositionsTable)
    .where(eq(openPositionsTable.id, id))
    .returning();
  if (!deleted) { res.status(404).json({ error: "Position hittades inte" }); return; }
  res.sendStatus(204);
});

/**
 * GET /api/screener/price-chart/:ticker?days=N
 *
 * Returns daily OHLCV candles + pre-computed Bollinger Bands (20-period, 2σ)
 * + RSI(14).  Default display window = 90 days, max 365.
 *
 * Ticker may be a bare symbol (AAPL, ERIC-B) or include .ST suffix — both accepted.
 */
import { Router, type IRouter } from "express";
import YahooFinance from "yahoo-finance2";
import { resolveYahooTicker } from "../lib/omxs30TickerMap";

const router: IRouter = Router();
const yf = new YahooFinance({ suppressNotices: ["yahooSurvey", "ripHistorical"] });

// ── Bollinger Bands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function computeBollinger(
  closes: number[],
  period = 20,
  multiplier = 2,
): { upper: number | null; middle: number | null; lower: number | null }[] {
  return closes.map((_, i) => {
    if (i < period - 1) return { upper: null, middle: null, lower: null };
    const slice = closes.slice(i - period + 1, i + 1);
    const sma = slice.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / period;
    const variance = slice.reduce((a, b) => a + (b - sma) ** 2, 0) / period;
    const std = Math.sqrt(variance);
    return {
      upper: Number((sma + multiplier * std).toFixed(4)),
      middle: Number(sma.toFixed(4)),
      lower: Number((sma - multiplier * std).toFixed(4)),
    };
  });
}

// ── RSI ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function computeRSI(closes: number[], period = 14): (number | null)[] {
  const result: (number | null)[] = new Array(closes.length).fill(null);
  if (closes.length <= period) return result;

  // Build gains / losses arrays (length = closes.length - 1)
  const gains: number[] = [];
  const losses: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 1; i < closes.length; i++) {
    const diff = closes[i] - closes[i - 1];
    gains.push(diff > 0 ? diff : 0);
    losses.push(diff < 0 ? -diff : 0);
  }

  // Seed using simple average of first `period` changes → RSI for close[period]
  let avgGain = gains.slice(0, period).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / period;
  let avgLoss = losses.slice(0, period).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / period;
  const rs0 = avgLoss === 0 ? Infinity : avgGain / avgLoss;
  result[period] = avgLoss === 0 ? 100 : Number((100 - 100 / (1 + rs0)).toFixed(2));

  // Wilder smooth for the rest
  for (let i = period; i < gains.length; i++) {
    avgGain = (avgGain * (period - 1) + gains[i]) / period;
    avgLoss = (avgLoss * (period - 1) + losses[i]) / period;
    const rs = avgLoss === 0 ? Infinity : avgGain / avgLoss;
    result[i + 1] = avgLoss === 0 ? 100 : Number((100 - 100 / (1 + rs)).toFixed(2));
  }

  return result;
}

router.get("/screener/price-chart/:ticker", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const raw = req.params.ticker;
  const yahoo = resolveYahooTicker(raw);

  // Display window: default 90, capped at 365
  const reqDays = parseInt(String(req.query.days ?? "90"), 10);
  const displayDays = Math.min(Math.max(isNaN(reqDays) ? 90 : reqDays, 10), 365);

  // Fetch enough history for BB(20) + RSI(14) warmup
  const warmup = 34; // 20 (BB) + 14 (RSI) = 34, round up to be safe
  const fetchDays = displayDays + warmup + 10; // extra buffer for weekends/holidays

  const end = new Date();
  const start = new Date(end.getTime() - fetchDays * 86_400_000);

  let history: { date: Date; open: number; high: number; low: number; close: number; volume: number }[];
  try {
    history = (await yf.historical(yahoo, {
      period1: start,
      period2: end,
      interval: "1d",
    })) as typeof history;
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(502).json({ error: `Yahoo Finance error: ${err.message}` });
    return;
  }

  if (!history || history.length === 0) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: "No price data found for " + yahoo });
    return;
  }

  // Sort ascending
  history.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.date).getTime() - new Date(b.date).getTime());

  // Build full candle array
  const allCandles = history.map((h) => ({
    time: new Date(h.date).toISOString().slice(0, 10),
    open: Number(h.open?.toFixed(4) ?? h.close),
    high: Number(h.high?.toFixed(4) ?? h.close),
    low: Number(h.low?.toFixed(4) ?? h.close),
    close: Number(h.close?.toFixed(4)),
    volume: h.volume ?? 0,
  }));

  const closes = history.map((h) => h.close);

  // Compute indicators over full history
  const bb = computeBollinger(closes, 20, 2);
  const rsiAll = computeRSI(closes, 14);

  // Trim to display window
  const displayCount = Math.min(displayDays, allCandles.length);
  const displayFrom = allCandles.length - displayCount;

  const displayCandles = allCandles.slice(displayFrom);
  const displayBB = bb.slice(displayFrom);
  const displayRSI = rsiAll.slice(displayFrom);

  // Bollinger: filter nulls
  const upper = displayBB
    .map((b, i) => (b.upper != null ? { time: displayCandles[i].time, value: b.upper } : null))
    .filter(Boolean) as { time: string; value: number }[];
  const middle = displayBB
    .map((b, i) => (b.middle != null ? { time: displayCandles[i].time, value: b.middle } : null))
    .filter(Boolean) as { time: string; value: number }[];
  const lower = displayBB
    .map((b, i) => (b.lower != null ? { time: displayCandles[i].time, value: b.lower } : null))
    .filter(Boolean) as { time: string; value: number }[];

  // RSI: filter nulls
  const rsi = displayRSI
    .map((v, i) => (v != null ? { time: displayCandles[i].time, value: v } : null))
    .filter(Boolean) as { time: string; value: number }[];

  res.json({
    ticker: raw.toUpperCase(),
    yahooTicker: yahoo,
    candles: displayCandles,
    bollinger: { upper, middle, lower },
    rsi,
  });
});

export default router;

import { Router, type IRouter } from "express";
import YahooFinance from "yahoo-finance2";
import { resolveYahooTicker } from "../lib/omxs30TickerMap";

const router: IRouter = Router();
const yf = new YahooFinance({ suppressNotices: ["yahooSurvey", "ripHistorical"] });

/** How many calendar days from today until `ts` (yahoo-finance2 returns a Date). Negative = past. */
function daysUntil(ts: Date | number | undefined | null): number | null {
  if (ts == null) return null;
  const ms = ts instanceof Date ? ts.getTime() : ts * 1000;
  if (!ms || isNaN(ms)) return null;
  const todayUtc = new Date();
  todayUtc.setUTCHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  return Math.round((ms - todayUtc.getTime()) / 86_400_000);
}

// GET /screener/quotes?tickers=SSAB,Getinge,SEB
router.get("/screener/quotes", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const tickersParam = req.query.tickers;
  if (!tickersParam || typeof tickersParam !== "string") {
    res.status(400).json({ error: "tickers query parameter is required (comma-separated)" });
    return;
  }

  const tickers = tickersParam
    .split(",")
    .map((t) => t.trim())
    .filter(Boolean);

  if (tickers.length === 0) {
    res.json([]);
    return;
  }

  const fetchedAt = new Date().toISOString();

  const results = await Promise.all(
    tickers.map(async (ticker) => {
      const yahooTicker = resolveYahooTicker(ticker);
      try {
        const quote = await yf.quote(yahooTicker);
        const earningsTs: Date | null = (quote as any).earningsTimestamp ?? null;
        const earningsInDays = daysUntil(earningsTs);
        const earningsDate =
          earningsTs instanceof Date
            ? earningsTs.toISOString().slice(0, 10)
            : null;
        // regularMarketTime is when Yahoo's underlying price was last updated —
        // this can lag far behind `fetchedAt` outside market hours or on stale feeds.
        const marketTime: Date | null = (quote as any).regularMarketTime ?? null;
        const asOf = marketTime instanceof Date ? marketTime.toISOString() : null;
        return {
          ticker,
          yahooTicker,
          livePrice: quote.regularMarketPrice ?? null,
          change: quote.regularMarketChange ?? null,
          changePct: quote.regularMarketChangePercent ?? null,
          marketState: quote.marketState ?? null,
          asOf,
          fetchedAt,
          earningsDate,
          earningsInDays,
          error: null,
        };
      } catch {
        return {
          ticker,
          yahooTicker,
          livePrice: null,
          change: null,
          changePct: null,
          marketState: null,
          asOf: null,
          fetchedAt,
          earningsDate: null,
          earningsInDays: null,
          error: `Could not fetch quote for ${yahooTicker}`,
        };
      }
    })
  );

  res.json(results);
});

export default router;

import { Router, type IRouter } from "express";

// POST /screener/sessions/import
router.post("/screener/sessions/import", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const parsed = ImportSessionBody.safeParse(req.body);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: parsed.error.message });
    return;
  }

  let session;
  try {
    session = parseScreenerText(parsed.data.rawText);
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof ScreenerParseError) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: err.message });
      return;
    }
    throw err;
  }

  const reportDate = session.date;
  if (parsed.data.targetDate) {
    const targetDate = parsed.data.targetDate instanceof Date
      ? parsed.data.targetDate.toISOString().slice(0, 10)
      : parsed.data.targetDate;
    session = { ...session, date: targetDate };
  }

  // Check for duplicate date
  const existing = await db
    .select({ id: screenerSessionsTable.id, source: screenerSessionsTable.source })
    .from(screenerSessionsTable)
    .where(eq(screenerSessionsTable.date, session.date));

  const { force } = parsed.data;
  // A force import may update a trading/display session, but cannot rewrite a
  // candidate's source-day provenance.
  if (existing.length > 0 && force) {
    const existingRows = await db
      .select()
      .from(candidatesTable)
      .where(eq(candidatesTable.sessionId, existing[0].id));
    const incomingByIdentity = new Map(
      session.candidates.map((candidate) => {
        const row = { ...candidate, market: "SE", signalSource: "manual" };
        return [candidateIdentity(row), reportDate] as const;
      }),
    );
    const mismatch = existingRows.find((row) =>
      row.signalDate != null &&
      incomingByIdentity.has(candidateIdentity(row)) &&
      incomingByIdentity.get(candidateIdentity(row)) !== row.signalDate,
    );
    if (mismatch) {
      res.status(409).json({
        error: `Signal date mismatch for ${mismatch.ticker}: stored ${mismatch.signalDate}, incoming ${reportDate}`,
      });
      return;
    }
  }
  {
    const { skipped } = deduplicateCandidates(
      session.candidates.map((candidate) => ({ ...candidate, market: "SE" })),
    );
    if (skipped.length > 0) {
      logger.warn({ skipped }, "Screener import skipped duplicate candidates");
    }
  }

  if (existing.length > 0 && !force) {
    // Return 409 with details about any logged outcomes so the UI can show
    // exactly what would be preserved on a force re-import — and which
    // still-pending candidates would be REMOVED because they're absent from
    // this new import (logged outcomes are never removed).
    const existingId = existing[0].id;
    const existingRows = await db
      .select({
        id: candidatesTable.id,
        ticker: candidatesTable.ticker,
        category: candidatesTable.category,
        direction: candidatesTable.direction,
        market: candidatesTable.market,
        signalSource: candidatesTable.signalSource,
        outcome: candidatesTable.outcome,
        exitPrice: candidatesTable.exitPrice,
      })
      .from(candidatesTable)
      .where(eq(candidatesTable.sessionId, existingId));

    const affectedOutcomes = existingRows.filter((r) => r.outcome !== "PENDING");
    const selectedSnapshotRows = await db
      .select({ candidateId: top3SelectionSnapshotsTable.candidateId })
      .from(top3SelectionSnapshotsTable)
      .where(and(
        eq(top3SelectionSnapshotsTable.sessionId, existingId),
        eq(top3SelectionSnapshotsTable.selected, true),
      ));

    const wouldRemove = pendingCandidatesToRemove(
      existingRows as Array<typeof existingRows[number] & { category: string }>,
      session.candidates.map((c) => ({ ...c, market: "SE" })),
      new Set(selectedSnapshotRows.map((row) => row.candidateId)),
    );

    res.status(409).json({
      error: `A session for ${session.date} already exists`,
      sessionId: existingId,
      date: session.date,
      affectedOutcomes,
      wouldRemove,
    });
    return;
  }

  // ---------- helpers shared by both insert and force-update paths ----------
  // The parsed report date remains the source date even when a manual paste
  // is explicitly assigned to today's session for trading.
  const volMap = await enrichVolMultiplier(session.candidates.map((c) => c.ticker), _yf, reportDate);

  const buildCandidateRow = (
    sessionId: number,
    c: (typeof session.candidates)[number],
    earnings: EarningsObservation,
    preserved?: {
      outcome: string; exitPrice: number | null; outcomeNotes: string | null;
      resolutionMethod: "MANUAL_EXIT" | "TARGET_HIT" | "STOP_HIT" | "TIME_EXIT" | null;
      resolutionQuality: "RECORDED_EXIT" | "ASSUMED_LEVEL" | "LEGACY_UNKNOWN" | null;
      realizedR: number | null;
    },
  ) => ({
    sessionId,
    signalDate: reportDate,
    market: "SE" as const,   // screener text is always SE stocks
    signalSource: "manual" as const,
    category: c.category,
    rank: c.rank,
    ticker: c.ticker,
    price: c.price,
    rs3m: c.rs3m,
    perf1m: c.perf1m,
    rsi: c.rsi,
    pctB: c.pctB,
    atr: c.atr,
    volMultiplier: volMap.get(c.ticker)?.multiplier ?? 0,
    volumeAsOf: volMap.get(c.ticker)?.asOf ?? null,
    signalRsi: c.rsi,
    signalGapPct: c.gapWarning ?? null,
    edgeWinRate: null,
    edgeExpectancyR: null,
    edgeSampleN: null,
    signalAgeBars: null,
    maxHoldDays: c.category === "SQUEEZE" ? 15 : c.category === "STUDS" ? 5 : 10,
    distFrom20dH: c.distFrom20dH,
    gapWarning: c.gapWarning ?? undefined,
    earningsInDays: earnings.earningsInDays ?? undefined,
    earningsKnowledge: earnings.knowledge,
    earningsObservedAt: earnings.observedAt,
    direction: c.direction,
    entryPrice: c.entryPrice,
    stopPrice: c.stopPrice,
    targetPrice: c.targetPrice,
    rr: c.rr,
    oneR: c.oneR,
    outcome: (preserved?.outcome ?? "PENDING") as "WIN" | "LOSS" | "TIME_EXIT" | "SKIP" | "PENDING",
    exitPrice: preserved?.exitPrice ?? null,
    outcomeNotes: preserved?.outcomeNotes ?? null,
    resolutionMethod: preserved?.resolutionMethod ?? null,
    resolutionQuality: preserved?.resolutionQuality ?? null,
    realizedR: preserved?.realizedR ?? null,
  });

  const earningsBatch = await fetchEarningsBatch(
    session.candidates.map((c) => c.ticker),
    reportDate,
  );

  // ---------- force re-import: preserve outcomes, replace everything else ----------
  if (existing.length > 0 && force) {
    const existingId = existing[0].id;
    const { updatedSession, updatedCandidates, diff } = await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await lockScreenerSession(tx, session.date);
      // Re-read under the same lock used by outcome mutation; a pre-lock copy
      // could otherwise merge stale PENDING/null resolution fields.
      const existingCandidates = await tx
        .select()
        .from(candidatesTable)
        .where(eq(candidatesTable.sessionId, existingId));
      const [updatedSession] = await tx
        .update(screenerSessionsTable)
        .set({
          omxsValue: session.marketWeather.omxsValue,
          perf5d: session.marketWeather.perf5d,
          perf1m: session.marketWeather.perf1m,
          perf3m: session.marketWeather.perf3m,
          marketRsi: session.marketWeather.rsi,
          trendLabel: session.marketWeather.trendLabel,
          rawText: parsed.data.rawText,
        })
        .where(eq(screenerSessionsTable.id, existingId))
        .returning();
      const incomingRows = mergeCandidateInputs(
        session.candidates.map((candidate) =>
          buildCandidateRow(updatedSession.id, candidate, earningsBatch.get(candidate.ticker) ?? UNKNOWN_EARNINGS),
        ),
        existingCandidates.map(({ id, ...candidate }) => candidate as any),
      );
      const { candidates: updatedCandidates, diff } = await synchronizeCandidates(tx, updatedSession.id, incomingRows);
      const aggregateSource = aggregateSessionSource(
        updatedSession.source,
        updatedCandidates.map((candidate) => candidate.signalSource),
      );
      await tx
        .update(screenerSessionsTable)
        .set({ lastImportDiff: diff, lastImportAt: new Date(), source: aggregateSource })
        .where(eq(screenerSessionsTable.id, updatedSession.id));
      await snapshotNewSessionTop3(
        tx,
        { id: updatedSession.id, date: updatedSession.date, source: aggregateSource },
        updatedCandidates,
      );
      return { updatedSession: { ...updatedSession, source: aggregateSource }, updatedCandidates, diff };
    });

    const linkedIds = await fetchLinkedTradeIds(updatedCandidates.map((c: any) => c.id));
    const response = ImportSessionResponse.parse({
      id: updatedSession.id,
      date: updatedSession.date,
      source: updatedSession.source ?? null,
      createdAt: updatedSession.createdAt ?? null,
      lastImportAt: updatedSession.lastImportAt ?? null,
      marketWeather: {
        omxsValue: updatedSession.omxsValue,
        perf5d: updatedSession.perf5d,
        perf1m: updatedSession.perf1m,
        perf3m: updatedSession.perf3m,
        rsi: updatedSession.marketRsi,
        trendLabel: updatedSession.trendLabel,
      },
      candidates: updatedCandidates.map((c: any) => mapCandidate(c, linkedIds.has(c.id))),
      importDiff: diff,
    });

    res.status(200).json(response);
    return;
  }

  // ---------- normal insert (no existing session) ----------
  const { insertedSession, insertedCandidates } = await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await lockScreenerSession(tx, session.date);
    const [alreadyStored] = await tx
      .select({ id: screenerSessionsTable.id })
      .from(screenerSessionsTable)
      .where(eq(screenerSessionsTable.date, session.date));
    if (alreadyStored) {
      throw new Error(`A session for ${session.date} already exists`);
    }
    const [insertedSession] = await tx
      .insert(screenerSessionsTable)
      .values({
      date: session.date,
      omxsValue: session.marketWeather.omxsValue,
      perf5d: session.marketWeather.perf5d,
      perf1m: session.marketWeather.perf1m,
      perf3m: session.marketWeather.perf3m,
      marketRsi: session.marketWeather.rsi,
      trendLabel: session.marketWeather.trendLabel,
      rawText: parsed.data.rawText,
      })
      .returning();
    const { candidates: insertedCandidates } = await synchronizeCandidates(
      tx,
      insertedSession.id,
      session.candidates.map((c) =>
        buildCandidateRow(insertedSession.id, c, earningsBatch.get(c.ticker) ?? UNKNOWN_EARNINGS),
      ),
    );
    const aggregateSource = aggregateSessionSource(
      insertedSession.source,
      insertedCandidates.map((candidate) => candidate.signalSource),
    );
    await tx
      .update(screenerSessionsTable)
      .set({ source: aggregateSource })
      .where(eq(screenerSessionsTable.id, insertedSession.id));
    await snapshotNewSessionTop3(
      tx,
      { id: insertedSession.id, date: insertedSession.date, source: aggregateSource },
      insertedCandidates,
    );
    return { insertedSession: { ...insertedSession, source: aggregateSource }, insertedCandidates };
  });

  const response = ImportSessionResponse.parse({
    id: insertedSession.id,
    date: insertedSession.date,
    source: insertedSession.source ?? null,
    createdAt: insertedSession.createdAt ?? null,
    lastImportAt: insertedSession.lastImportAt ?? null,
    marketWeather: {
      omxsValue: insertedSession.omxsValue,
      perf5d: insertedSession.perf5d,
      perf1m: insertedSession.perf1m,
      perf3m: insertedSession.perf3m,
      rsi: insertedSession.marketRsi,
      trendLabel: insertedSession.trendLabel,
    },
    candidates: insertedCandidates.map((c: any) => mapCandidate(c)),
  });

  res.status(201).json(response);
});

// PUT /screener/sessions/:id/reimport
router.put("/screener/sessions/:id/reimport", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const params = ReimportSessionParams.safeParse(req.params);
  if (!params.success) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: params.error.message });
    return;
  }

  const bodyParsed = ReimportSessionBody.safeParse(req.body);
  if (!bodyParsed.success) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: bodyParsed.error.message });
    return;
  }

  // Load the existing session
  const [existingSession] = await db
    .select()
    .from(screenerSessionsTable)
    .where(eq(screenerSessionsTable.id, params.data.id));

  if (!existingSession) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: "Session not found" });
    return;
  }

  // Parse the new raw text
  let parsedSession;
  try {
    parsedSession = parseScreenerText(bodyParsed.data.rawText);
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof ScreenerParseError) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: err.message });
      return;
    }
    throw err;
  }

  // Verify the date matches
  if (parsedSession.date !== existingSession.date) {
    res
      .status(400)
      .json({
        error: `Date mismatch: imported text has date ${parsedSession.date}, but session has date ${existingSession.date}`,
      });
    return;
  }

  const existingCandidatesForDateCheck = await db
    .select()
    .from(candidatesTable)
    .where(eq(candidatesTable.sessionId, existingSession.id));
  const reimportIdentitySet = new Set(parsedSession.candidates.map((candidate) =>
    candidateIdentity({ ...candidate, market: "SE", signalSource: "manual" }),
  ));
  const sourceDateMismatch = existingCandidatesForDateCheck.find((candidate) =>
    candidate.signalDate != null &&
    reimportIdentitySet.has(candidateIdentity(candidate)) &&
    candidate.signalDate !== parsedSession.date,
  );
  if (sourceDateMismatch) {
    res.status(409).json({
      error: `Signal date mismatch for ${sourceDateMismatch.ticker}: stored ${sourceDateMismatch.signalDate}, incoming ${parsedSession.date}`,
    });
    return;
  }

  const reimportVolumes = await enrichVolMultiplier(
    parsedSession.candidates.map((candidate) => candidate.ticker),
    _yf,
    parsedSession.date,
  );
  let updatedSession: typeof existingSession;
  let resultCandidates: (typeof candidatesTable.$inferSelect)[];
  let diff: import("../lib/candidateSynchronization").CandidateSyncDiff;
  try {
    ({ updatedSession, resultCandidates, diff } = await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await lockScreenerSession(tx, existingSession.date);
      const [updatedSession] = await tx
        .update(screenerSessionsTable)
        .set({
          omxsValue: parsedSession.marketWeather.omxsValue,
          perf5d: parsedSession.marketWeather.perf5d,
          perf1m: parsedSession.marketWeather.perf1m,
          perf3m: parsedSession.marketWeather.perf3m,
          marketRsi: parsedSession.marketWeather.rsi,
          trendLabel: parsedSession.marketWeather.trendLabel,
          rawText: bodyParsed.data.rawText,
        })
        .where(eq(screenerSessionsTable.id, params.data.id))
        .returning();
      const existingCandidates = await tx
        .select()
        .from(candidatesTable)
        .where(eq(candidatesTable.sessionId, updatedSession.id));
      const rows = parsedSession.candidates.map((candidate) => ({
        sessionId: updatedSession.id,
        signalDate: parsedSession.date,
        market: "SE" as const,
        signalSource: "manual" as const,
        category: candidate.category,
        rank: candidate.rank,
        ticker: candidate.ticker,
        price: candidate.price,
        rs3m: candidate.rs3m,
        perf1m: candidate.perf1m,
        rsi: candidate.rsi,
        pctB: candidate.pctB,
        atr: candidate.atr,
        volMultiplier: reimportVolumes.get(candidate.ticker)?.multiplier ?? 0,
        volumeAsOf: reimportVolumes.get(candidate.ticker)?.asOf ?? null,
        signalRsi: candidate.rsi,
        signalGapPct: candidate.gapWarning ?? null,
        distFrom20dH: candidate.distFrom20dH,
        gapWarning: candidate.gapWarning ?? null,
        direction: candidate.direction,
        entryPrice: candidate.entryPrice,
        stopPrice: candidate.stopPrice,
        targetPrice: candidate.targetPrice,
        rr: candidate.rr,
        oneR: candidate.oneR,
        outcome: "PENDING" as const,
      }));
      const { candidates: resultCandidates, diff } = await synchronizeCandidates(
        tx,
        updatedSession.id,
        mergeCandidateInputs(
          rows,
          existingCandidates.map(({ id, ...candidate }) => candidate),
        ),
      );
      const aggregateSource = aggregateSessionSource(
        updatedSession.source,
        resultCandidates.map((candidate) => candidate.signalSource),
      );
      await tx
        .update(screenerSessionsTable)
        .set({ lastImportDiff: diff, lastImportAt: new Date(), source: aggregateSource })
        .where(eq(screenerSessionsTable.id, updatedSession.id));
      await snapshotNewSessionTop3(
        tx,
        { id: updatedSession.id, date: updatedSession.date, source: aggregateSource },
        resultCandidates,
      );
      return { updatedSession: { ...updatedSession, source: aggregateSource }, resultCandidates, diff };
    }));
  } catch (error) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not synchronize candidates" });
    return;
  }

  const linkedIds = await fetchLinkedTradeIds(resultCandidates.map((c) => c.id));
  res.json(
    ReimportSessionResponse.parse({
      id: updatedSession.id,
      date: updatedSession.date,
      source: updatedSession.source ?? null,
      createdAt: updatedSession.createdAt ?? null,
      lastImportAt: updatedSession.lastImportAt ?? null,
      marketWeather: {
        omxsValue: updatedSession.omxsValue,
        perf5d: updatedSession.perf5d,
        perf1m: updatedSession.perf1m,
        perf3m: updatedSession.perf3m,
        rsi: updatedSession.marketRsi,
        trendLabel: updatedSession.trendLabel,
      },
      candidates: resultCandidates.map((c) => mapCandidate(c, linkedIds.has(c.id))),
      importDiff: diff,
    })
  );
});

// GET /screener/sessions
router.get("/screener/sessions", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const sessions = await db
    .select()
    .from(screenerSessionsTable)
    .orderBy(sql`${screenerSessionsTable.date} DESC`);

  // For each session, count candidates per category and tracked outcomes
  const result = await Promise.all(
    sessions.map(async (s) => {
      const candidateCounts = await db
        .select({
          category: candidatesTable.category,
          outcome: candidatesTable.outcome,
          count: sql<number>`cast(count(*) as integer)`,
        })
        .from(candidatesTable)
        .where(eq(candidatesTable.sessionId, s.id))
        .groupBy(candidatesTable.category, candidatesTable.outcome);

      let momentumCount = 0;
      let squeezeCount = 0;
      let studsCount = 0;
      let weakestCount = 0;
      let trackedCount = 0;
      let totalCandidates = 0;

      for (const row of candidateCounts) {
        const count = Number(row.count);
        totalCandidates += count;
        if (row.outcome !== "PENDING") trackedCount += count;
        if (row.category === "MOMENTUM") momentumCount += count;
        if (row.category === "SQUEEZE") squeezeCount += count;
        if (row.category === "STUDS") studsCount += count;
        if (row.category === "WEAKEST") weakestCount += count;
      }

      return {
        id: s.id,
        date: s.date,
        marketWeather: {
          omxsValue: s.omxsValue,
          perf5d: s.perf5d,
          perf1m: s.perf1m,
          perf3m: s.perf3m,
          rsi: s.marketRsi,
          trendLabel: s.trendLabel,
        },
        momentumCount,
        squeezeCount,
        studsCount,
        weakestCount,
        totalCandidates,
        trackedCount,
      };
    })
  );

  res.json(ListSessionsResponse.parse(result));
});

// GET /screener/sessions/:id
router.get("/screener/sessions/:id/delete-impact", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const params = GetSessionParams.safeParse(req.params);
  if (!params.success) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: params.error.message });
    return;
  }
  const [session] = await db
    .select({ id: screenerSessionsTable.id, date: screenerSessionsTable.date })
    .from(screenerSessionsTable)
    .where(eq(screenerSessionsTable.id, params.data.id));
  if (!session) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: "Session not found" });
    return;
  }
  const candidates = await db
    .select({ id: candidatesTable.id, outcome: candidatesTable.outcome })
    .from(candidatesTable)
    .where(eq(candidatesTable.sessionId, session.id));
  const ids = candidates.map((candidate) => candidate.id);
  const linkedTrades = ids.length
    ? await db
        .select({ id: survivalTradesTable.id })
        .from(survivalTradesTable)
        .where(inArray(survivalTradesTable.sourceCandidateId, ids))
    : [];
  res.json({
    sessionId: session.id,
    date: session.date,
    candidates: candidates.length,
    resolvedOutcomes: candidates.filter((candidate) => candidate.outcome !== "PENDING").length,
    linkedChallengeTrades: linkedTrades.length,
  });
});

router.get("/screener/sessions/:id", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const params = GetSessionParams.safeParse(req.params);
  if (!params.success) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: params.error.message });
    return;
  }

  const [session] = await db
    .select()
    .from(screenerSessionsTable)
    .where(eq(screenerSessionsTable.id, params.data.id));

  if (!session) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: "Session not found" });
    return;
  }

  const candidates = await db
    .select()
    .from(candidatesTable)
    .where(eq(candidatesTable.sessionId, session.id))
    .orderBy(candidatesTable.category, candidatesTable.rank);

  const selectionSnapshots = await db
    .select()
    .from(top3SelectionSnapshotsTable)
    .where(eq(top3SelectionSnapshotsTable.sessionId, session.id));
  const selectionByCandidate = new Map(selectionSnapshots.map((snapshot) => [snapshot.candidateId, snapshot]));

  const linkedIds = await fetchLinkedTradeIds(candidates.map((c) => c.id));
  const candidatesWithReview = candidates.map((candidate) => {
    const review = reviewCandidate(candidate, session.source ?? null);
    const officialSelection = selectionByCandidate.get(candidate.id);
    return {
      ...mapCandidate(candidate, linkedIds.has(candidate.id)),
      review,
      decision: decideCandidate(candidate, review, session.date),
      officialSelection: officialSelection ? {
        selected: officialSelection.selected,
        rank: officialSelection.rank,
        score: officialSelection.score,
        review: officialSelection.review,
        decision: officialSelection.decision,
        policyVersion: officialSelection.policyVersion,
        selectedAt: officialSelection.selectedAt,
        type: officialSelection.type,
        market: officialSelection.market,
        direction: officialSelection.direction,
        source: officialSelection.source,
      } : null,
    };
  });
  const sessionReview = reviewSession(
    candidatesWithReview.map((candidate) => candidate.review),
    session.marketRsi,
  );

  const parsed = GetSessionResponse.parse({
    id: session.id,
    date: session.date,
    source: session.source ?? null,
    createdAt: session.createdAt ?? null,
    lastImportAt: session.lastImportAt ?? null,
    marketWeather: {
      omxsValue: session.omxsValue,
      perf5d: session.perf5d,
      perf1m: session.perf1m,
      perf3m: session.perf3m,
      rsi: session.marketRsi,
      trendLabel: session.trendLabel,
    },
    candidates: candidatesWithReview,
    sessionReview,
    importDiff: (session.lastImportDiff as any) ?? undefined,
    top3SelectionSnapshot: session.top3SnapshotAt ? {
      available: true,
      selectedAt: session.top3SnapshotAt,
      policyVersion: session.top3PolicyVersion,
    } : { available: false, selectedAt: null, policyVersion: null },
  });

  // Append fields not in Zod schema — passed through directly
  res.json({
    ...parsed,
    candidates: candidatesWithReview,
    createdAt: session.createdAt ?? null,
    source: session.source ?? null,
    edgeRegime: session.edgeRegime ? (() => { try { return JSON.parse(session.edgeRegime!); } catch { return null; } })() : null,
    edgeExpectancy: session.edgeExpectancy ?? null,
    edgeWinRate: session.edgeWinRate ?? null,
    edgePF: session.edgePF ?? null,
    edgeN: session.edgeN ?? null,
    lastImportAt: session.lastImportAt ?? null,
    top3SelectionSnapshot: session.top3SnapshotAt ? {
      available: true,
      selectedAt: session.top3SnapshotAt,
      policyVersion: session.top3PolicyVersion,
    } : { available: false, selectedAt: null, policyVersion: null },
  });
});

// DELETE /screener/sessions/:id
router.delete("/screener/sessions/:id", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const params = DeleteSessionParams.safeParse(req.params);
  if (!params.success) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: params.error.message });
    return;
  }

  if (req.query.force !== "true") {
    res.status(409).json({
      error: "Deletion requires explicit force confirmation. Fetch delete-impact first and retry with force=true.",
    });
    return;
  }

  const deleted = await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const [session] = await tx
      .select()
      .from(screenerSessionsTable)
      .where(eq(screenerSessionsTable.id, params.data.id));
    if (!session) return null;
    await lockScreenerSession(tx, session.date);
    const candidates = await tx
      .select({ id: candidatesTable.id })
      .from(candidatesTable)
      .where(eq(candidatesTable.sessionId, session.id));
    const candidateIds = candidates.map((candidate) => candidate.id);
    if (candidateIds.length > 0) {
      await tx
        .delete(survivalTradesTable)
        .where(inArray(survivalTradesTable.sourceCandidateId, candidateIds));
    }
    const [removed] = await tx
      .delete(screenerSessionsTable)
      .where(eq(screenerSessionsTable.id, params.data.id))
      .returning();
    return removed;
  });

  if (!deleted) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: "Session not found" });
    return;
  }

  res.sendStatus(204);
});

/** Fetch which of the given candidate ids have a linked Challenge Tracker trade. */
async function fetchLinkedTradeIds(candidateIds: number[]): Promise<Set<number>> {
  if (candidateIds.length === 0) return new Set();
  const rows = await db
    .select({ sourceCandidateId: survivalTradesTable.sourceCandidateId })
    .from(survivalTradesTable)
    .where(inArray(survivalTradesTable.sourceCandidateId, candidateIds));
  return new Set(rows.map((r) => r.sourceCandidateId).filter((id): id is number => id != null));
}

function mapCandidate(c: {
  id: number;
  sessionId: number;
    signalDate: string | null;
  category: string;
  rank: number;
  ticker: string;
  price: number;
  rs3m: number;
  perf1m: number;
  rsi: number;
  pctB: number;
  atr: number;
  volMultiplier: number;
  volumeAsOf: string | null;
  signalRsi: number | null;
  signalGapPct: number | null;
  edgeWinRate: number | null;
  edgeExpectancyR: number | null;
  edgeSampleN: number | null;
  signalAgeBars: number | null;
  maxHoldDays: number | null;
  distFrom20dH: number;
  gapWarning: number | null;
  earningsInDays: number | null;
  earningsKnowledge: "SIGNAL_TIME" | "UNKNOWN" | null;
  earningsObservedAt: Date | null;
  market: string | null;
  signalSource: "edgeai" | "telegram" | "manual" | "screener" | null;
  direction: string;
  entryPrice: number;
  stopPrice: number;
  targetPrice: number;
  rr: number;
  oneR: number;
  outcome: string;
  exitPrice: number | null;
  outcomeNotes: string | null;
  resolutionMethod: "MANUAL_EXIT" | "TARGET_HIT" | "STOP_HIT" | "TIME_EXIT" | null;
  resolutionQuality: "RECORDED_EXIT" | "ASSUMED_LEVEL" | "LEGACY_UNKNOWN" | null;
  realizedR: number | null;
  resolutionEntryPrice: number | null;
  resolutionStopPrice: number | null;
  resolutionDirection: "LONG" | "SHORT" | null;
  isTop3Pick?: boolean | null;
}, hasLinkedTrade = false) {
  return {
    id: c.id,
    sessionId: c.sessionId,
    signalDate: c.signalDate ?? null,
    category: c.category,
    rank: c.rank,
    ticker: c.ticker,
    price: c.price,
    rs3m: c.rs3m,
    perf1m: c.perf1m,
    rsi: c.rsi,
    pctB: c.pctB,
    atr: c.atr,
    volMultiplier: c.volMultiplier,
    volumeAsOf: c.volumeAsOf ?? null,
    signalRsi: c.signalRsi ?? null,
    signalGapPct: c.signalGapPct ?? null,
    edgeWinRate: c.edgeWinRate ?? null,
    edgeExpectancyR: c.edgeExpectancyR ?? null,
    edgeSampleN: c.edgeSampleN ?? null,
    signalAgeBars: c.signalAgeBars ?? null,
    maxHoldDays: c.maxHoldDays ?? null,
    distFrom20dH: c.distFrom20dH,
    gapWarning: c.gapWarning ?? null,
    earningsInDays: c.earningsInDays ?? null,
    // Pre-provenance rows are intentionally UNKNOWN even if they have a legacy
    // number: that number cannot establish what was known on signal day.
    earningsKnowledge: c.earningsKnowledge === "SIGNAL_TIME" ? "SIGNAL_TIME" : "UNKNOWN",
    earningsObservedAt: c.earningsObservedAt ?? null,
    market: c.market ?? "SE",
    signalSource: c.signalSource ?? null,
    direction: c.direction,
    entryPrice: c.entryPrice,
    stopPrice: c.stopPrice,
    targetPrice: c.targetPrice,
    rr: c.rr,
    oneR: c.oneR,
    outcome: c.outcome,
    exitPrice: c.exitPrice ?? null,
    outcomeNotes: c.outcomeNotes ?? null,
    resolutionMethod: c.resolutionMethod ?? null,
    resolutionQuality: c.resolutionQuality ?? null,
    realizedR: c.realizedR ?? null,
     resolutionEntryPrice: c.resolutionEntryPrice ?? null,
     resolutionStopPrice: c.resolutionStopPrice ?? null,
     resolutionDirection: c.resolutionDirection ?? null,
    isTop3Pick: c.isTop3Pick ?? false,
    hasLinkedTrade,
  };
}

// PATCH /screener/candidates/:id/top3pick — toggle an annotation (max 3 per market/direction)
router.patch("/screener/candidates/:id/top3pick", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const params = SetCandidateTop3AnnotationParams.safeParse(req.params);
  if (!params.success) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: params.error.message });
    return;
  }
  const parsedBody = SetCandidateTop3AnnotationBody.safeParse(req.body);
  if (!parsedBody.success) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: parsedBody.error.message });
    return;
  }
  const id = params.data.id;
  const { isTop3Pick } = parsedBody.data;

  const result = await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const [beforeLock] = await tx.select().from(candidatesTable).where(eq(candidatesTable.id, id)).limit(1);
    if (!beforeLock) return { status: "missing" as const };
    const [session] = await tx
      .select({ date: screenerSessionsTable.date })
      .from(screenerSessionsTable)
      .where(eq(screenerSessionsTable.id, beforeLock.sessionId));
    if (!session) return { status: "missing" as const };
    await lockScreenerSession(tx, session.date);

    // Serialize star annotations with import and outcome writers. They remain
    // annotations only; this endpoint never writes official snapshot rows.
    const [candidate] = await tx.select().from(candidatesTable).where(eq(candidatesTable.id, id)).limit(1);
    if (!candidate) return { status: "missing" as const };

    if (isTop3Pick) {
      const existing = await tx
        .select()
        .from(candidatesTable)
        .where(and(
          eq(candidatesTable.sessionId, candidate.sessionId),
          eq(candidatesTable.isTop3Pick, true),
        ));
      const sameMarketDirection = existing.filter((pick) =>
        pick.direction === candidate.direction && pick.market === candidate.market,
      );
      if (sameMarketDirection.length >= 3 && !sameMarketDirection.some((pick) => pick.id === id)) {
        const dirLabel = candidate.direction === "SHORT" ? "sälj-picks" : "köp-picks";
        return { status: "limit" as const, message: `Max 3 ${dirLabel} per market — ta bort en stjärna först` };
      }
    }

    const [updated] = await tx
      .update(candidatesTable)
      .set({ isTop3Pick })
      .where(eq(candidatesTable.id, id))
      .returning();
    return { status: "updated" as const, candidate: updated };
  });
  if (result.status === "missing") { res.status(404).json({ error: "Candidate not found" }); return; }
  if (result.status === "limit") { res.status(409).json({ error: result.message }); return; }
  res.json(SetCandidateTop3AnnotationResponse.parse({
    id: result.candidate.id,
    isTop3Pick: result.candidate.isTop3Pick,
  }));
});

export default router;

const _yf = new YahooFinance({ suppressNotices: ["yahooSurvey", "ripHistorical"] });

type EarningsObservation = {
  earningsInDays: number | null;
  knowledge: "SIGNAL_TIME" | "UNKNOWN";
  observedAt: Date | null;
};

const UNKNOWN_EARNINGS: EarningsObservation = {
  earningsInDays: null,
  knowledge: "UNKNOWN",
  observedAt: null,
};

/** Fetch Rule 7 data only when a Yahoo observation is contemporaneous with the signal. */
async function fetchEarningsBatch(
  tickers: string[],
  sessionDate: string,
): Promise<Map<string, EarningsObservation>> {
  if (sessionDate !== stockholmCalendarDate()) {
    return new Map(tickers.map((ticker) => [ticker, UNKNOWN_EARNINGS]));
  }
  const unique = [...new Set(tickers)];
  const results = await Promise.all(
    unique.map(async (t) => [t, await fetchEarningsAtSignalTime(t, sessionDate)] as const),
  );
  return new Map(results);
}

function stockholmCalendarDate(): string {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("sv-SE", {
    timeZone: "Europe/Stockholm",
    year: "numeric",
    month: "2-digit",
    day: "2-digit",
  }).format(new Date());
}

/**
 * Fetch relative volume for the report's completed day (not a live quote).
 * A failed verification leaves volume unavailable, not qualified by an
 * unverified report ratio or today's incomplete live quote.
 */
async function enrichVolMultiplier(
  tickers: string[],
  yf: InstanceType<typeof YahooFinance>,
  reportDate: string,
): Promise<Map<string, { multiplier: number; asOf: string }>> {
  const volumes = await fetchCompletedVolumeBatch(
    yf,
    tickers.map((ticker) => ({ ticker, market: "SE", asOfDate: reportDate })),
  );
  return new Map(tickers.flatMap((ticker) => {
    const result = volumes.get(`SE:${ticker}:${reportDate}`);
    return result ? [[ticker, result] as const] : [];
  }));
}

/** Current Yahoo data is signal-time evidence only after fetchEarningsBatch's date guard. */
async function fetchEarningsAtSignalTime(ticker: string, sessionDate: string): Promise<EarningsObservation> {
  const observedAt = new Date();
  try {
    const quote = await _yf.quote(resolveYahooTicker(ticker));
    const earningsTs: Date | null = (quote as any).earningsTimestamp ?? null;
    if (!earningsTs || !(earningsTs instanceof Date)) return UNKNOWN_EARNINGS;
    const sessionStart = new Date(`${sessionDate}T00:00:00.000Z`);
    return {
      earningsInDays: calendarDaysBetween(earningsTs, sessionStart),
      knowledge: "SIGNAL_TIME",
      observedAt,
    };
  } catch {
    return UNKNOWN_EARNINGS;
  }
}

/**
 * /survival — Survival Challenge Tracker
 *
 * GET  /survival           → { config, trades, stats }
 * PATCH /survival/config   → update startCapital / goalCapital
 * POST /survival/trades    → add trade
 * DELETE /survival/trades/:id → remove trade
 */
import { Router, type IRouter } from "express";
import { eq, asc } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db, survivalConfigTable, survivalTradesTable, openPositionsTable } from "@workspace/db";

const router: IRouter = Router();

// ─── helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

async function getOrCreateConfig() {
  const rows = await db.select().from(survivalConfigTable).limit(1);
  if (rows.length) return rows[0];
  const [created] = await db
    .insert(survivalConfigTable)
    .values({ startCapital: 5000, goalCapital: 1000000 })
    .returning();
  return created;
}

function computeStats(startCapital: number, trades: typeof survivalTradesTable.$inferSelect[]) {
  const equity = startCapital + trades.reduce((s, t) => s + t.pnlKr, 0);

  // loss streak at tail
  let currentStreak = 0;
  for (let i = trades.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    if (trades[i].pnlKr < 0) currentStreak++;
    else break;
  }

  // max streak ever
  let maxStreak = 0;
  let cur = 0;
  for (const t of trades) {
    cur = t.pnlKr < 0 ? cur + 1 : 0;
    maxStreak = Math.max(maxStreak, cur);
  }

  const wins = trades.filter((t) => t.pnlKr > 0);
  const losses = trades.filter((t) => t.pnlKr < 0);
  const planned = trades.filter((t) => t.followedPlan);
  const disciplinePct = trades.length ? Math.round((planned.length / trades.length) * 100) : null;

  const lastStats = (arr: typeof trades) => {
    if (!arr.length) return null;
    const sum = arr.reduce((s, t) => s + t.pnlKr, 0);
    const w = arr.filter((t) => t.pnlKr > 0).length;
    return { n: arr.length, sum, avg: sum / arr.length, winPct: Math.round((w / arr.length) * 100) };
  };

  const lastTrades = trades.filter((t) => t.flag === "LAST");
  const reflexTrades = trades.filter((t) => t.flag === "REFLEX");

  // equity curve: cumulative kr at each trade
  const equityCurve: { i: number; eq: number }[] = [{ i: 0, eq: startCapital }];
  let running = startCapital;
  trades.forEach((t, idx) => {
    running += t.pnlKr;
    equityCurve.push({ i: idx + 1, eq: running });
  });

  return {
    equity,
    totalTrades: trades.length,
    wins: wins.length,
    losses: losses.length,
    winPct: trades.length ? Math.round((wins.length / trades.length) * 100) : null,
    currentStreak,
    maxStreak,
    circuitBreakerActive: currentStreak >= 3,
    disciplinePct,
    last: lastStats(lastTrades),
    reflex: lastStats(reflexTrades),
    equityCurve,
  };
}

// ─── routes ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// GET /survival
router.get("/survival", async (_req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const config = await getOrCreateConfig();
  const trades = await db
    .select()
    .from(survivalTradesTable)
    .orderBy(asc(survivalTradesTable.createdAt));

  const stats = computeStats(config.startCapital, trades);
  res.json({ config, trades, stats });
});

// PATCH /survival/config
router.patch("/survival/config", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const { startCapital, goalCapital, currentCapital, riskPct } = req.body ?? {};
  const patch: Partial<{ startCapital: number; goalCapital: number; currentCapital: number | null; riskPct: number; updatedAt: Date }> = {};
  if (startCapital !== undefined) {
    if (typeof startCapital !== "number" || startCapital <= 0) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: "startCapital must be a positive number" });
      return;
    }
    patch.startCapital = startCapital;
  }
  if (currentCapital !== undefined) {
    if (currentCapital !== null && (typeof currentCapital !== "number" || !isFinite(currentCapital) || currentCapital < 0)) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: "currentCapital must be a non-negative number or null" });
      return;
    }
    patch.currentCapital = currentCapital;
  }
  if (goalCapital !== undefined) {
    if (typeof goalCapital !== "number" || goalCapital <= 0) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: "goalCapital must be a positive number" });
      return;
    }
    const effectiveStart = patch.startCapital ?? (await getOrCreateConfig()).startCapital;
    if (goalCapital <= effectiveStart) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: "goalCapital must be greater than startCapital" });
      return;
    }
    patch.goalCapital = goalCapital;
  }
  if (riskPct !== undefined) {
    if (typeof riskPct !== "number" || !isFinite(riskPct) || riskPct <= 0 || riskPct > 100) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: "riskPct must be a number between 0 and 100" });
      return;
    }
    patch.riskPct = riskPct;
  }
  patch.updatedAt = new Date();
  const config = await getOrCreateConfig();
  const [updated] = await db
    .update(survivalConfigTable)
    .set(patch)
    .where(eq(survivalConfigTable.id, config.id))
    .returning();
  res.json(updated);
});

// POST /survival/trades
router.post("/survival/trades", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const { date, ticker, strategy, direction, leverageX, pnlKr, flag, followedPlan, boughtBeforeReport } = req.body ?? {};
  if (
    typeof date !== "string" || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(date) ||
    typeof strategy !== "string" || !strategy ||
    !["LONG", "SHORT"].includes(direction) ||
    typeof pnlKr !== "number" || !isFinite(pnlKr) ||
    !["LAST", "REFLEX"].includes(flag) ||
    typeof followedPlan !== "boolean" ||
    (boughtBeforeReport !== undefined && typeof boughtBeforeReport !== "boolean")
  ) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: "Invalid trade payload" });
    return;
  }
  const [trade] = await db
    .insert(survivalTradesTable)
    .values({
      date,
      ticker: ticker ?? null,
      strategy,
      direction,
      leverageX: typeof leverageX === "number" && isFinite(leverageX) ? leverageX : null,
      pnlKr,
      flag,
      followedPlan,
      boughtBeforeReport: boughtBeforeReport ?? false,
    })
    .returning();
  res.status(201).json(trade);
});

// DELETE /survival/trades/:id
router.delete("/survival/trades/:id", async (req, res): Promise<void> => {
  const id = Number(req.params.id);
  if (isNaN(id)) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: "Invalid id" });
    return;
  }
  const [deleted] = await db
    .delete(survivalTradesTable)
    .where(eq(survivalTradesTable.id, id))
    .returning();
  if (!deleted) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: "Trade not found" });
    return;
  }
  res.sendStatus(204);
});

/**
 * POST /api/telegram-import
 *
 * Accepts the raw screener text from the Telegram bot (via GitHub Actions)
 * and upserts a session + candidates in the DB.
 *
 * Auth: Authorization: Bearer <TELEGRAM_IMPORT_SECRET>
 * Body: { text: string }
 *
 * Response:
 *   201 { sessionId, date, candidateCount }   — fresh import
 *   200 { sessionId, date, candidateCount }   — updated existing session (outcomes preserved)
 *   400 { error }                             — parse failure
 *   401 { error }                             — missing/wrong token
 */

import { Router, type IRouter, type Request, type Response } from "express";
import { requireAdministrator } from "../middlewares/authMiddleware";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db, screenerSessionsTable, candidatesTable } from "@workspace/db";
import { parseScreenerText, ScreenerParseError } from "../lib/screenerParser";
import { logger } from "../lib/logger";
import YahooFinance from "yahoo-finance2";
import { fetchCompletedVolumeBatch } from "../lib/completedVolumeBatch";
import { timingSafeEqual } from "node:crypto";
import {
  deduplicateCandidates,
  lockScreenerSession,
  mergeCandidateInputs,
  synchronizeCandidates,
  candidateIdentity,
} from "../lib/candidateSynchronization";
import { aggregateSessionSource } from "../lib/candidateSynchronizationPolicy";
import { snapshotNewSessionTop3 } from "../lib/top3SelectionPolicy";

const yf = new YahooFinance({ suppressNotices: ["yahooSurvey", "ripHistorical"] });

/** Verify report-date volume against the preceding ten completed Yahoo trading days. */
async function enrichVolMultiplier(
  candidates: Array<{ ticker: string; volMultiplier: number }>,
  reportDate: string,
): Promise<Map<string, { multiplier: number; asOf: string }>> {
  const volumes = await fetchCompletedVolumeBatch(
    yf,
    candidates.map((candidate) => ({ ticker: candidate.ticker, market: "SE", asOfDate: reportDate })),
  );
  for (const candidate of candidates) {
    const verified = volumes.get(`SE:${candidate.ticker}:${reportDate}`);
    // A bot-provided ratio is not proof of the completed Yahoo bar.
    candidate.volMultiplier = verified?.multiplier ?? 0;
  }
  return new Map(candidates.flatMap((candidate) => {
    const verified = volumes.get(`SE:${candidate.ticker}:${reportDate}`);
    return verified ? [[candidate.ticker, verified] as const] : [];
  }));
}

const router: IRouter = Router();

// GET /api/telegram-import/status — shows pipeline health without exposing secret
router.get("/telegram-import/status", requireAdministrator, async (_req, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  const { db, screenerSessionsTable } = await import("@workspace/db");
  const { desc } = await import("drizzle-orm");
  const secretConfigured = !!process.env.TELEGRAM_IMPORT_SECRET;
  const [latest] = await db
    .select({ date: screenerSessionsTable.date, source: screenerSessionsTable.source, createdAt: screenerSessionsTable.createdAt })
    .from(screenerSessionsTable)
    .orderBy(desc(screenerSessionsTable.createdAt))
    .limit(1);
  res.json({
    secretConfigured,
    latestSession: latest ?? null,
    note: secretConfigured
      ? "Token configured — ensure DASHBOARD_IMPORT_SECRET in GitHub matches TELEGRAM_IMPORT_SECRET in Replit"
      : "TELEGRAM_IMPORT_SECRET not set — set it in Replit Secrets",
  });
});

router.post("/telegram-import", async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  // ── Auth ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const secret = process.env.TELEGRAM_IMPORT_SECRET;
  if (!secret) {
    res.status(503).json({ error: "TELEGRAM_IMPORT_SECRET not configured on server" });
    return;
  }
  const authHeader = req.headers["authorization"] ?? "";
  const token = authHeader.startsWith("Bearer ") ? authHeader.slice(7) : "";
  const received = Buffer.from(token);
  const expected = Buffer.from(secret);
  if (
    received.length !== expected.length ||
    !timingSafeEqual(received, expected)
  ) {
    res.status(401).json({ error: "Invalid or missing bearer token" });
    return;
  }

  // ── Body ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const rawText: unknown = req.body?.text;
  if (typeof rawText !== "string" || rawText.trim().length === 0) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: 'Body must be JSON with a non-empty "text" string' });
    return;
  }

  // ── Parse ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  let session: ReturnType<typeof parseScreenerText>;
  try {
    session = parseScreenerText(rawText);
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof ScreenerParseError) {
      logger.warn({ err: err.message }, "[telegram-import] Parse error");
      res.status(400).json({ error: err.message });
      return;
    }
    throw err;
  }

  const { date, marketWeather, candidates } = session;
  const [existingSessionForDate] = await db
    .select({ id: screenerSessionsTable.id })
    .from(screenerSessionsTable)
    .where(eq(screenerSessionsTable.date, date));
  if (existingSessionForDate) {
    const priorCandidates = await db
      .select()
      .from(candidatesTable)
      .where(eq(candidatesTable.sessionId, existingSessionForDate.id));
    const incomingIdentities = new Set(candidates.map((candidate) =>
      candidateIdentity({ ...candidate, market: "SE", signalSource: "telegram" }),
    ));
    const mismatch = priorCandidates.find((candidate) =>
      candidate.signalDate != null &&
      incomingIdentities.has(candidateIdentity(candidate)) &&
      candidate.signalDate !== date,
    );
    if (mismatch) {
      res.status(409).json({
        error: `Signal date mismatch for ${mismatch.ticker}: stored ${mismatch.signalDate}, incoming ${date}`,
      });
      return;
    }
  }
  {
    const { skipped } = deduplicateCandidates(
      candidates.map((candidate) => ({ ...candidate, market: "SE" })),
    );
    if (skipped.length > 0) {
      console.warn(`[telegram import] Skipped duplicate candidates: ${skipped.join(", ")}`);
    }
  }

  // The report date, not import time, is the provenance of its daily signal.
  const verifiedVolumes = await enrichVolMultiplier(candidates, date);

  const buildRow = (
    sessionId: number,
    c: (typeof candidates)[number],
    preserved?: {
      outcome: string; exitPrice: number | null; outcomeNotes: string | null;
      resolutionMethod: "MANUAL_EXIT" | "TARGET_HIT" | "STOP_HIT" | null;
      resolutionQuality: "RECORDED_EXIT" | "ASSUMED_LEVEL" | "LEGACY_UNKNOWN" | null;
      realizedR: number | null;
    },
  ) => ({
    sessionId,
    signalDate: date,
    market: "SE" as const,   // Telegram screener always imports SE stocks
    signalSource: "telegram" as const,
    category: c.category,
    rank: c.rank,
    ticker: c.ticker,
    price: c.price,
    rs3m: c.rs3m,
    perf1m: c.perf1m,
    rsi: c.rsi,
    pctB: c.pctB,
    atr: c.atr,
    volMultiplier: c.volMultiplier,
    volumeAsOf: verifiedVolumes.get(c.ticker)?.asOf ?? null,
    distFrom20dH: c.distFrom20dH,
    gapWarning: c.gapWarning ?? undefined,
    direction: c.direction,
    entryPrice: c.entryPrice,
    stopPrice: c.stopPrice,
    targetPrice: c.targetPrice,
    rr: c.rr,
    oneR: c.oneR,
    outcome: (preserved?.outcome ?? "PENDING") as "WIN" | "LOSS" | "SKIP" | "PENDING",
    exitPrice: preserved?.exitPrice ?? null,
    outcomeNotes: preserved?.outcomeNotes ?? null,
    resolutionMethod: preserved?.resolutionMethod ?? null,
    resolutionQuality: preserved?.resolutionQuality ?? null,
    realizedR: preserved?.realizedR ?? null,
  });

  // ── Upsert ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const result = await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await lockScreenerSession(tx, date);
    const [existing] = await tx
      .select()
      .from(screenerSessionsTable)
      .where(eq(screenerSessionsTable.date, date));
    const sessionRow = {
      omxsValue: marketWeather.omxsValue,
      perf5d: marketWeather.perf5d,
      perf1m: marketWeather.perf1m,
      perf3m: marketWeather.perf3m,
      marketRsi: marketWeather.rsi,
      trendLabel: marketWeather.trendLabel,
      rawText,
    };
    const [stored] = existing
      ? await tx.update(screenerSessionsTable).set(sessionRow).where(eq(screenerSessionsTable.id, existing.id)).returning()
      : await tx.insert(screenerSessionsTable).values({ date, ...sessionRow }).returning();
    const existingCandidates = existing
      ? await tx
          .select()
          .from(candidatesTable)
          .where(eq(candidatesTable.sessionId, stored.id))
      : [];
    const { candidates: storedCandidates, diff } = await synchronizeCandidates(
      tx,
      stored.id,
      mergeCandidateInputs(
        candidates.map((candidate) => buildRow(stored.id, candidate)),
        existingCandidates.map(({ id, ...candidate }) => candidate),
      ),
    );
    const aggregateSource = aggregateSessionSource(
      existing?.source,
      storedCandidates.map((candidate) => candidate.signalSource),
    );
    if (existing) {
      await tx
        .update(screenerSessionsTable)
        .set({ lastImportDiff: diff, lastImportAt: new Date(), source: aggregateSource })
        .where(eq(screenerSessionsTable.id, stored.id));
      await snapshotNewSessionTop3(
        tx,
        { id: stored.id, date, source: aggregateSource },
        storedCandidates,
      );
    } else {
      await tx
        .update(screenerSessionsTable)
        .set({ source: aggregateSource })
        .where(eq(screenerSessionsTable.id, stored.id));
      await snapshotNewSessionTop3(
        tx,
        { id: stored.id, date, source: aggregateSource },
        storedCandidates,
      );
    }
    return { stored, candidateCount: storedCandidates.length, updated: Boolean(existing) };
  });

  logger.info({ date, sessionId: result.stored.id, candidates: result.candidateCount }, "[telegram-import] Session synchronized");
  res.status(result.updated ? 200 : 201).json({ sessionId: result.stored.id, date, candidateCount: result.candidateCount });
});

export default router;
