// Custom dot — colour by outcome, skip the origin point
function CurveDot(props: any) {
  const { cx, cy, payload } = props;
  if (!payload?.outcome) return null; // origin point
  const color =
    payload.r > 0
      ? "hsl(var(--success, 142 71% 45%))"
      : payload.r < 0 ? "hsl(var(--destructive))" : "hsl(var(--muted-foreground))";
  return <circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r={3} fill={color} stroke="none" />;
}

// Custom tooltip
function EquityCurveTooltip({ active, payload }: TooltipProps<number, string>) {
  if (!active || !payload?.length) return null;
  const d = payload[0].payload;
  if (!d?.outcome) return null; // origin point

  const isWin = d.r > 0;
  return (
    <div className="bg-popover border border-border rounded-lg p-3 shadow-lg text-xs space-y-1 min-w-[160px]">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <span className="font-bold font-mono">
          {d.ticker}{d.outcome === "TIME_EXIT" ? " · Tidsavslut" : ""}
        </span>
        <span
          className={`font-mono font-bold ${isWin ? "text-success" : d.r < 0 ? "text-destructive" : "text-muted-foreground"}`}
        >
          {d.r >= 0 ? "+" : ""}
          {Number(d.r).toFixed(2)}R
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="text-muted-foreground">{d.date}</div>
      <div className="border-t border-border pt-1 flex justify-between">
        <span className="text-muted-foreground">Kumulativt</span>
        <span className="font-mono font-semibold">
          {d.cumulativeR >= 0 ? "+" : ""}
          {Number(d.cumulativeR).toFixed(2)}R
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function TodaySessionPanel() {
  const { data: sessions, isLoading } = useListSessions();
  const { data: top3 } = useTop3Analytics();

  // Use sv-SE locale so we get "YYYY-MM-DD" in the Swedish timezone
  const todayStr = new Date().toLocaleDateString("sv-SE");
  const latest = sessions?.[0]; // list is sorted DESC by date
  const isToday = latest?.date === todayStr;

  // Find top-3 picks for the latest session from the already-loaded analytics data
  const top3Session = top3?.sessions.find((s) => s.sessionId === latest?.id);
  const top3Count = top3Session?.picks.length ?? 0;

  const trendLabel = latest?.marketWeather.trendLabel ?? "";
  const trendUp = trendLabel.includes("BULL");
  const trendDown = trendLabel.includes("BEAR");
  const TrendIcon = trendUp ? TrendingUp : trendDown ? TrendingDown : BarChart2;
  const trendColor = trendUp
    ? "text-success"
    : trendDown
    ? "text-destructive"
    : "text-muted-foreground";

  // ── Loading skeleton ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (isLoading) {
    return <div className="h-20 bg-muted rounded-lg animate-pulse" />;
  }

  // ── No session yet today ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!isToday) {
    return (
      <div className="bg-card border border-border rounded-lg p-5 shadow-sm flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-2 rounded-full bg-muted">
            <CalendarDays className="h-5 w-5 text-muted-foreground" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Dagens session</p>
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold mt-0.5">
              Ingen signal ännu idag — Telegram-import inväntas
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
        {latest && (
          <Link
            href={`/sessions/${latest.id}`}
            className="shrink-0 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors"
          >
            Senaste: {latest.date}
            <ArrowUpRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          </Link>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  // ── Today's session exists ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const { marketWeather, totalCandidates, id } = latest;

  return (
    <div className="bg-card border border-primary/30 rounded-lg p-5 shadow-sm ring-1 ring-primary/10">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        {/* Left: date + market snapshot */}
        <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
          <div className="p-2 rounded-full bg-primary/10 shrink-0">
            <CalendarDays className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">Dagens session</p>
              <p className="text-sm font-bold mt-0.5">{latest.date}</p>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3 text-xs">
              {/* OMXS30 value */}
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-muted/60 rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 font-mono font-semibold">
                OMXS30 {formatNumber(marketWeather.omxsValue, 1)}
              </span>
              {/* Trend */}
              <span className={`flex items-center gap-1 bg-muted/60 rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 font-medium ${trendColor}`}>
                <TrendIcon className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                {trendLabel}
              </span>
              {/* Candidates */}
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-muted/60 rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 text-muted-foreground">
                <Target className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                {totalCandidates} kandidater
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right: top3 picks preview + open button */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 sm:flex-col sm:items-end">
          {/* Ticker chips come only from the official snapshot. */}
          {top3Session?.picks && top3Session.picks.length > 0 ? (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
              {top3Session.picks.map((p) => (
                <span
                  key={`${p.direction}:${p.ticker}:${p.signalSource ?? "unknown"}`}
                  className={`text-xs font-mono font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border ${
                    p.direction === "SHORT"
                      ? "bg-destructive/10 text-destructive border-destructive/20"
                      : "bg-success/10 text-success border-success/20"
                  } ${p.outcome === "LOSS" ? "opacity-40 line-through" : p.outcome === "WIN" ? "opacity-70" : ""}`}
                  title={`${p.direction} · ${p.signalSource ?? "okänd källa"} · ${p.outcome ?? "PENDING"}`}
                >
                  {p.ticker.replace(/\.ST$/i, "")}
                  {p.signalSource === "edgeai" ? " · E" : p.signalSource === "telegram" ? " · T" : ""}
                  {p.outcome === "WIN" ? " ✓" : p.outcome === "LOSS" ? " ✗" : ""}
                </span>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs">
              {[0, 1, 2].map((i) => (
                <Star
                  key={i}
                  className={`h-4 w-4 ${
                    i < top3Count
                      ? "text-amber-400 fill-amber-400"
                      : "text-muted-foreground/30"
                  }`}
                />
              ))}
              <span className="ml-1 text-muted-foreground font-medium">
                {top3Session?.selectionStatus === "UNAVAILABLE"
                  ? "Officiellt urval saknas"
                  : `${top3Count} officiella picks`}
              </span>
            </div>
          )}
          {/* Open session link */}
          <Link
            href={`/sessions/${id}`}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md bg-primary text-primary-foreground text-xs font-semibold px-3 py-1.5 hover:bg-primary/90 transition-colors shadow-sm shrink-0"
          >
            Öppna session
            <ArrowUpRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ─── Week Summary ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function getISOWeekNumber(date: Date): number {
  const d = new Date(Date.UTC(date.getUTCFullYear(), date.getUTCMonth(), date.getUTCDate()));
  const dayNum = d.getUTCDay() || 7;
  d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + 4 - dayNum);
  const yearStart = new Date(Date.UTC(d.getUTCFullYear(), 0, 1));
  return Math.ceil(((d.getTime() - yearStart.getTime()) / 86400000 + 1) / 7);
}

function WeekSummarySection({ equityCurve }: { equityCurve: EquityPoint[] }) {
  const { weekNum, mondayStr, wins, losses, winRate, totalR, bestPick, trades } = useMemo(() => {
    const now = new Date();
    const day = now.getUTCDay();
    const mondayOffset = day === 0 ? -6 : 1 - day;
    const monday = new Date(Date.UTC(now.getUTCFullYear(), now.getUTCMonth(), now.getUTCDate() + mondayOffset));
    const mondayStr = monday.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const weekNum = getISOWeekNumber(now);

    const thisWeek = equityCurve.filter((t) => t.date >= mondayStr);
    let wins = 0, losses = 0, totalR = 0;
    let bestPick: { ticker: string; r: number } | null = null;
    for (const t of thisWeek) {
      if (t.r > 0) wins++;
      else if (t.r < 0) losses++;
      totalR += t.r;
      if (!bestPick || t.r > bestPick.r) bestPick = { ticker: t.ticker, r: t.r };
    }
    return {
      weekNum,
      mondayStr,
      trades: thisWeek.length,
      wins,
      losses,
      winRate: thisWeek.length > 0 ? wins / thisWeek.length : null,
      totalR: Math.round(totalR * 100) / 100,
      bestPick,
    };
  }, [equityCurve]);

  const rColor = totalR > 0 ? "text-success" : totalR < 0 ? "text-destructive" : "text-muted-foreground";
  const wrColor = winRate != null ? (winRate >= 0.5 ? "text-success" : "text-destructive") : "text-muted-foreground";

  return (
    <div className="bg-card border border-border rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
        <h3 className="font-semibold text-base">Sammanfattning vecka {weekNum}</h3>
        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{mondayStr} →</span>
      </div>
      {trades === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Inga utfall med beräknat R denna vecka.</p>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
          <div className="text-center">
            <div className={`text-2xl font-bold font-mono ${rColor}`}>
              {totalR >= 0 ? "+" : ""}{formatNumber(totalR, 2)}R
            </div>
            <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">Total R</div>
          </div>
          <div className="text-center">
            <div className={`text-2xl font-bold font-mono ${wrColor}`}>
              {winRate != null ? formatPercent(winRate) : "–"}
            </div>
            <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">Win rate</div>
          </div>
          <div className="text-center">
            <div className="text-2xl font-bold font-mono">
              <span className="text-success">{wins}V</span>
              <span className="text-muted-foreground mx-1">/</span>
              <span className="text-destructive">{losses}F</span>
              {trades > wins + losses && <span className="text-muted-foreground"> / {trades - wins - losses} 0R</span>}
            </div>
            <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">Trades</div>
          </div>
          <div className="text-center">
            {bestPick ? (
              <>
                <div className="text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-success">
                  {bestPick.ticker.replace(/\.ST$/i, "")}
                </div>
                <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">
                  Bästa pick (+{formatNumber(bestPick.r, 2)}R)
                </div>
              </>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-muted-foreground">–</div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ─── Market Intel ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function fgColor(score: number): string {
  if (score <= 25) return "#ef4444"; // extreme fear
  if (score <= 45) return "#f97316"; // fear
  if (score <= 55) return "#eab308"; // neutral
  if (score <= 75) return "#84cc16"; // greed
  return "#22c55e";                  // extreme greed
}

function fgLabel(rating: string): string {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {
    "Extreme Fear": "Extrem Rädsla",
    "Fear": "Rädsla",
    "Neutral": "Neutralt",
    "Greed": "Girighet",
    "Extreme Greed": "Extrem Girighet",
  };
  return map[rating] ?? rating;
}

  return (

      <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-4 border-b border-border pb-2">Marknadsläge</h3>

                    {fgLabel(data.fearGreed.rating)}

// ─── Session R Curve ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface EquityPoint {
  date: string;
  r: number;
  ticker: string;
  outcome: "WIN" | "LOSS" | "TIME_EXIT";
  tradeIndex: number;
  cumulativeR: number;
}

function buildSessionData(equityCurve: EquityPoint[]) {
  const byDate: Record<string, number> = {};
  const dateOrder: string[] = [];
  for (const pt of equityCurve) {
    if (!(pt.date in byDate)) {
      byDate[pt.date] = 0;
      dateOrder.push(pt.date);
    }
    byDate[pt.date] = Math.round((byDate[pt.date] + pt.r) * 1000) / 1000;
  }
  let cum = 0;
  return dateOrder.map((date) => {
    cum = Math.round((cum + byDate[date]) * 1000) / 1000;
    return {
      date: date.slice(5),
      fullDate: date,
      sessionR: Math.round(byDate[date] * 1000) / 1000,
      cumulativeR: cum,
    };
  });
}

// ─── Rolling 20-trade expectancy ──────────────────────────────────────────────

function RollingExpectancySection({ equityCurve }: { equityCurve: EquityPoint[] }) {
  const WINDOW = 20;
  const recent = equityCurve.slice(-WINDOW);
  const total  = recent.length;

  if (total < 5) return null; // too few data points to show anything meaningful

  const winTrades = recent.filter(pt => pt.r > 0);
  const lossTrades = recent.filter(pt => pt.r < 0);
  const wins = winTrades.length;
  const losses = lossTrades.length;
  const winRate = total > 0 ? wins / total : 0;

  const avgWinR = wins > 0 ? winTrades.reduce((s, pt) => s + pt.r, 0) / wins : 0;
  const avgLossR = losses > 0 ? Math.abs(lossTrades.reduce((s, pt) => s + pt.r, 0) / losses) : 0;
  const expectancy = recent.reduce((sum, pt) => sum + pt.r, 0) / total;

  const isPositive = expectancy > 0;
  const label = total < WINDOW ? `Senaste ${total} trades` : `Senaste ${WINDOW} trades`;

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-border pb-2 mb-4">
        <Sigma className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
        <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold">Rullande expectancy</h3>
        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground ml-1">({label})</span>
      </div>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
        <div className="bg-card border border-border rounded-lg p-4 text-center shadow-sm">
          <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Win rate</div>
          <div className={`text-2xl font-bold ${winRate >= 0.5 ? "text-success" : "text-destructive"}`}>
            {(winRate * 100).toFixed(0)}%
          </div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-1">{wins}V / {losses}F / {total - wins - losses} 0R</div>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-card border border-border rounded-lg p-4 text-center shadow-sm">
          <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Avg vinst</div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-success">+{formatNumber(avgWinR, 2)}R</div>
          <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-1">per vinnande trade</div>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-card border border-border rounded-lg p-4 text-center shadow-sm">
          <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Avg förlust</div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-destructive">-{formatNumber(avgLossR, 2)}R</div>
          <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-1">per förlorande trade</div>
        </div>
        <div className={`border rounded-lg p-4 text-center shadow-sm ${isPositive ? "bg-success/5 border-success/20" : "bg-destructive/5 border-destructive/20"}`}>
          <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Expectancy</div>
          <div className={`text-2xl font-bold ${isPositive ? "text-success" : "text-destructive"}`}>
            {isPositive ? "+" : ""}{formatNumber(expectancy, 2)}R
          </div>
          <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-1">per trade i snitt</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      {!isPositive && total >= 10 && (
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-3 flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <AlertTriangle className="h-3 w-3 text-amber-500" />
          Negativ expectancy — systemet tappar pengar per trade i snitt. Justera strategi eller vänta på fler observationer.
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function SessionRCurveSection({ equityCurve }: { equityCurve: EquityPoint[] }) {
  const sessionData = buildSessionData(equityCurve);
  const hasData = sessionData.length > 0;
  const finalR = hasData ? sessionData[sessionData.length - 1].cumulativeR : null;

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4 border-b border-border pb-2">
        <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold">R per session</h3>
        {finalR != null && (
          <span className={`text-sm font-mono font-bold ${finalR >= 0 ? "text-success" : "text-destructive"}`}>
            {finalR >= 0 ? "+" : ""}{formatNumber(finalR, 2)}R totalt
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      {!hasData ? (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-48 bg-card border border-border rounded-lg text-muted-foreground gap-2">
          <BarChart2 className="h-8 w-8 opacity-30" />
          <p className="text-sm">Logga utfall med exit-pris för att se sessionsresultat.</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="bg-card border border-border rounded-lg p-4 shadow-sm">
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={240}>
            <ComposedChart data={sessionData} margin={{ top: 8, right: 16, left: 0, bottom: 0 }}>
              <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" className="stroke-border" />
              <XAxis dataKey="date" tick={{ fontSize: 11 }} tickLine={false} axisLine={false} />
              <YAxis tick={{ fontSize: 11 }} tickLine={false} axisLine={false} tickFormatter={(v) => `${v}R`} width={40} />

                  <Cell
                    key={i}
                    fill={
                      entry.sessionR >= 0
                        ? "hsl(142 71% 45%)"
                        : "hsl(var(--destructive))"
                    }
                    fillOpacity={0.75}
                  />
                ))}
              </Bar>
              <Line
                type="monotone"
                dataKey="cumulativeR"
                stroke="hsl(var(--primary))"
                strokeWidth={2}
                dot={false}
                activeDot={{ r: 4 }}
              />
            </ComposedChart>
          </ResponsiveContainer>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-2 text-center">
            Staplar = netto-R per dag · Linje = kumulativt
          </p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function SessionTooltip({ active, payload }: TooltipProps<number, string>) {
  if (!active || !payload?.length) return null;
  const d = payload[0]?.payload as { fullDate: string; sessionR: number; cumulativeR: number } | undefined;
  if (!d) return null;
  return (
    <div className="bg-popover border border-border rounded-lg p-3 shadow-lg text-xs space-y-1 min-w-[160px]">
      <div className="font-semibold text-muted-foreground">{d.fullDate}</div>
      <div className="flex justify-between gap-4">
        <span className="text-muted-foreground">Session</span>
        <span className={`font-mono font-bold ${d.sessionR >= 0 ? "text-success" : "text-destructive"}`}>
          {d.sessionR >= 0 ? "+" : ""}{formatNumber(d.sessionR, 2)}R
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="flex justify-between gap-4 border-t border-border pt-1">
        <span className="text-muted-foreground">Kumulativt</span>
        <span className="font-mono font-semibold">
          {d.cumulativeR >= 0 ? "+" : ""}{formatNumber(d.cumulativeR, 2)}R
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ─── Top 3 Strategy ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function Top3Section() {
  const { data, isLoading } = useTop3Analytics();

  const seSessions = data?.sessions.filter((s) => s.source !== "edgeai") ?? [];
  const usSessions = data?.sessions.filter((s) => s.source === "edgeai") ?? [];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-border pb-2">
        <Trophy className="h-5 w-5 text-muted-foreground" />
        <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold">Top 3 — officiellt signal-time-urval</h3>
      </div>
      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground -mt-4">
        Frysta urval från första signal-time-importen, endast TRADEABLE och högst tre per market/riktning. Äldre sessioner utan sparad snapshot markeras som otillgängliga och ingår inte i resultatet.
      </p>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
        <Top3MarketCard label="📋 Manuella sessioner" sessions={seSessions} isLoading={isLoading} accentColor="hsl(var(--primary))" />
        <Top3MarketCard label="⚡ EdgeAI (SE + US)" sessions={usSessions} isLoading={isLoading} accentColor="hsl(var(--success, 142 71% 45%))" />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function computeMarketChartData(sessions: Top3Session[]) {
  let cum = 0;
  const points: { date: string; cumulativeR: number }[] = [{ date: "Start", cumulativeR: 0 }];
  for (const s of sessions) {
    if (s.sessionR !== null) {
      cum += s.sessionR;
      points.push({ date: s.date.slice(5), cumulativeR: cum });
    }
  }
  return points;
}

function isCountedTop3Pick(pick: Top3Session["picks"][number]): boolean {
  return pick.r != null &&
    (pick.outcome === "WIN" || pick.outcome === "LOSS" || pick.outcome === "TIME_EXIT");
}

function isWinningTop3Pick(pick: Top3Session["picks"][number]): boolean {
  return pick.r != null &&
    (pick.outcome === "WIN" || (pick.outcome === "TIME_EXIT" && pick.r > 0));
}

function isLosingTop3Pick(pick: Top3Session["picks"][number]): boolean {
  return pick.r != null &&
    (pick.outcome === "LOSS" || (pick.outcome === "TIME_EXIT" && pick.r < 0));
}

function computeMarketStats(sessions: Top3Session[]) {
  let wins = 0, losses = 0, flats = 0, totalR = 0;
  for (const s of sessions) {
    for (const p of s.picks) {
      if (!isCountedTop3Pick(p)) continue;
      totalR += p.r!;
      if (isWinningTop3Pick(p)) wins++;
      else if (isLosingTop3Pick(p)) losses++;
      else flats++;
    }
  }
  const total = wins + losses + flats;
  return {
    wins, losses, flats, total,
    winRate: total > 0 ? wins / total : null,
    totalR,
    avgR: total > 0 ? totalR / total : null,
    completedSessions: sessions.filter((s) => s.selectionStatus === "AVAILABLE" && s.sessionR !== null).length,
    totalSessions: sessions.filter((s) => s.selectionStatus === "AVAILABLE").length,
    unavailableSessions: sessions.filter((s) => s.selectionStatus === "UNAVAILABLE").length,
  };
}

function Top3MarketCard({
  label, sessions, isLoading, accentColor,
}: {
  label: string;
  sessions: Top3Session[];
  isLoading: boolean;
  accentColor: string;
}) {
  const [excludeEarnings, setExcludeEarnings] = useState(false);

  const displaySessions = useMemo(() => {
    if (!excludeEarnings) return sessions;
    return sessions.map((s) => ({
      ...s,
      picks: s.picks.filter((p) => !p.earningsWarning),
    }));
  }, [sessions, excludeEarnings]);

  const chartData = computeMarketChartData(displaySessions);
  const hasData = chartData.length > 1;
  const stats = computeMarketStats(displaySessions);
  const finalR = hasData ? chartData[chartData.length - 1].cumulativeR : null;

  const earningsWarningCount = useMemo(
    () => sessions.reduce((n, s) => n + s.picks.filter((p) => p.earningsWarning).length, 0),
    [sessions],
  );

  // #28 — Rule 7 side-by-side comparison (raw vs clean)
  const rawStats = useMemo(() => computeMarketStats(sessions), [sessions]);
  const cleanSessions = useMemo(
    () => sessions.map((s) => ({ ...s, picks: s.picks.filter((p) => !p.earningsWarning) })),
    [sessions],
  );
  const cleanStats = useMemo(() => computeMarketStats(cleanSessions), [cleanSessions]);

  return (
    <div className="bg-card border border-border rounded-lg p-5 shadow-sm flex flex-col gap-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <span className="font-semibold text-sm">{label}</span>
        {finalR != null && (
          <span className={`font-mono font-bold text-sm ${finalR >= 0 ? "text-success" : "text-destructive"}`}>
            {finalR >= 0 ? "+" : ""}{formatNumber(finalR, 2)}R
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Earnings-filter toggle */}
      {earningsWarningCount > 0 && (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between py-1.5 px-2 bg-amber-500/5 rounded-md border border-amber-500/20">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-amber-500">
            <AlertTriangle className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            <span>{earningsWarningCount} pick{earningsWarningCount !== 1 ? "s" : ""} med rapportvarning</span>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={() => setExcludeEarnings((v) => !v)}
            className={`text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded border transition-colors font-medium ${
              excludeEarnings
                ? "bg-amber-500/15 border-amber-500/40 text-amber-500"
                : "bg-muted border-border text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
            }`}
          >
            {excludeEarnings ? "Ren kurva" : "Exkludera"}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Stat pills */}
      {stats.total > 0 && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <Pill label="Trades" value={`${stats.wins}V / ${stats.losses}F / ${stats.flats}0R`} />
          <Pill
            label="Hitrate"
            value={stats.winRate != null ? formatPercent(stats.winRate) : "–"}
            color={stats.winRate != null ? (stats.winRate >= 0.5 ? "success" : "destructive") : ""}
          />
          <Pill
            label="Snitt-R"
            value={stats.avgR != null ? `${stats.avgR >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${formatNumber(stats.avgR, 2)}R` : "–"}
            color={stats.avgR != null ? (stats.avgR > 0 ? "success" : "destructive") : ""}
          />
          <Pill label="Sessioner" value={`${stats.completedSessions}/${stats.totalSessions}`} />
          {stats.unavailableSessions > 0 && (
            <Pill label="Historik utan snapshot" value={String(stats.unavailableSessions)} />
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* #28 Rule 7 comparison — shown when earnings exclusions make a real difference */}
      {earningsWarningCount > 0 && rawStats.total > 0 && (
        <div className="bg-amber-500/5 rounded-md border border-amber-500/20 px-3 py-2.5 space-y-1.5">
          <div className="text-[10px] text-amber-500 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide">
            Regel 7 påverkan
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs">
            <div>
              <div className="text-muted-foreground text-[10px] mb-0.5">Utan Regel 7</div>
              <div className="font-mono">{rawStats.winRate != null ? formatPercent(rawStats.winRate) : "–"} hitrate</div>
              <div className={`font-mono font-bold ${rawStats.avgR != null ? (rawStats.avgR > 0 ? "text-success" : "text-destructive") : ""}`}>
                {rawStats.avgR != null ? `${rawStats.avgR >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${formatNumber(rawStats.avgR, 2)}R` : "–"} snitt
              </div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="text-success text-[10px] mb-0.5 font-medium">Med Regel 7 ✓</div>
              <div className="font-mono">{cleanStats.winRate != null ? formatPercent(cleanStats.winRate) : "–"} hitrate</div>
              <div className={`font-mono font-bold ${cleanStats.avgR != null ? (cleanStats.avgR > 0 ? "text-success" : "text-destructive") : ""}`}>
                {cleanStats.avgR != null ? `${cleanStats.avgR >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${formatNumber(cleanStats.avgR, 2)}R` : "–"} snitt
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* #56 Direction split — LONG vs SHORT hitrate (shown when there is resolved data) */}
      {(() => {
        const allLong = sessions.flatMap((s) => s.longPicks ?? []);
        const allShort = sessions.flatMap((s) => s.shortPicks ?? []);
        const longRes = allLong.filter(isCountedTop3Pick);
        const shortRes = allShort.filter(isCountedTop3Pick);
        if (longRes.length === 0 && shortRes.length === 0) return null;
        const longWR = longRes.length > 0 ? longRes.filter(isWinningTop3Pick).length / longRes.length : null;
        const shortWR = shortRes.length > 0 ? shortRes.filter(isWinningTop3Pick).length / shortRes.length : null;
        const avgR = (pool: typeof longRes) => {
          const rs = pool.map((p) => p.r).filter((r): r is number => r != null);
          return rs.length > 0 ? rs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / rs.length : null;
        };
        const longAvgR = avgR(longRes);
        const shortAvgR = avgR(shortRes);
        return (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
            <div className="bg-success/5 border border-success/15 rounded-md p-2">
              <div className="text-[10px] text-success font-semibold mb-0.5">📈 Köp-picks</div>
              <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
                <span className="font-mono">{longWR != null ? formatPercent(longWR) : "—"} hitrate</span>
                <span className={`font-mono font-bold ${longAvgR != null ? (longAvgR >= 0 ? "text-success" : "text-destructive") : ""}`}>
                  {longAvgR != null ? `${longAvgR >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${formatNumber(longAvgR, 2)}R` : "—"} snitt
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{longRes.length}/{allLong.length} avslutade</div>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-destructive/5 border border-destructive/15 rounded-md p-2">
              <div className="text-[10px] text-destructive font-semibold mb-0.5">📉 Sälj-picks</div>
              <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
                <span className="font-mono">{shortWR != null ? formatPercent(shortWR) : "—"} hitrate</span>
                <span className={`font-mono font-bold ${shortAvgR != null ? (shortAvgR >= 0 ? "text-success" : "text-destructive") : ""}`}>
                  {shortAvgR != null ? `${shortAvgR >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${formatNumber(shortAvgR, 2)}R` : "—"} snitt
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{shortRes.length}/{allShort.length} avslutade</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })()}

      {/* #47 EdgeAI kalibrering — lovad WR vs faktisk WR */}
      {sessions.some((s) => s.edgeWinRate != null) && (() => {
        const withRate = sessions.filter((s) => s.selectionStatus === "AVAILABLE" && s.edgeWinRate != null);
        if (withRate.length === 0) return null;
        const avgPromised = withRate.reduce((a, s) => a + (s.edgeWinRate ?? 0), 0) / withRate.length;
        const allResolved = sessions.flatMap((s) => s.picks).filter(isCountedTop3Pick);
        const actualWR = allResolved.length > 0 ? allResolved.filter(isWinningTop3Pick).length / allResolved.length : null;
        return (
          <div className="bg-blue-500/5 border border-blue-500/20 rounded-md px-3 py-2 space-y-1.5">
            <div className="text-[10px] text-blue-400 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide">
              EdgeAI kalibrering
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-4 text-xs">
              <div>
                <div className="text-muted-foreground text-[10px]">Lovad WR</div>
                <div className="font-mono font-bold">{formatPercent(avgPromised)}</div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-muted-foreground text-[10px]">Faktisk WR</div>
                <div className={`font-mono font-bold ${actualWR != null ? (actualWR >= avgPromised ? "text-success" : "text-destructive") : ""}`}>
                  {actualWR != null ? formatPercent(actualWR) : "—"}
                </div>
              </div>
              {actualWR == null && (
                <div className="text-muted-foreground text-[10px] self-end italic">Logga utfall för att se jämförelse</div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })()}

      {/* Chart or empty state */}
      {isLoading ? (
        <div className="h-40 bg-muted rounded animate-pulse" />
      ) : !hasData ? (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-40 text-muted-foreground gap-2">
          <Trophy className="h-6 w-6 opacity-30" />
          <p className="text-xs">Logga utfall för att se kurvan.</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={160}>
          <LineChart data={chartData} margin={{ top: 4, right: 8, left: 0, bottom: 0 }}>
            <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" className="stroke-border" />
            <XAxis dataKey="date" tick={{ fontSize: 10 }} tickLine={false} axisLine={false} />
            <YAxis tick={{ fontSize: 10 }} tickLine={false} axisLine={false} tickFormatter={(v) => `${v}R`} width={36} />
            <ReferenceLine y={0} stroke="currentColor" strokeOpacity={0.25} />
            <Tooltip content={<Top3Tooltip sessions={displaySessions} />} />
            <Line type="linear" dataKey="cumulativeR" strokeWidth={2} stroke={accentColor} dot={{ r: 3, fill: accentColor }} activeDot={{ r: 5 }} isAnimationActive />
          </LineChart>
        </ResponsiveContainer>
      )}

      {/* Per-session picks table — always shows raw sessions with warning badges */}
        {sessions.length > 0 && (
        <div className="border-t border-border pt-3 space-y-2">
          {sessions.map((s) => (
            <div key={s.date} className="flex items-start gap-2 text-xs">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground w-12 shrink-0 pt-0.5">{s.date.slice(5)}</span>
                {s.selectionStatus === "UNAVAILABLE" ? (
                  <span className="flex-1 text-amber-600">Officiellt resultat saknas · historisk snapshot ej tillgänglig</span>
                ) : <div className="flex gap-1 flex-1 flex-wrap">
                {s.picks.map((p) => (
                  <span
                     key={`${p.direction}:${p.ticker}:${p.signalSource ?? "unknown"}`}
                     title={`${p.signalSource ?? "okänd källa"}${p.earningsWarning ? " · Rapportvarning — Regel 7 hade exkluderat denna" : ""}`}
                    className={`inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-mono font-medium ${
                      p.earningsWarning ? "ring-1 ring-amber-500/50" : ""
                    } ${
                      isWinningTop3Pick(p)
                        ? "bg-success/15 text-success"
                        : isLosingTop3Pick(p)
                        ? "bg-destructive/15 text-destructive"
                        : "bg-muted text-muted-foreground"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {p.earningsWarning && (
                      <AlertTriangle className="h-2.5 w-2.5 text-amber-500 shrink-0" />
                    )}
                    {p.ticker.replace(/\.ST$/i, "")}
                     {p.signalSource === "edgeai" ? " · E" : p.signalSource === "telegram" ? " · T" : ""}
                    {p.r != null ? ` ${p.r >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${formatNumber(p.r, 1)}R` : ""}
                  </span>
                ))}
                </div>}
              {s.sessionR !== null && (
                <span className={`font-mono font-bold shrink-0 ${s.sessionR >= 0 ? "text-success" : "text-destructive"}`}>
                  {s.sessionR >= 0 ? "+" : ""}{formatNumber(s.sessionR, 1)}R
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function Pill({
  label,
  value,
  color = "",
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  color?: string;
}) {
  const colorClass =
    color === "success"
      ? "text-success"
      : color === "destructive"
      ? "text-destructive"
      : "text-foreground";
  return (
    <div className="bg-muted/60 rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-xs flex gap-2 items-baseline">
      <span className="text-muted-foreground">{label}</span>
      <span className={`font-mono font-bold ${colorClass}`}>{value}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

function Top3Tooltip({
  active,
  payload,
  sessions,
}: TooltipProps<number, string> & { sessions: Top3Session[] }) {
  if (!active || !payload?.length) return null;
  const d = payload[0].payload as { date: string; cumulativeR: number };
  if (d.date === "Start") return null;

  const fullDate = sessions.find((s) => s.date.slice(5) === d.date)?.date;
  const session = sessions.find((s) => s.date === fullDate);

  return (
    <div className="bg-popover border border-border rounded-lg p-3 shadow-lg text-xs space-y-2 min-w-[180px]">
      <div className="font-semibold text-muted-foreground">{fullDate ?? d.date}</div>
      {session?.picks.map((p) => (
        <div key={`${p.direction}:${p.ticker}:${p.signalSource ?? "unknown"}`} className="flex justify-between gap-4">
          <span className="font-mono flex items-center gap-1">
            {p.earningsWarning && <AlertTriangle className="h-2.5 w-2.5 text-amber-500" />}
            {p.ticker} · {p.signalSource ?? "okänd"}
          </span>
          <span
            className={
              isWinningTop3Pick(p)
                ? "text-success font-mono"
                : isLosingTop3Pick(p)
                ? "text-destructive font-mono"
                : "text-muted-foreground"
            }
          >
            {p.r != null
              ? `${p.r >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${formatNumber(p.r, 2)}R`
              : p.outcome}
          </span>
        </div>
      ))}
      <div className="border-t border-border pt-1 flex justify-between">
        <span className="text-muted-foreground">Kumulativt</span>
        <span className="font-mono font-semibold">
          {d.cumulativeR >= 0 ? "+" : ""}
          {formatNumber(d.cumulativeR, 2)}R
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ─── Stat Card ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function StatCard({
  title,
  value,
  icon,
  subtitle,
  valueClass = "",
}: {
  title: string;
  value: string;
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  subtitle?: string;
  valueClass?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="bg-card border border-border rounded-lg p-6 shadow-sm">
      <div className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between space-y-0 pb-2">
        <h3 className="tracking-tight text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
          {title}
        </h3>
        {icon}
      </div>
      <div>
        <div className={`text-2xl font-bold font-mono ${valueClass}`}>
          {value}
        </div>
        {subtitle && (
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">{subtitle}</p>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Types ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
interface HistoricalEarning {
  date: string;
  estimate: number | null;
  actual: number | null;
  surprisePct: number | null;
  dayPlusOneReturn: number | null;
  beat: boolean | null;
}
interface EarningsStock {
  ticker: string;
  yahooTicker: string;
  display: string;
  market: "SE" | "US";
  earningsDate: string | null;
  earningsInDays: number | null;
  livePrice: number | null;
  changePct: number | null;
  nextEpsEstimate: number | null;
  beatRate: number | null;
  avgSurprisePct: number | null;
  avgDayPlusOneReturn: number | null;
  revisionUpCount: number;
  revisionDownCount: number;
  recommendationKey: string | null;
  recommendationMean: number | null;
  numberOfAnalystOpinions: number | null;
  targetMeanPrice: number | null;
  targetLowPrice: number | null;
  targetHighPrice: number | null;
  upsidePct: number | null;
  compositeScore: number | null;
  historicalEarnings: HistoricalEarning[];
}
interface EarningsResponse {
  stocks: EarningsStock[];
  generatedAt: string;
}

// ── Hook ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function useEarningsScreener() {
  return useQuery<EarningsResponse>({
    queryKey: ["earnings-screener"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch(`${BASE}/api/screener/earnings-screener`);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to load earnings screener");
      return res.json();
    },
    staleTime: 10 * 60_000, // 10 minutes — Yahoo Finance data doesn't update that often
  });
}

type SortBy = "days" | "score" | "consensus";

function sortStocks(stocks: EarningsStock[], sortBy: SortBy): EarningsStock[] {
  return [...stocks].sort((a, b) => {
    if (sortBy === "days") {
      const dA = a.earningsInDays ?? 99;
      const dB = b.earningsInDays ?? 99;
      if (dA < 0 && dB >= 0) return 1;
      if (dB < 0 && dA >= 0) return -1;
      if (dA < 0 && dB < 0) return dB - dA;
      return dA - dB;
    }
    if (sortBy === "score") {
      return (b.compositeScore ?? -1) - (a.compositeScore ?? -1);
    }
    // consensus: strong_buy(1) → strong_sell(5) ascending
    const cm = (s: EarningsStock) => s.recommendationMean ?? 99;
    return cm(a) - cm(b);
  });
}

// ── Page ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

            Uppdatera
          </button>
        </div>

          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm animate-pulse">

          </p>
          {[1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
            <div key={i} className="h-40 bg-muted rounded-lg animate-pulse" />
          ))}

      )}

      {isError && (
        <div className="p-6 bg-destructive/10 text-destructive rounded-lg border border-destructive/20">
          Kunde inte hämta rapportdata. Prova att uppdatera.
        </div>
      )}

      {data && data.stocks.length === 0 && (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-64 bg-card border border-border rounded-lg text-muted-foreground gap-3">
          <CalendarDays className="h-12 w-12 opacity-20" />
          <p className="text-base">Inga bolag rapporterar inom 21 dagar just nu.</p>
          <p className="text-sm opacity-70">Kolla igen närmre rapportsäsongen.</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {data && sorted.length > 0 && (

          ))}
        </div>

    </div>
  );
}

// ── Card ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function EarningsCard({ stock }: { stock: EarningsStock }) {
  const [showChart, setShowChart] = useState(false);
  const isToday = stock.earningsInDays === 0;
  const isTomorrow = stock.earningsInDays === 1;
  const isPast = (stock.earningsInDays ?? 1) < 0;

  const dayLabel = isPast
    ? `Rapporterade för ${Math.abs(stock.earningsInDays!)} dag${Math.abs(stock.earningsInDays!) === 1 ? "" : "ar"} sedan`
    : isToday
    ? "Rapporterar IDAG"
    : isTomorrow
    ? "Rapporterar IMORGON"
    : `Rapporterar om ${stock.earningsInDays} dagar`;

  const urgencyClass = isPast
    ? "border-border"
    : isToday
    ? "border-destructive/60 ring-1 ring-destructive/20"
    : isTomorrow || (stock.earningsInDays ?? 99) <= 2
    ? "border-orange-500/50"
    : "border-amber-500/30";

  const beatColor =
    stock.beatRate == null
      ? "text-muted-foreground"
      : stock.beatRate >= 0.7
      ? "text-success"
      : stock.beatRate >= 0.5
      ? "text-amber-600"
      : "text-destructive";

  const d1Color =
    stock.avgDayPlusOneReturn == null
      ? "text-muted-foreground"
      : stock.avgDayPlusOneReturn > 0
      ? "text-success"
      : "text-destructive";

  return (
    <div className={`bg-card border rounded-lg shadow-sm p-5 ${urgencyClass}`}>
      {/* Top row */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-3">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
            <span className="font-bold text-xl">{stock.ticker}</span>
            <span className="text-xs bg-muted px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-mono text-muted-foreground">
              {stock.market}
            </span>
            {stock.recommendationKey && (
              <Consensusbadge rkey={stock.recommendationKey} nAnalysts={stock.numberOfAnalystOpinions} />
            )}
            {(isToday || isTomorrow) && (
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-bold text-orange-500">
                <AlertTriangle className="h-3 w-3" />
                Undvik ny position
              </span>
            )}
            <button
              onClick={() => setShowChart((v) => !v)}
              title="Visa/dölj kursdiagram med Bollinger Bands"
              className={`p-1 rounded transition-colors ${showChart ? "bg-primary/15 text-primary" : "text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted"}`}
            >
              <CandlestickIcon className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </button>
          </div>
          <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{stock.display}</div>
        </div>
        <div className="text-right shrink-0 ml-3">
          <div className={`text-xs font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded ${
            isPast ? "bg-muted text-muted-foreground" :
            isToday ? "bg-destructive/15 text-destructive" :
            isTomorrow ? "bg-orange-500/15 text-orange-500" :
            "bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-600"
          }`}>
            {dayLabel}
          </div>
          {stock.earningsDate && (
            <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">{stock.earningsDate}</div>
          )}
          {stock.compositeScore != null && (
            <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">
              Score: <span className={`font-mono font-bold ${stock.compositeScore >= 0.65 ? "text-success" : stock.compositeScore >= 0.45 ? "text-amber-600" : "text-muted-foreground"}`}>
                {Math.round(stock.compositeScore * 100)}
              </span>/100
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Live price + price target row */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-6 gap-y-1 text-sm mb-3">
        {stock.livePrice != null && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">Pris</span>
            <span className="font-mono font-bold">{formatNumber(stock.livePrice)}</span>
            {stock.changePct != null && (
              <span className={`text-xs font-mono ${stock.changePct >= 0 ? "text-success" : "text-destructive"}`}>
                {stock.changePct >= 0 ? "+" : ""}{formatNumber(stock.changePct, 2)}%
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
        {stock.targetMeanPrice != null && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">Kursmål</span>
            <span className="font-mono font-medium">{formatNumber(stock.targetMeanPrice)}</span>
            {stock.targetLowPrice != null && stock.targetHighPrice != null && (
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-mono">
                ({formatNumber(stock.targetLowPrice)}–{formatNumber(stock.targetHighPrice)})
              </span>
            )}
            {stock.upsidePct != null && (
              <span className={`text-xs font-mono font-bold ${stock.upsidePct >= 0 ? "text-success" : "text-destructive"}`}>
                {stock.upsidePct >= 0 ? "+" : ""}{stock.upsidePct}%
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
        {stock.nextEpsEstimate != null && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">EPS-estimat</span>
            <span className="font-mono font-medium">{formatNumber(stock.nextEpsEstimate, 2)}</span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Metrics grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3 mb-3">
        <Metric
          label="Beat-rate"
          value={stock.beatRate != null ? formatPercent(stock.beatRate) : "–"}
          sub={`${stock.historicalEarnings.filter((e) => e.beat).length}/${stock.historicalEarnings.filter((e) => e.beat !== null).length} kvartal`}
          valueClass={beatColor}
        />
        <Metric
          label="Snitt EPS-surprise"
          value={stock.avgSurprisePct != null ? `${stock.avgSurprisePct > 0 ? "+" : ""}${formatNumber(stock.avgSurprisePct, 1)}%` : "–"}
          sub="mot estimat"
          valueClass={stock.avgSurprisePct != null ? (stock.avgSurprisePct > 0 ? "text-success" : "text-destructive") : "text-muted-foreground"}
        />
        <Metric
          label="Snitt dag +1"
          value={stock.avgDayPlusOneReturn != null ? `${stock.avgDayPlusOneReturn > 0 ? "+" : ""}${formatNumber(stock.avgDayPlusOneReturn, 1)}%` : "–"}
          sub="prisreaktion"
          valueClass={d1Color}
        />
        <Metric
          label="Rev. 30 dagar"
          value={`↑${stock.revisionUpCount} ↓${stock.revisionDownCount}`}
          sub="analytikerrevisioner"
          valueClass={
            stock.revisionUpCount > stock.revisionDownCount
              ? "text-success"
              : stock.revisionUpCount < stock.revisionDownCount
              ? "text-destructive"
              : "text-muted-foreground"
          }
        />
      </div>

      {/* Historical earnings mini-table */}
      {stock.historicalEarnings.length > 0 && (
        <div className="border-t border-border pt-3">
          <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Senaste kvartalen</p>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2">
            {stock.historicalEarnings.map((h) => (
              <div key={h.date} className={`rounded p-2 text-xs ${
                h.beat === true ? "bg-success/8" : h.beat === false ? "bg-destructive/8" : "bg-muted/50"
              }`}>
                <div className="text-muted-foreground text-[10px] mb-1">{h.date.slice(0, 7)}</div>
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                  <span className="font-mono">
                    {h.actual != null ? formatNumber(h.actual, 2) : "?"}
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground"> / {h.estimate != null ? formatNumber(h.estimate, 2) : "?"}</span>
                  </span>
                  {h.beat !== null && (
                    h.beat
                      ? <TrendingUp className="h-3 w-3 text-success" />
                      : <TrendingDown className="h-3 w-3 text-destructive" />
                  )}
                </div>
                {h.dayPlusOneReturn != null && (
                  <div className={`text-[10px] font-mono mt-0.5 ${h.dayPlusOneReturn >= 0 ? "text-success" : "text-destructive"}`}>
                    dag+1: {h.dayPlusOneReturn >= 0 ? "+" : ""}{formatNumber(h.dayPlusOneReturn, 1)}%
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Candlestick + Bollinger chart */}
      {showChart && (
        <div className="border-t border-border/60 mt-3 pt-3">
          <CandlestickChart ticker={stock.yahooTicker} height={300} />
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function Metric({ label, value, sub, valueClass = "" }: { label: string; value: string; sub: string; valueClass?: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="bg-muted/40 rounded-md p-3">
      <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">{label}</div>
      <div className={`text-lg font-bold font-mono ${valueClass}`}>{value}</div>
      <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{sub}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Analyst consensus pill ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const CONSENSUS_CONFIG: Record<string, { label: string; cls: string }> = {
  strong_buy:  { label: "STRONG BUY",  cls: "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30" },
  buy:         { label: "BUY",         cls: "bg-green-500/15 text-green-700 dark:text-green-400 border border-green-500/30" },
  hold:        { label: "HOLD",        cls: "bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30" },
  sell:        { label: "SELL",        cls: "bg-red-500/15 text-red-700 dark:text-red-400 border border-red-500/30" },
  strong_sell: { label: "STRONG SELL", cls: "bg-red-600/20 text-red-700 dark:text-red-400 border border-red-600/40" },
  underperform:{ label: "UNDERPERFORM",cls: "bg-red-500/15 text-red-700 dark:text-red-400 border border-red-500/30" },
  outperform:  { label: "OUTPERFORM",  cls: "bg-green-500/15 text-green-700 dark:text-green-400 border border-green-500/30" },
};

function Consensusbadge({ rkey, nAnalysts }: { rkey: string; nAnalysts: number | null }) {
  const cfg = CONSENSUS_CONFIG[rkey.toLowerCase()] ?? { label: rkey.replace(/_/g, " ").toUpperCase(), cls: "bg-muted text-muted-foreground border border-border" };
  return (
    <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded ${cfg.cls}`}>
      {cfg.label}
      {nAnalysts != null && <span className="font-normal opacity-70">({nAnalysts})</span>}
    </span>
  );
}



==============================================================================

import { useState } from "react";
import { useLocation } from "wouter";
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Terminal, Upload, AlertTriangle, RefreshCw, X, ShieldAlert, Zap, CheckCircle2 } from "lucide-react";
import { useImportSession, getListSessionsQueryKey } from "@workspace/api-client-react";
import { useAuthContext } from "../lib/auth-context";

const BASE = import.meta.env.BASE_URL.replace(/\/$/, "");

type AffectedOutcome = {
  ticker: string;
  category: string;
  outcome: "WIN" | "LOSS" | "SKIP";
  exitPrice: number | null;
};

type RemovedCandidatePreview = {
  ticker: string;
  category: string;
  direction: string;
  market?: string | null;
};

type ConflictInfo = {
  sessionId: number;
  date: string;
  affectedOutcomes: AffectedOutcome[];
  wouldRemove: RemovedCandidatePreview[];
  rawText: string;
  targetDate?: string;
};

const OUTCOME_COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
  WIN: "text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-500/10 border-emerald-500/20",
  LOSS: "text-red-400 bg-red-500/10 border-red-500/20",
  SKIP: "text-slate-400 bg-slate-500/10 border-slate-500/20",
};

type EdgeAIStatus =
  | { kind: "idle" }
  | { kind: "loading" }
  | {
      kind: "success";
      setupCount: number;
      date: string;
      generatedAt: string;
      stale?: boolean;
      ageDescription?: string;
    }
  | { kind: "auth"; message: string }
  | { kind: "error"; message: string };

export function Import() {
  const [rawText, setRawText] = useState("");
  const [useTodayAsTradingDate, setUseTodayAsTradingDate] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [conflict, setConflict] = useState<ConflictInfo | null>(null);
  const [edgeStatus, setEdgeStatus] = useState<EdgeAIStatus>({ kind: "idle" });
  const [, setLocation] = useLocation();
  const importSession = useImportSession();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const { login } = useAuthContext();

  const stockholmToday = () =>
    new Intl.DateTimeFormat("sv-SE", {
      timeZone: "Europe/Stockholm",
      year: "numeric",
      month: "2-digit",
      day: "2-digit",
    }).format(new Date());

  const runImport = (text: string, force: boolean, targetDate?: string) => {
    setError(null);
    importSession.mutate(
      { data: { rawText: text, force, targetDate } },
      {
        onSuccess: (data) => {
          queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: getListSessionsQueryKey() });
          setLocation(`/sessions/${data.id}`);
        },
        onError: (err: any) => {
          // ApiError wraps the response body in `.data`; fall back to top-level for safety.
          const body = err?.data ?? err;
          // 401 → the session expired mid-use (e.g. a token refresh failure). A generic
          // error here is a dead end; offer the same re-login path as the EdgeAI import.
          if (err?.status === 401) {
            setEdgeStatus({
              kind: "auth",
              message: "Din inloggning har gått ut. Logga in igen och försök importen på nytt.",
            });
            return;
          }
          // 409 conflict with outcome details → show confirmation modal
          if (body?.sessionId !== undefined && Array.isArray(body?.affectedOutcomes)) {
            setConflict({
              sessionId: body.sessionId,
              date: body.date,
              affectedOutcomes: body.affectedOutcomes,
              wouldRemove: body.wouldRemove ?? [],
              rawText: text,
              targetDate,
            });
          } else {
            setError(body?.error || err?.message || "Failed to parse and import session. Check format.");
          }
        },
      }
    );
  };

  const handleImport = () => {
    if (!rawText.trim()) {
      setError("Please paste screener output first.");
      return;
    }
    runImport(rawText, false, useTodayAsTradingDate ? stockholmToday() : undefined);
  };

  const handleForceReimport = () => {
    if (!conflict) return;
    setConflict(null);
    runImport(conflict.rawText, true, conflict.targetDate);
  };

  const handleEdgeAIImport = async (force = false) => {
    setEdgeStatus({ kind: "loading" });
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${BASE}/api/screener/sessions/import-from-edgeai`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        credentials: "include",
        body: JSON.stringify({ force }),
      });
      const responseText = await res.text();
      let data: any = null;
      try {
        data = responseText ? JSON.parse(responseText) : null;
      } catch {
        // A proxy or server failure may return an HTML error page. Do not
        // surface a misleading JSON parsing error to the trader.
      }
      if (!data && !res.ok) {
        setEdgeStatus({
          kind: "error",
          message: `Importtjänsten svarade med ${res.status}. Försök igen om en minut.`,
        });
        return;
      }
      if (res.status === 401) {
        setEdgeStatus({
          kind: "auth",
          message: "Din inloggning har gått ut. Logga in igen och försök importen på nytt.",
        });
        return;
      }
      if (res.status === 409) {
        // Reuse the same conflict modal as manual import
        setConflict({
          sessionId: data.sessionId,
          date: data.date,
          affectedOutcomes: data.affectedOutcomes,
          wouldRemove: data.wouldRemove ?? [],
          rawText: "__edgeai__", // sentinel — not used for edge import
        });
        setEdgeStatus({ kind: "idle" });
        return;
      }
      if (!res.ok) {
        setEdgeStatus({ kind: "error", message: data.error ?? `HTTP ${res.status}` });
        return;
      }
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: getListSessionsQueryKey() });
      setEdgeStatus({
        kind: "success",
        setupCount: data.setupCount,
        date: data.date,
        generatedAt: data.generatedAt,
        stale: data.stale,
        ageDescription: data.ageDescription,
      });
      setTimeout(() => setLocation(`/sessions/${data.id}`), 1200);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setEdgeStatus({ kind: "error", message: e.message ?? "Nätverksfel" });
    }
  };

  // Override force-reimport so both EdgeAI and manual conflicts work from same modal
  const handleForceFromConflict = () => {
    if (!conflict) return;
    if (conflict.rawText === "__edgeai__") {
      setConflict(null);
      handleEdgeAIImport(true);
    } else {
      handleForceReimport();
    }
  };

  const loggedOutcomes = conflict?.affectedOutcomes.filter((o) => o.outcome !== "SKIP") ?? [];
  const skipped = conflict?.affectedOutcomes.filter((o) => o.outcome === "SKIP") ?? [];

  return (
    <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-6 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-4 duration-500">
      <header>
        <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight">Import Screener Data</h2>
        <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-1">Paste the raw text output from your daily screener tool.</p>
      </header>

      {/* ── EdgeAI auto-import card ── */}
      <div className="bg-card border border-border rounded-xl p-4 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
          <div className="p-2 bg-blue-500/10 rounded-lg shrink-0">
            <Zap className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-400" />
          </div>
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <p className="text-sm font-medium">Importera från EdgeAI</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground truncate">
              Hämtar senaste SE/US-setups direkt från{" "}
              <span className="font-mono text-blue-400/80">edgeai/public/data.json</span>
              {edgeStatus.kind === "success" && (
                <span className="text-emerald-400 ml-1">
                  · {edgeStatus.setupCount} setups ({edgeStatus.date})
                  {edgeStatus.stale && (
                    <span className="text-amber-400">
                      {" "}
                      · {edgeStatus.ageDescription ?? "äldre snapshot"}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </span>
              )}
              {edgeStatus.kind === "error" && (
                <span className="text-red-400 ml-1">· {edgeStatus.message}</span>
              )}
              {edgeStatus.kind === "auth" && (
                <span className="text-amber-400 ml-1">· {edgeStatus.message}</span>
              )}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={() => edgeStatus.kind === "auth" ? login() : handleEdgeAIImport(false)}
          disabled={edgeStatus.kind === "loading"}
          className="shrink-0 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 rounded-md bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white text-sm font-medium disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed transition-colors"
          data-testid="btn-edgeai-import"
        >
          {edgeStatus.kind === "loading" ? (
            <span className="animate-pulse">Hämtar…</span>
          ) : edgeStatus.kind === "success" ? (
            <><CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" /> Importerad</>
          ) : edgeStatus.kind === "auth" ? (
            <>Logga in igen</>
          ) : (
            <><Zap className="w-4 h-4" /> Hämta & importera</>
          )}
        </button>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-destructive/10 text-destructive border border-destructive/20 rounded-md flex items-start gap-3">
          <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <p className="text-sm font-medium">{error}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="bg-card border border-border rounded-lg shadow-sm overflow-hidden flex flex-col">
        <div className="bg-muted px-4 py-2 border-b border-border flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono text-muted-foreground">
          <Terminal className="w-4 h-4" />
          RAW_INPUT.txt
        </div>
        <textarea
          value={rawText}
          onChange={(e) => setRawText(e.target.value)}
          placeholder={`Klistra in screener-texten här. Formatet ska innehålla:

SCREENER · YYYY-MM-DD

MARKNADSVÄDER  OMXS30 3305.0 | 5d  2.7% | 1m  1.8% | 3m  8.9% | RSI  79
→ MEDVIND

=== 1 · MOMENTUM — ...===
1. SSAB   102.85 | RS3m  18.5 | 1m  9.4% | RSI  57 | %B  0.90 | ATR  3.3% | vol  0.2x | ↔20dH  -0.3%
      plan(LONG): entry ~102.85 · stop 98.83 (1.2×ATR) · mål +1% 103.88 (R/R 0.26) · 1R 106.87

=== 2 · SQUEEZE — ...===
...`}
          className="w-full h-[500px] p-4 bg-transparent font-mono text-sm resize-none focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20"
          spellCheck={false}
          data-testid="input-raw-text"
        />
        <label className="flex items-start gap-3 border-t border-border bg-muted/30 px-4 py-3 cursor-pointer">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={useTodayAsTradingDate}
            onChange={(event) => setUseTodayAsTradingDate(event.target.checked)}
            className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 accent-primary"
          />
          <span>
            <span className="block text-sm font-medium">Visa i dagens session (äldre signal förblir inaktuell)</span>
            <span className="block text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
              Visar kandidaterna under {stockholmToday()}, men deras ursprungliga signaldatum ändras inte.
              En äldre signal kan inte bli handelsbar utan en ny, färsk screening.
            </span>
          </span>
        </label>
      </div>

      <div className="flex justify-end">
        <button
          onClick={handleImport}
          disabled={importSession.isPending}
          className="inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:pointer-events-none ring-offset-background bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 h-11 px-8 shadow-sm"
          data-testid="btn-parse-import"
        >
          {importSession.isPending ? (
            <span className="animate-pulse">Parsing...</span>
          ) : (
            <>
              <Upload className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
              Parse & Import
            </>
          )}
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* ── Conflict confirmation modal ── */}
      {conflict && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm p-4">
          <div className="bg-card border border-border rounded-xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-lg animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-200">
            {/* Header */}
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between p-5 border-b border-border">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="p-2 bg-amber-500/10 rounded-lg">
                  <ShieldAlert className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-400" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="font-semibold text-base">Session already exists</h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">{conflict.date}</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setConflict(null)}
                className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors p-1 rounded"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Body */}
            <div className="p-5 space-y-4">
              {conflict.affectedOutcomes.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  No outcomes have been logged yet. The new import will be merged
                  with candidates already in this session.
                </p>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                     The following outcomes are already logged. They will be{" "}
                     <span className="text-foreground font-medium">preserved</span>.
                     Candidates from both imports will remain in the session.
                  </p>

                  <div className="space-y-1.5 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                    {conflict.affectedOutcomes.map((o) => (
                      <div
                        key={`${o.ticker}-${o.outcome}`}
                        className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-md px-3 py-2 bg-muted/50 border border-border text-sm"
                      >
                        <span className="font-mono font-medium">{o.ticker}</span>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          {o.exitPrice != null && (
                            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                              exit {o.exitPrice.toFixed(2)}
                            </span>
                          )}
                          <span
                            className={`text-xs font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded border ${OUTCOME_COLORS[o.outcome] ?? ""}`}
                          >
                            {o.outcome}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>

                  {loggedOutcomes.length > 0 && (
                    <p className="text-xs text-amber-400/80 flex items-start gap-1.5">
                      <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                       Existing candidates from the other screener source will not be removed.
                    </p>
                  )}
                </>
              )}

              {conflict.wouldRemove.length > 0 && (
                <div className="space-y-1.5 pt-1 border-t border-border">
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground pt-3">
                    These still-pending picks are{" "}
                    <span className="text-foreground font-medium">not present</span>{" "}
                    in the new import and will be{" "}
                    <span className="text-destructive font-medium">removed</span> (no outcome
                    was logged for them, so nothing tracked is lost):
                  </p>
                  <div className="space-y-1.5 max-h-40 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                    {conflict.wouldRemove.map((c) => (
                      <div
                        key={`${c.ticker}-${c.category}-${c.direction}`}
                        className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-md px-3 py-2 bg-destructive/5 border border-destructive/20 text-sm"
                      >
                        <span className="font-mono font-medium">{c.ticker}</span>
                        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                          {c.category} · {c.direction}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Footer */}
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 px-5 py-4 border-t border-border">
              <button
                onClick={() => setConflict(null)}
                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md text-sm font-medium h-9 px-4 border border-border bg-transparent hover:bg-muted transition-colors"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={handleForceFromConflict}
                disabled={importSession.isPending}
                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md text-sm font-medium h-9 px-4 bg-amber-500 text-black hover:bg-amber-400 transition-colors disabled:opacity-50"
                data-testid="btn-confirm-reimport"
              >
                {importSession.isPending ? (
                  <span className="animate-pulse">Re-importing…</span>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1.5" />
                     Merge & update
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
